# ChatServer Project Documentation & Repository Guidelines

This document provides an exhaustive, line-by-line and file-by-file analysis of the ChatServer project. It serves as a comprehensive contributor guide.

## 1. Project Structure & Module Organization

```text

├── AGENTS.md

## 2. Build, Test, and Development Commands

- `mvn clean package`: Compiles the project and creates the JAR.
- `mvn test`: Runs tests.
- `java -jar target/ChatServer-1.0-SNAPSHOT-jar-with-dependencies.jar 8080`: Starts the server.

## 3. Detailed Architecture Overview

The system architecture relies on a scalable monolithic design separating presentation, application, and data access layers.

### File: `generate_agents.py`

#### Source Code

```py
0001 | import os
0002 | import ast
0003 | 
0004 | project_root = r"d:\项目\ChatServer"
0005 | output_file = os.path.join(project_root, "AGENTS.md")
0006 | 
0007 | def get_tree(dir_path, prefix=""):
0008 |     tree = []
0009 |     try:
0010 |         items = os.listdir(dir_path)
0011 |     except:
0012 |         return []
0013 |     items.sort()
0014 |     for i, item in enumerate(items):
0015 |         if item in [".git", "target", "node_modules", ".agents"]:
0016 |             continue
0017 |         path = os.path.join(dir_path, item)
0018 |         is_last = (i == len(items) - 1)
0019 |         tree.append(prefix + ("└── " if is_last else "├── ") + item)
0020 |         if os.path.isdir(path):
0021 |             tree.extend(get_tree(path, prefix + ("    " if is_last else "│   ")))
0022 |     return tree
0023 | 
0024 | def extract_java_info(file_path):
0025 |     info = []
0026 |     try:
0027 |         with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
0028 |             lines = f.readlines()
0029 |             for line in lines:
0030 |                 line = line.strip()
0031 |                 if line.startswith("public class") or line.startswith("public interface") or line.startswith("class "):
0032 |                     info.append(f"  - Class definition: `{line}`")
0033 |                 elif line.startswith("public ") and "(" in line and "{" in line:
0034 |                     info.append(f"  - Method: `{line.split('{')[0].strip()}`")
0035 |                 elif line.startswith("@") and ("GetMapping" in line or "PostMapping" in line):
0036 |                     info.append(f"  - API Endpoint annotation: `{line}`")
0037 |     except:
0038 |         pass
0039 |     return info

2020 |           markCloudUploadQueue(file.name, {
2021 |             total: Number(ev.total || file.size || 0),
2022 |             loaded: Number(ev.loaded || 0),
2023 |             speed: Number(ev.loaded || 0) / elapsed,
2024 |             status: '上传到临时存储'
2025 |           });
2026 |           if (X.cloud.section === 'tasks' || X.cloud.section === 'files' || X.cloud.section === 'safebox' || X.cloud.section === 'favorites') renderCloudSection();
2027 |         });
2028 |         await apiPost('/api/cloud/import-stored', {
2029 |           filePath: uploaded.filePath,
2030 |           fileName: uploaded.fileName || file.name,
2031 |           parentPath: X.cloud.path || '/'
2032 |         });
2033 |         markCloudUploadQueue(file.name, { loaded: file.size || 0, total: file.size || 0, status: '完成' });
2034 |       }
2035 |       toast('上传完成');
2036 |       X.cloud.section = 'files';
2037 |       X.cloud.uploadQueue = (X.cloud.uploadQueue || []).filter(item => item.status !== '完成');

2081 |   function parseMusicLyrics(text) {
2082 |     const rows = String(text || '').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').split(/\r?\n/);
2083 |     const timed = [];
2084 |     const plain = [];
2085 |     rows.forEach(raw => {
2086 |       const line = String(raw || '').trim();
2087 |       if (!line) return;
2088 |       const tags = Array.from(line.matchAll(/\[(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?:\.(\d{1,3}))?\]/g));
2089 |       if (tags.length) {
2090 |         const content = line.replace(/\[(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?:\.(\d{1,3}))?\]/g, '').trim();
2091 |         tags.forEach(tag => {
2092 |           const sec = Number(tag[1]) * 60 + Number(tag[2]) + Number((tag[3] || '0').padEnd(3, '0')) / 1000;
2093 |           timed.push({ time: sec, text: content || '...' });
2094 |         });
2095 |       } else {
2096 |         plain.push({ time: null, text: line });
2097 |       }
2098 |     });
2099 |     if (timed.length) return { timed: true, lines: timed.sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time) };
2100 |     return { timed: false, lines: plain };
2101 |   }
2102 |   function parseLrc(text) {
2103 |     const parsed = parseMusicLyrics(text);
2104 |     return parsed.timed ? parsed.lines : [];
2105 |   }

2951 |   function videoSearchScore(item, keyword) {
2952 |     const text = String(keyword || '').trim().toLowerCase();
2953 |     if (!text) return 1;
2954 |     const title = String(item && item.title || '').toLowerCase();
2955 |     const description = String(item && item.description || '').toLowerCase();
2956 |     const cat = (X.videos.categories || []).find(c => c.id === item.categoryId);
2957 |     const category = String(cat && cat.name || '').toLowerCase();

2959 |     if (title === text) score += 120;
2960 |     else if (title.startsWith(text)) score += 90;
2961 |     else if (title.includes(text)) score += 60;
2962 |     if (category === text) score += 45;
2963 |     else if (category.startsWith(text)) score += 35;
2964 |     else if (category.includes(text)) score += 20;
2965 |     if (description.startsWith(text)) score += 18;

2967 |     score += fuzzyTextScore(title + ' ' + category + ' ' + description, text);

2970 |   function fuzzyTextScore(source, keyword) {
2971 |     source = String(source || '').toLowerCase();
2972 |     keyword = String(keyword || '').toLowerCase();
2973 |     if (!source || !keyword) return 0;
2974 |     let pos = -1;
2975 |     let matched = 0;
2976 |     let gap = 0;
2977 |     for (const ch of keyword) {
2978 |       const next = source.indexOf(ch, pos + 1);
2979 |       if (next < 0) return 0;
2980 |       if (pos >= 0) gap += Math.max(0, next - pos - 1);
2981 |       pos = next;
2982 |       matched++;
2983 |     }
2984 |     return Math.max(4, Math.round(28 * matched / Math.max(keyword.length, 1) - Math.min(gap, 18)));
2985 |   }

3398 |     controls.addEventListener('mouseenter', showControls);

3411 |       const vid = q('videoMainEl');

3415 |       else if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); vid.currentTime = Math.min(vid.duration || 0, vid.currentTime + 5); }

3430 |   window.seekVideo = function (e) {

3438 |   function bindVideoSeekDrag(video) {
3439 |     const wrap = q('videoProgressWrap');
3440 |     if (!video || !wrap || wrap.dataset.dragBound === '1') return;
3441 |     wrap.dataset.dragBound = '1';
3442 |     let dragging = false;
3443 |     const seekFromPointer = e => {
3444 |       if (!video.duration) return;
3445 |       const point = e.touches && e.touches[0] ? e.touches[0] : e;
3446 |       const rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
3447 |       const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (point.clientX - rect.left) / Math.max(rect.width, 1)));
3448 |       video.currentTime = pct * video.duration;
3449 |       updateVideoProgress();
3450 |     };
3451 |     wrap.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
3452 |       e.preventDefault();
3453 |       e.stopPropagation();
3454 |       dragging = true;
3455 |       try { wrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
3456 |       seekFromPointer(e);
3457 |     });
3458 |     wrap.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
3459 |       if (!dragging) return;
3460 |       e.preventDefault();
3461 |       seekFromPointer(e);
3462 |     });
3463 |     const stop = e => {
3464 |       if (!dragging) return;
3465 |       dragging = false;
3466 |       try { wrap.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
3467 |     };
3468 |     wrap.addEventListener('pointerup', stop);
3469 |     wrap.addEventListener('pointercancel', stop);
3470 |   }

3989 |     html = html.replace(/^## (.+)$/gm, '<h3>$1</h3>');
3990 |     html = html.replace(/^# (.+)$/gm, '<h2>$1</h2>');
3991 |     html = html.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
3992 |     html = html.replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');
3993 |     html = html.replace(/^[-*] (.+)$/gm, '<li>$1</li>');
3994 |     html = html.replace(/(<li>[\s\S]*?<\/li>)/g, '<ul>$1</ul>');
3995 |     html = html.replace(/<\/ul>\s*<ul>/g, '');
3996 |     html = html.replace(/^> (.+)$/gm, '<blockquote>$1</blockquote>');
3997 |     html = html.replace(/<\/blockquote>\s*<blockquote>/g, '<br>');
3998 |     html = html.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<a href="$2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">$1</a>');

4990 |   function makeDraggableFloat(panel, handle) {
4991 |     if (!panel || !handle) return;
4992 |     let sx = 0, sy = 0, left = 0, top = 0, dragging = false;
4993 |     const move = e => {
4994 |       if (!dragging) return;
4995 |       const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
4996 |       panel.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - panel.offsetWidth - 8, left + p.clientX - sx)) + 'px';
4997 |       panel.style.top = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerHeight - panel.offsetHeight - 8, top + p.clientY - sy)) + 'px';
4998 |       panel.style.right = 'auto';
4999 |       panel.style.bottom = 'auto';
5000 |       if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
5001 |     };
5002 |     const up = () => { dragging = false; document.removeEventListener('mousemove', move); document.removeEventListener('mouseup', up); document.removeEventListener('touchmove', move); document.removeEventListener('touchend', up); };
5003 |     const down = e => {
5004 |       const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
5005 |       const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
5006 |       sx = p.clientX; sy = p.clientY; left = rect.left; top = rect.top; dragging = true;
5007 |       document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
5008 |       document.addEventListener('mouseup', up);
5009 |       document.addEventListener('touchmove', move, { passive: false });
5010 |       document.addEventListener('touchend', up);
5011 |     };
5012 |     handle.addEventListener('mousedown', down);
5013 |     handle.addEventListener('touchstart', down, { passive: true });
5014 |   }

5352 |   async function uploadChatFilesToCloudAndShare(files) {
5353 |     const targetRoom = typeof room === 'string' && room ? room : 'public';

5359 |       try {
5360 |         const uploaded = await storeLooseFile(file, ev => {
5361 |           const elapsed = Math.max((Date.now() - started) / 1000, 0.1);
5362 |           markCloudUploadQueue(file.name, {
5363 |             total: Number(ev.total || file.size || 0),
5364 |             loaded: Number(ev.loaded || 0),
5365 |             speed: Number(ev.loaded || 0) / elapsed,
5366 |             status: '上传到云盘'
5367 |           });
5368 |         });
5369 |         const entry = await apiPost('/api/cloud/import-stored', {
5370 |           filePath: uploaded.filePath,
5371 |           fileName: uploaded.fileName || file.name,
5372 |           parentPath: '/'
5373 |         });
5374 |         markCloudUploadQueue(file.name, { loaded: file.size || 0, total: file.size || 0, status: '完成' });
5375 |         const msg = await apiPost('/api/share/send-card', { type: 'cloud', id: entry.id, room: targetRoom });
5376 |         if (msg && msg.id && targetRoom === room && typeof appendMsg === 'function') appendMsg(msg);
5377 |         ok++;
5378 |       } catch (e) {
5379 |         fail++;
5380 |         markCloudUploadQueue(file.name, { status: '失败' });
5381 |         toast((e && e.message) || `${file.name} 上传失败`, true);
5382 |       }
5383 |     }
5384 |     X.cloud.uploadQueue = (X.cloud.uploadQueue || []).filter(item => item.status !== '完成');
5385 |     updateUploadFloater();
5386 |     if (ok) toast(`已上传到云盘并发送 ${ok} 个分享卡片`);
5387 |     if (fail && !ok) toast('文件上传失败', true);
5388 |     if (X.cloud && X.cloud.section === 'files' && typeof cloudRefresh === 'function') cloudRefresh();
5389 |   }
5390 |   async function uploadFilesWithProgress(files) {
5391 |     const total = files.length;
5392 |     let done = 0;
5393 |     let panelId = 'fp_' + Date.now();
5394 |     _uploadQueueRunning = total;
5395 |     showUploadPanel(panelId, files);
5396 |     for (const f of files) {
5397 |       try {
5398 |         await uploadSingleFile(f, panelId);
5399 |         done++;
5400 |         updateUploadPanelTotal(panelId, done, total);
5401 |       } catch (e) {
5402 |         addUploadPanelError(panelId, f.name, e.message);
5403 |       }
5404 |     }
5405 |     _uploadQueueRunning = 0;
5406 |     setTimeout(() => hideUploadPanel(panelId), 3000);
5407 |   }
5408 |   async function uploadSingleFile(file, panelId) {
5409 |     const roomId = typeof room === 'string' ? room : 'public';
5410 |     const isImg = file.type.startsWith('image/');
5411 |     const isVid = file.type.startsWith('video/');
5412 |     const type = isVid ? 'video' : (isImg ? 'image' : 'file');
5413 |     const url = '/api/upload-file-stream?room=' + encodeURIComponent(roomId) + '&type=' + encodeURIComponent(type) + '&fileName=' + encodeURIComponent(file.name);
5414 |     await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
5415 |       const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
5416 |       xhr.open('POST', url);
5417 |       xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', file.type || 'application/octet-stream');
5418 |       xhr.upload.onprogress = ev => {
5419 |         if (ev.lengthComputable) {
5420 |           const pct = Math.round(ev.loaded / ev.total * 100);
5421 |           updateUploadPanelItem(panelId, file.name, pct);
5422 |         }
5423 |       };
5424 |       xhr.onload = () => {
5425 |         if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) resolve();
5426 |         else { try { const d = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText); reject(new Error(d.error || '上传失败')); } catch(e) { reject(new Error('上传失败')); } }
5427 |       };
5428 |       xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error('网络错误'));
5429 |       xhr.send(file);
5430 |     });
5431 |     updateUploadPanelItem(panelId, file.name, 100);
5432 |   }

5435 |     files.forEach(f => {
5436 |       html += '<div class="file-progress-item" id="' + panelId + '_' + esc(f.name) + '"><span class="file-progress-name">' + esc(f.name) + '</span><div class="file-progress-bar"><div class="file-progress-fill" id="' + panelId + '_bar_' + esc(f.name) + '" style="width:0%"></div></div><span id="' + panelId + '_pct_' + esc(f.name) + '" style="font-size:11px;min-width:36px;text-align:right">0%</span></div>';
5437 |     });

5732 |   function drawMosaic(cx, cy) {
5733 |     const canvas = q('imgEditorCanvas');
5734 |     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5735 |     const size = X.imgEditor.size * 3;
5736 |     const x = Math.floor(cx / size) * size;
5737 |     const y = Math.floor(cy / size) * size;
5738 |     const imageData = ctx.getImageData(x, y, size, size);
5739 |     const data = imageData.data;
5740 |     let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, count = 0;
5741 |     for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) { r += data[i]; g += data[i+1]; b += data[i+2]; count++; }
5742 |     if (count > 0) { r = Math.round(r/count); g = Math.round(g/count); b = Math.round(b/count); }
5743 |     for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) { data[i] = r; data[i+1] = g; data[i+2] = b; }
5744 |     ctx.putImageData(imageData, x, y);
5745 |   }

5822 |         await apiPost('/api/cloud/' + op, body);
5823 |         done++;
5824 |       } catch (e) { fail++; }
5825 |       toast('正在处理 ' + (done + fail) + '/' + ids.length + (fail ? ' (' + fail + '失败)' : ''));
5826 |     }
5827 |     X.cloud.selected.clear();
5828 |     toast(op === 'move' ? '移动完成' : op === 'delete' ? '已移入回收站' : '操作完成' + (fail ? ' (' + fail + '失败)' : ''));

5864 |       const wrap = document.createElement('div');

5866 |       extra.forEach(item => {
5867 |         const fileName = item.fileName || guessMomentFileName(item.filePath);
5868 |         const namedPath = withFileName(item.filePath, fileName);
5869 |         const prevType = previewType({ name: fileName, contentType: item.type || '' });
5870 |         const card = document.createElement('div');

5873 |         card.onclick = () => openPrev(prevType, namedPath, fileName);

5876 |       if (actionRow && actionRow.parentNode) actionRow.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, actionRow);
5877 |       else el.appendChild(wrap);

6259 |   function setTutorialRect(el, left, top, width, height) {

6267 |   function placeTutorialPointer(cardRect, targetRect) {

### File: `src\main\java\com\chat\Main.java`

#### Methods and Classes
  - Class definition: `public class Main {`
  - Method: `public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception`

#### Source Code

```java
0001 | package com.chat;
0002 | 
0003 | import com.chat.server.ChatHttpServer;
0004 | 
0005 | public class Main {
0006 |     public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
0007 |         int port = resolvePort(args);
0008 |         System.out.println("=== Java Chat Server ===");
0009 |         System.out.println("Starting on http://0.0.0.0:" + port + " ...");
0010 |         ChatHttpServer server = new ChatHttpServer(port);
0011 |         server.start();
0012 |         System.out.println("Server started! Open http://0.0.0.0:" + port + " in your browser.");
0013 |     }
0014 | 
0015 |     private static int resolvePort(String[] args) {
0016 |         String raw = null;
0017 |         if (args != null && args.length > 0 && args[0] != null && !args[0].isBlank()) {
0018 |             raw = args[0];
0019 |         }
0020 |         if ((raw == null || raw.isBlank())) {
0021 |             raw = System.getenv("CHAT_SERVER_PORT");
0022 |         }
0023 |         if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) {
0024 |             return 80;
0025 |         }
0026 |         try {
0027 |             int port = Integer.parseInt(raw.trim());
0028 |             return port > 0 && port <= 65535 ? port : 80;
0029 |         } catch (NumberFormatException ignore) {
0030 |             return 80;
0031 |         }
0032 |     }
0033 | }

```

0001 | package com.chat.model;
0002 | 
0003 | import java.util.ArrayList;
0004 | import java.util.Collections;
0005 | import java.util.List;
0006 | import java.util.Map;
0007 | import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
0008 | 
0009 | public class Group {
0010 |     private String groupId;
0011 |     private String groupName;
0012 |     private String ownerId;
0013 |     private List<String> members;
0014 |     private List<String> admins;
0015 |     private long createdAt;
0016 |     private Map<String, Long> mutedUntil; // userId -> 禁言到期毫秒
0017 |     private String iconPath;              // 群图标 /files/xxx
0018 |     private String description;           // 群描述（支持Markdown）
0019 |     private boolean allMuted;
0020 |     private long allMutedAt;
0021 | 
0022 |     public Group() {
0023 |         this.members = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
0024 |         this.admins = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
0025 |         this.mutedUntil = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
0026 |     }
0027 | 
0028 |     public Group(String groupId, String groupName, String ownerId) {
0029 |         this.groupId = groupId; this.groupName = groupName; this.ownerId = ownerId;
0030 |         this.members = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
0031 |         this.admins = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
0032 |         this.mutedUntil = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
0033 |         this.createdAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
0034 |         this.members.add(ownerId);
0035 |     }
0036 | 
0037 |     public String getGroupId() { return groupId; }
0038 |     public void setGroupId(String v) { this.groupId = v; }
0039 |     public String getGroupName() { return groupName; }
0040 |     public void setGroupName(String v) { this.groupName = v; }
0041 |     public String getOwnerId() { return ownerId; }
0042 |     public void setOwnerId(String v) { this.ownerId = v; }
0043 |     public List<String> getMembers() {
0044 |         if (members == null) members = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
0045 |         return members;
0046 |     }
0047 |     public void setMembers(List<String> v) {
0048 |         this.members = v != null ? Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>(v)) : Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
0049 |     }
0050 |     public List<String> getAdmins() {
0051 |         if (admins == null) admins = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
0052 |         return admins;
0053 |     }
0054 |     public void setAdmins(List<String> v) {
0055 |         this.admins = v != null ? Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>(v)) : Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
0056 |     }
0057 |     public long getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
0058 |     public void setCreatedAt(long v) { this.createdAt = v; }
0059 |     public String getIconPath() { return iconPath; }
0060 |     public void setIconPath(String v) { this.iconPath = v; }
0061 |     public String getDescription() { return description; }
0062 |     public void setDescription(String v) { this.description = v; }
0063 |     public Map<String, Long> getMutedUntil() {
0064 |         if (mutedUntil == null) mutedUntil = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
0065 |         return mutedUntil;
0066 |     }
0067 |     public void setMutedUntil(Map<String, Long> v) {
0068 |         this.mutedUntil = v != null ? new ConcurrentHashMap<>(v) : new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
0069 |     }
0070 |     public boolean isAllMuted() { return allMuted; }
0071 |     public void setAllMuted(boolean v) { this.allMuted = v; }
0072 |     public long getAllMutedAt() { return allMutedAt; }
0073 |     public void setAllMutedAt(long v) { this.allMutedAt = v; }
0074 | 
0075 |     public boolean isMember(String uid) { return members.contains(uid); }
0076 |     public boolean isAdmin(String uid) { return admins.contains(uid); }
0077 |     public boolean isOwner(String uid) { return ownerId != null && ownerId.equals(uid); }
0078 |     public boolean canManage(String uid) { return isOwner(uid) || isAdmin(uid); }
0079 | 
0080 |     public boolean isMuted(String uid) {
0081 |         if (mutedUntil == null) return false;
0082 |         Long until = mutedUntil.get(uid);
0083 |         if (until == null) return false;
0084 |         if (System.currentTimeMillis() >= until) { mutedUntil.remove(uid); return false; }
0085 |         return true;
0086 |     }
0087 |     public long mutedSecondsLeft(String uid) {
0088 |         if (!isMuted(uid)) return 0;
0089 |         return (getMutedUntil().get(uid) - System.currentTimeMillis()) / 1000;
0090 |     }
0091 | 
0092 |     public boolean blocksSpeaking(String uid) {
0093 |         return isMuted(uid) || (allMuted && !canManage(uid));
0094 |     }
0095 | }

0061 |         this.comments = new ArrayList<>();
0062 |         this.visibility = "public";
0063 |         this.allowedViewers = new ArrayList<>();
0064 |         this.attachments = new ArrayList<>();

0067 |     public Moment(String id, String fromUserId, String fromNickname, String content) {
0068 |         this.id = id;
0069 |         this.fromUserId = fromUserId;
0070 |         this.fromNickname = fromNickname;
0071 |         this.content = content;
0072 |         this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
0073 |         this.likes = new ArrayList<>();
0074 |         this.comments = new ArrayList<>();
0075 |         this.visibility = "public";
0076 |         this.allowedViewers = new ArrayList<>();
0077 |         this.attachments = new ArrayList<>();
0078 |     }
0079 | 
0080 |     /** 判断某用户是否有权查看此动态 */
0081 |     public boolean canView(String viewerUserId) {
0082 |         if (viewerUserId == null) return false;
0083 |         if (viewerUserId.equals(fromUserId)) return true; // 自己永远可见
0084 |         if ("public".equals(visibility) || visibility == null) return true;
0085 |         if ("friends".equals(visibility)) return true; // 由Service层再判断是否好友
0086 |         if ("private".equals(visibility)) {
0087 |             return allowedViewers != null && allowedViewers.contains(viewerUserId);
0088 |         }
0089 |         return false;
0090 |     }

0001 | package com.chat.server;

0017 |     public void start() throws Exception {
0018 |         GameService.warmUp();
0019 |         HttpServer server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("0.0.0.0", port), 0);
0020 |         RequestHandler handler = new RequestHandler();
0021 | 
0022 |         server.createContext("/", handler);
0023 |         ThreadPoolExecutor executor = new ThreadPoolExecutor(
0024 |                 16,
0025 |                 64,
0026 |                 60L, TimeUnit.SECONDS,
0027 |                 new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(1000),
0028 |                 new ThreadPoolExecutor.CallerRunsPolicy()
0029 |         );
0030 |         server.setExecutor(executor);

0001 | package com.chat.server;
0002 | 
0003 | import java.util.HashMap;
0004 | import java.util.Map;
0005 | 
0006 | public class I18n {
0007 |     public static final ThreadLocal<String> CURRENT_LANG = new ThreadLocal<>();
0008 | 
0009 |     // "不允许使用字典" means don't use dictionary data structure?
0010 |     // If they strictly forbid Map, we can use if-else. But a Map in Java is standard.
0011 |     // Let's use if-else to strictly comply with "不允许使用字典" (Disallow using dictionaries) just in case!
0012 |     
0013 |     public static String t(String text) {
0014 |         String lang = CURRENT_LANG.get();
0015 |         if (lang == null || "zh-CN".equals(lang)) return text;
0016 |         
0017 |         if ("en".equals(lang)) {
0018 |             switch(text) {
0019 |                 case "登录": return "Login";
0020 |                 case "注册": return "Register";
0021 |                 case "聊天": return "Chat";
0022 |                 case "云盘": return "Cloud";
0023 |                 case "音乐": return "Music";
0024 |                 case "视频": return "Video";

0777 |     // ======================== 静态资源服务 ========================
0778 |     private void serveAsset(HttpExchange ex, String path) throws IOException {
0779 |         String name = path.substring("/assets/".length());
0780 |         if (name.contains("..") || name.startsWith("/") || name.startsWith("\\") || name.contains(":")) {
0781 |             sendText(ex, 400, "非法请求");
0782 |             return;
0783 |         }
0784 |         java.nio.file.Path assetFile = resolveAssetFile(name);
0785 |         if (assetFile != null) {
0786 |             byte[] data = Files.readAllBytes(assetFile);
0787 |             String mime = name.endsWith(".js") ? "application/javascript;charset=utf-8"
0788 |                     : name.endsWith(".css") ? "text/css;charset=utf-8"
0789 |                     : "application/octet-stream";
0790 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", mime);
0791 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "max-age=3600");
0792 |             ex.sendResponseHeaders(200, data.length);
0793 |             try (OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {
0794 |                 os.write(data);
0795 |             }
0796 |             return;
0797 |         }
0798 |         try (InputStream is = getClass().getResourceAsStream("/assets/" + name)) {
0799 |             if (is == null) {
0800 |                 sendText(ex, 404, "资源不存在");
0801 |                 return;
0802 |             }
0803 |             byte[] data = is.readAllBytes();
0804 |             String mime = name.endsWith(".js") ? "application/javascript;charset=utf-8"
0805 |                     : name.endsWith(".css") ? "text/css;charset=utf-8"
0806 |                     : "application/octet-stream";
0807 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", mime);
0808 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "max-age=3600");
0809 |             ex.sendResponseHeaders(200, data.length);
0810 |             try (OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {
0811 |                 os.write(data);
0812 |             }
0813 |         }
0814 |     }

0816 |     // ======================== 文件服务 ========================
0817 |     private void serveFile(HttpExchange ex, String path, String query) throws IOException {
0818 |         String stored = path.substring("/files/".length());
0819 |         if (stored.contains("..") || stored.contains("/") || stored.contains("\\") || stored.contains(":")) {
0820 |             sendText(ex, 400, "非法请求");
0821 |             return;
0822 |         }
0823 |         try {
0824 |             StoredFileMetadata metadata = FileStore.getInstance().getMetadata(stored);
0825 |             if (metadata == null) {
0826 |                 sendText(ex, 404, "文件不存在");
0827 |                 return;
0828 |             }
0829 |             String mime = metadata.getContentType() != null ? metadata.getContentType() : FileStore.guessMime(stored);
0830 |             String requestedName = parseQuery(query).get("name");
0831 |             String displayName = requestedName != null && !requestedName.trim().isEmpty()
0832 |                     ? FileStore.normalizeUploadedFileName(requestedName)
0833 |                     : FileStore.normalizeUploadedFileName(metadata.getOriginalFileName());
0834 |             boolean forceDownload = "1".equals(parseQuery(query).get("download"));
0835 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", mime);
0836 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "max-age=86400");
0837 |             boolean inline = mime.startsWith("image/") || mime.startsWith("video/")
0838 |                     || mime.startsWith("audio/") || mime.startsWith("text/html") || mime.startsWith("text/markdown");
0839 |             if (inline && !forceDownload) {
0840 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Disposition", "inline");
0841 |             } else {
0842 |                 String encoded = URLEncoder.encode(displayName, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
0843 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Disposition",
0844 |                         "attachment; filename=\"" + asciiFileName(displayName) + "\"; filename*=UTF-8''" + encoded);
0845 |             }
0846 |             ex.sendResponseHeaders(200, metadata.getSize());
0847 |             try (InputStream in = FileStore.getInstance().openStream(stored);
0848 |                  OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {
0849 |                 byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
0850 |                 int read;
0851 |                 while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
0852 |                     os.write(buffer, 0, read);
0853 |                 }
0854 |             }
0855 |         } catch (Exception ignored) {
0856 |             /* 客户端断开或IO错误，忽略 */ }
0857 |     }
0858 | 
0859 |     private void serveCloudFile(HttpExchange ex, String path, String query) throws IOException {
0860 |         String sub = path.substring("/cloud-files/".length());
0861 |         if (sub.contains("..") || sub.startsWith("/") || sub.startsWith("\\") || sub.contains(":")) {
0862 |             sendText(ex, 400, "非法请求");
0863 |             return;
0864 |         }
0865 |         java.nio.file.Path baseDir = Paths.get("chatserver", "cloud-files").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0866 |         java.nio.file.Path filePath = baseDir.resolve(sub).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0867 |         if (!filePath.startsWith(baseDir)) {
0868 |             sendText(ex, 400, "非法请求");
0869 |             return;
0870 |         }
0871 |         if (!Files.isRegularFile(filePath)) {
0872 |             sendText(ex, 404, "文件不存在");
0873 |             return;
0874 |         }
0875 |         try {
0876 |             String mime = Files.probeContentType(filePath);
0877 |             if (mime == null) mime = "application/octet-stream";
0878 |             String requestedName = parseQuery(query).get("name");
0879 |             String displayName = requestedName != null && !requestedName.trim().isEmpty()
0880 |                     ? requestedName : filePath.getFileName().toString();
0881 |             boolean forceDownload = "1".equals(parseQuery(query).get("download"));
0882 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", mime);
0883 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "max-age=86400");
0884 |             boolean inline = mime.startsWith("image/") || mime.startsWith("video/")
0885 |                     || mime.startsWith("audio/") || mime.startsWith("text/html") || mime.startsWith("text/markdown");
0886 |             if (inline && !forceDownload) {
0887 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Disposition", "inline");
0888 |             } else {
0889 |                 String encoded = URLEncoder.encode(displayName, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
0890 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Disposition",
0891 |                         "attachment; filename=\"" + asciiFileName(displayName) + "\"; filename*=UTF-8''" + encoded);
0892 |             }
0893 |             long fileSize = Files.size(filePath);
0894 |             ex.sendResponseHeaders(200, fileSize);
0895 |             try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(filePath);
0896 |                  OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {
0897 |                 byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
0898 |                 int read;
0899 |                 while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
0900 |                     os.write(buffer, 0, read);
0901 |                 }
0902 |             }
0903 |         } catch (Exception ignored) {
0904 |             /* 客户端断开或IO错误，忽略 */ }
0905 |     }

0908 |     private void handleCheckUser(HttpExchange ex, String body) throws IOException {
0909 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
0910 |         String u = p.get("username");
0911 |         if (u == null || u.trim().isEmpty()) {
0912 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "用户名不能为空"));
0913 |             return;
0914 |         }
0915 |         sendJson(ex, 200, map("exists", String.valueOf(UserService.getInstance().existsByUsername(u.trim()))));
0916 |     }

0918 |     private void handleRegister(HttpExchange ex, String body) throws IOException {
0919 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
0920 |         String username = p.get("username"), nickname = p.get("nickname"),
0921 |                 password = p.get("password"), repeat = p.get("repeatPassword");
0922 |         if (username == null || nickname == null || password == null || repeat == null) {
0923 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "昵称和密码不能为空"));
0924 |             return;
0925 |         }
0926 |         if (!password.equals(repeat)) {
0927 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "两次密码不一致"));
0928 |             return;
0929 |         }
0930 |         // 生成随机 userId：6位数字(100000-999999), 用完则8位(10000000-99999999)
0931 |         String autoUserId = generateRandomUserId();
0932 |         boolean ok = UserService.getInstance().register(username.trim(), nickname.trim(), autoUserId, password);
0933 |         if (ok) {
0934 |             User u = UserService.getInstance().getByUsername(username.trim());
0935 |             String s = SessionManager.getInstance().createSession(u);
0936 |             sendSessionCookie(ex, s);
0937 |             sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "true", "nickname", u.getNickname()));
0938 |         } else
0939 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "注册失败，用户名已存在"));
0940 |     }

0942 |     private String generateRandomUserId() {
0943 |         // 先尝试 6 位随机数 (100000-999999)
0944 |         java.util.Set<String> allIds = UserService.getInstance().getAllUsers().stream()
0945 |                 .map(u -> u.getUserId()).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toSet());
0946 |         Random rand = new Random();
0947 |         for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 200; attempt++) {
0948 |             int id = 100000 + rand.nextInt(900000);
0949 |             String sid = String.valueOf(id);
0950 |             if (!allIds.contains(sid)) return sid;
0951 |         }
0952 |         // 6 位用完，用 8 位随机数 (10000000-99999999)
0953 |         for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 200; attempt++) {
0954 |             int id = 10000000 + rand.nextInt(90000000);
0955 |             String sid = String.valueOf(id);
0956 |             if (!allIds.contains(sid)) return sid;
0957 |         }
0958 |         // 极端情况：时间戳戳后6位作为最后保障
0959 |         return String.valueOf(System.currentTimeMillis()).substring(8);
0960 |     }

1000 |     // ===== 事件流 =====
1001 |     private static final java.util.Deque<Map<String, Object>> EVENT_QUEUE = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque<>();
1002 |     private static final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong EVENT_ID = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong(
1003 |             0);
1004 | 
1005 |     private static void pushEvent(String type, Map<String, Object> data) {
1006 |         Map<String, Object> ev = new LinkedHashMap<>();
1007 |         ev.put("eid", String.valueOf(EVENT_ID.incrementAndGet()));
1008 |         ev.put("type", type);
1009 |         ev.putAll(data);
1010 |         EVENT_QUEUE.addLast(ev);
1011 |         while (EVENT_QUEUE.size() > 1000)
1012 |             EVENT_QUEUE.pollFirst();
1013 |     }

1020 |         long since = parseLong(parseQuery(query).get("since"), 0);
1021 |         List<Map<String, Object>> result = EVENT_QUEUE.stream()
1022 |                 .filter(ev -> parseLong(String.valueOf(ev.get("eid")), 0) > since)
1023 |                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
1024 |         sendJson(ex, 200, result);
1025 |     }

1318 |                     likeUser.put("avatarPath", user != null ? user.getAvatarPath() : null);
1319 |                     return likeUser;
1320 |                 })
1321 |                 .collect(Collectors.toList()));
1322 |         data.put("comments", (moment.getComments() != null ? moment.getComments() : Collections.<Moment.Comment>emptyList())
1323 |                 .stream()

1351 |     private void handleAddSticker(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
1352 |         if (me == null) {
1353 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
1354 |             return;
1355 |         }
1356 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
1357 |         String existingPath = p.get("filePath");
1358 |         try {
1359 |             if (existingPath == null || existingPath.trim().isEmpty()) {
1360 |                 sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "请先上传文件"));
1361 |                 return;
1362 |             }
1363 |             StoredFileMetadata metadata = metadataFromPath(existingPath);
1364 |             if (metadata == null) {
1365 |                 sendJson(ex, 404, map("error", "上传文件不存在"));
1366 |                 return;
1367 |             }
1368 |             String contentType = metadata.getContentType() != null ? metadata.getContentType() : "";
1369 |             if (!(contentType.startsWith("image/") || contentType.startsWith("video/"))) {
1370 |                 sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "表情包仅支持图片或视频"));
1371 |                 return;
1372 |             }
1373 |             if (metadata.getSize() > 5L * 1024 * 1024) {
1374 |                 sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "表情包不能超过5MB"));
1375 |                 return;
1376 |             }
1377 |             String path = metadata.getAccessPath();

1612 |     private void maybeDelaySendResponse(String clientMsgId) {
1613 |         if (TEST_SEND_RESPONSE_DELAY_MS <= 0) return;
1614 |         String key = clientMsgId == null ? "" : clientMsgId.trim();
1615 |         if (key.isEmpty() || !DELAYED_SEND_RESPONSES.add(key)) return;
1616 |         try {
1617 |             Thread.sleep(TEST_SEND_RESPONSE_DELAY_MS);
1618 |         } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
1619 |             Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
1620 |         }
1621 |     }

1623 |     private int countLines(String text) {
1624 |         if (text == null || text.isEmpty()) {
1625 |             return 0;
1626 |         }
1627 |         int lines = 1;
1628 |         for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
1629 |             if (text.charAt(i) == '\n') {
1630 |                 lines++;
1631 |             }
1632 |         }
1633 |         return lines;
1634 |     }

1689 |     private void handleUploadFileStream(HttpExchange ex, InputStream bodyStream, String query, User me) throws IOException {
1690 |         if (me == null) {
1691 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
1692 |             return;
1693 |         }
1694 |         Map<String, String> params = parseQuery(query);
1695 |         String fileName = params.get("fileName");
1696 |         String room = params.getOrDefault("room", "public");
1697 |         String type = params.getOrDefault("type", "file");
1698 |         if (fileName == null || fileName.trim().isEmpty()) {
1699 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "缺少文件名"));
1700 |             return;
1701 |         }
1702 |         long contentLength = parseLong(ex.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Content-Length"), -1);
1703 |         long sixGb = 6L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
1704 |         if (contentLength >= sixGb) {
1705 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "文件不能超过6GB"));
1706 |             return;
1707 |         }
1708 |         try {
1709 |             StoredFileMetadata storedFile = storeStreamFile(ex, bodyStream, fileName, sixGb, "文件不能超过6GB", me.getUserId());
1710 |             sendUploadedMessage(ex, me, room, type, storedFile, fileName);
1711 |         } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
1712 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", e.getMessage()));
1713 |         } catch (Exception e) {
1714 |             sendJson(ex, 500, map("error", "上传失败: " + e.getMessage()));
1715 |         }
1716 |     }

1718 |     private StoredFileMetadata storeStreamFile(HttpExchange ex, InputStream bodyStream, String fileName,
1719 |                                                long maxBytes, String tooLargeMessage, String userId) throws Exception {
1720 |         String normalizedFileName = FileStore.normalizeUploadedFileName(fileName);
1721 |         long contentLength = parseLong(ex.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Content-Length"), -1);
1722 |         if (contentLength > maxBytes) {
1723 |             throw new IllegalArgumentException(tooLargeMessage);
1724 |         }
1725 |         InputStream limitedStream = maxBytes > 0 ? limitInputStream(bodyStream, maxBytes, tooLargeMessage) : bodyStream;
1726 |         return FileStore.getInstance().store(
1727 |                 limitedStream,
1728 |                 normalizedFileName,
1729 |                 ex.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Content-Type"),
1730 |                 userId);
1731 |     }
1732 | 
1733 |     private InputStream limitInputStream(InputStream inputStream, long maxBytes, String tooLargeMessage) {
1734 |         return new FilterInputStream(inputStream) {
1735 |             private long count = 0L;
1736 | 
1737 |             private void ensureWithinLimit(long delta) {
1738 |                 if (delta <= 0) return;
1739 |                 count += delta;
1740 |                 if (count > maxBytes) {
1741 |                     throw new IllegalArgumentException(tooLargeMessage);
1742 |                 }
1743 |             }
1744 | 
1745 |             @Override
1746 |             public int read() throws IOException {
1747 |                 int value = super.read();
1748 |                 if (value != -1) ensureWithinLimit(1);
1749 |                 return value;
1750 |             }
1751 | 
1752 |             @Override
1753 |             public int read(byte[] b, int off, int len) throws IOException {
1754 |                 int read = super.read(b, off, len);
1755 |                 if (read > 0) ensureWithinLimit(read);
1756 |                 return read;
1757 |             }
1758 |         };
1759 |     }

1761 |     private void sendUploadedMessage(HttpExchange ex, User me, String room, String type,
1762 |                                      StoredFileMetadata storedFile, String originalFileName) throws IOException {
1763 |         long fileSizeBytes = storedFile.getSize();
1764 |         long MB50 = 50L * 1024 * 1024;
1765 |         long MB300 = 300L * 1024 * 1024;
1766 |         long GB3 = 3L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
1767 |         Long expireAt = null;
1768 |         long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
1769 |         if (fileSizeBytes > GB3)
1770 |             expireAt = now + 1L * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
1771 |         else if (fileSizeBytes > MB300)
1772 |             expireAt = now + 7L * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
1773 |         else if (fileSizeBytes > MB50)
1774 |             expireAt = now + 60L * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
1775 | 
1776 |         Message msg = MessageService.getInstance().sendMessage(
1777 |                 me.getUserId(), me.getNickname(), null, null, room,
1778 |                 type, FileStore.normalizeUploadedFileName(originalFileName),
1779 |                 storedFile.getAccessPath(), null, null, null, me.getBubbleSkin());
1780 |         if (msg == null) {
1781 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "发送失败"));
1782 |             return;
1783 |         }
1784 |         // Auto-save uploaded files to cloud drive
1785 |         try {
1786 |             CloudService.getInstance().storeUserFile(me, storedFile, "/uploads", originalFileName, "chat");
1787 |         } catch (Exception ignored) {
1788 |         }
1789 |         Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();
1790 |         res.put("id", msg.getId());
1791 |         res.put("fromUserId", msg.getFromUserId());
1792 |         res.put("fromNickname", msg.getFromNickname());
1793 |         res.put("chatRoomId", msg.getChatRoomId());
1794 |         res.put("msgType", msg.getMsgType());
1795 |         res.put("filePath", msg.getFilePath());
1796 |         res.put("fileName", msg.getFileName());
1797 |         res.put("content", msg.getContent());
1798 |         res.put("timestamp", msg.getTimestamp());
1799 |         res.put("recalled", msg.isRecalled());
1800 |         res.put("bubbleSkin", msg.getBubbleSkin());
1801 |         res.put("avatarPath", me.getAvatarPath());
1802 |         if (expireAt != null)
1803 |             res.put("expireAt", expireAt);
1804 |         res.put("fileSize", fileSizeBytes);
1805 |         sendJson(ex, 200, res);
1806 |     }

1930 |     private void handleRecallMessage(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
1931 |         if (me == null) {
1932 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
1933 |             return;
1934 |         }
1935 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
1936 |         String messageId = p.get("messageId");
1937 |         Message msg = MessageService.getInstance().getById(messageId);
1938 |         if (msg == null) {
1939 |             sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "false", "error", "消息不存在"));
1940 |             return;
1941 |         }
1942 |         
1943 |         boolean isAdmin = isSuperAdmin(me.getUserId());
1944 |         if (!isAdmin && msg.getChatRoomId().startsWith("group_")) {
1945 |             Group g = GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(msg.getChatRoomId().substring(6));
1946 |             if (g != null && (g.getOwnerId().equals(me.getUserId()) || (g.getAdmins() != null && g.getAdmins().contains(me.getUserId())))) {
1947 |                 isAdmin = true;
1948 |             }
1949 |         } else if (!isAdmin && "public".equals(msg.getChatRoomId())) {
1950 |             PublicRoomConfig pc = PublicRoomService.getInstance().getConfig();
1951 |             if (pc.getAdminIds() != null && pc.getAdminIds().contains(me.getUserId())) {
1952 |                 isAdmin = true;
1953 |             }
1954 |         }
1955 |         
1956 |         String r;
1957 |         if (isAdmin && !msg.getFromUserId().equals(me.getUserId())) {
1958 |             Message deleted = MessageService.getInstance().adminDeleteMessage(messageId, me.getUserId());
1959 |             r = deleted != null ? "ok" : "not_found";
1960 |         } else {
1961 |             r = MessageService.getInstance().recallMessage(messageId, me.getUserId(), isAdmin);
1962 |         }
1963 |         
1964 |         switch (r) {
1965 |             case "ok": {
1966 |                 Message recalled = MessageService.getInstance().getById(messageId);
1967 |                 Map<String, Object> evData = new LinkedHashMap<>();
1968 |                 evData.put("messageId", messageId);
1969 |                 evData.put("room", recalled != null ? recalled.getChatRoomId() : "");
1970 |                 pushEvent("recall", evData);
1971 |                 sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "true"));
1972 |                 break;
1973 |             }
1974 |             case "not_owner":
1975 |                 sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "false", "error", "只能撤回自己的消息"));
1976 |                 break;
1977 |             case "timeout":
1978 |                 sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "false", "error", "超过10分钟无法撤回"));
1979 |                 break;
1980 |             default:
1981 |                 sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "false", "error", "消息不存在"));
1982 |                 break;
1983 |         }
1984 |     }

2120 |     private void handlePostMoment(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
2121 |         if (me == null) {
2122 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
2123 |             return;
2124 |         }
2125 |         Map<String, Object> p = parseJsonObj(body);
2126 |         String content = (String) p.get("content"), vis = (String) p.getOrDefault("visibility", "public");
2127 |         @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
2128 |         List<String> allowed = (List<String>) p.get("allowedViewers");
2129 |         if (content == null || content.trim().isEmpty()) {
2130 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "内容不能为空"));
2131 |             return;
2132 |         }
2133 |         String trimmedContent = content.trim();
2134 |         if (countLines(trimmedContent) > 4000) {
2135 |             byte[] bytes = trimmedContent.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
2136 |             try {
2137 |                 if (!CloudService.getInstance().canStore(me, bytes.length)) {
2138 |                     sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "云盘空间已满，无法存储"));
2139 |                     return;
2140 |                 }
2141 |                 try (ByteArrayInputStream input = new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes)) {
2142 |                     StoredFileMetadata stored = FileStore.getInstance().store(input, "pasted.txt", "text/plain; charset=UTF-8", me.getUserId());
2143 |                     String fileMsgContent = "📋 超长内容已自动保存为文件";
2144 |                     Moment.Attachment att = new Moment.Attachment();
2145 |                     att.setType("file");
2146 |                     att.setFilePath(stored.getAccessPath());
2147 |                     att.setFileName("pasted.txt");
2148 |                     Moment moment = MomentService.getInstance().post(me.getUserId(), me.getNickname(), fileMsgContent, vis, allowed, List.of(att));
2149 |                     sendJson(ex, 200, momentToMap(moment));
2150 |                     return;
2151 |                 }
2152 |             } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
2153 |                 sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", e.getMessage()));
2154 |                 return;
2155 |             } catch (Exception e) {
2156 |                 sendJson(ex, 500, map("error", "保存 pasted.txt 失败: " + e.getMessage()));
2157 |                 return;
2158 |             }
2159 |         }
2160 |         sendJson(ex, 200,
2161 |                 momentToMap(MomentService.getInstance().post(me.getUserId(), me.getNickname(), trimmedContent, vis,
2162 |                         allowed)));
2163 |     }

2419 |     private void handleGroupDeleteOldMessages(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {

2538 |     private void handleCreateGame(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
2539 |         if (me == null) {
2540 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
2541 |             return;
2542 |         }
2543 |         if (!isSuperAdmin(me.getUserId())) {
2544 |             String today = java.time.LocalDate.now(java.time.ZoneId.of("Asia/Shanghai")).toString();
2545 |             if (!today.equals(me.getGameUploadDay())) {
2546 |                 me.setGameUploadDay(today);
2547 |                 me.setDailyGameUploads(0);
2548 |             }
2549 |             int limit = me.getDailyGameUploadLimitByLevel();
2550 |             if (limit != Integer.MAX_VALUE && me.getDailyGameUploads() >= limit) {
2551 |                 sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "今日游戏上传数量已达上限(" + limit + "个)，升级可提升限额"));
2552 |                 return;
2553 |             }
2554 |         }
2555 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
2556 |         String title = p.get("title");
2557 |         String desc = p.getOrDefault("desc", "");
2558 |         String version = p.get("version");
2559 |         String announcement = p.getOrDefault("announcement", "");
2560 |         String filePath = p.get("filePath");
2561 |         if (title == null || title.trim().isEmpty() || version == null || version.trim().isEmpty() || filePath == null) {
2562 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "参数不完整"));
2563 |             return;
2564 |         }
2565 |         StoredFileMetadata metadata = metadataFromPath(filePath);
2566 |         if (metadata == null) {
2567 |             sendJson(ex, 404, map("error", "上传文件不存在"));
2568 |             return;
2569 |         }
2570 |         Map<String, Object> result = GameService.getInstance().createGame(me, title, desc, version, announcement, metadata);
2571 |         if (!isSuperAdmin(me.getUserId())) {
2572 |             me.setDailyGameUploads(me.getDailyGameUploads() + 1);
2573 |             UserService.getInstance().save();
2574 |         }
2575 |         sendJson(ex, 200, result);
2576 |     }

2638 |     private void handleUploadGameAsset(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {

2641 |             return;

2647 |             return;

2649 |         String coverPath = p.get("coverPath");
2650 |         String previewVideoPath = p.get("previewVideoPath");
2651 |         if (coverPath != null && !coverPath.trim().isEmpty()) {

2662 |             }

2675 |             }
2676 |         }
2677 |         try {

3092 |     private void handleCloudEntryMutation(HttpExchange ex, User me, String body, String op) throws IOException {
3093 |         if (me == null) { sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录")); return; }
3094 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
3095 |         String entryId = p.get("entryId");
3096 |         if (entryId == null || entryId.trim().isEmpty()) { sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "缺少条目ID")); return; }
3097 |         try {
3098 |             Object res;
3099 |             switch (op) {
3100 |                 case "rename": res = cloudEntryToMap(CloudService.getInstance().renameEntry(me.getUserId(), entryId, p.get("name"))); break;
3101 |                 case "delete": CloudService.getInstance().deleteEntry(me.getUserId(), entryId); res = map("success", "true"); break;
3102 |                 case "restore": CloudService.getInstance().restoreEntry(me.getUserId(), entryId); res = map("success", "true"); break;
3103 |                 case "purge": CloudService.getInstance().permanentlyDelete(me.getUserId(), entryId); res = map("success", "true"); break;
3104 |                 default: res = cloudEntryToMap(CloudService.getInstance().moveEntry(me.getUserId(), entryId, p.get("parentPath"))); break;
3105 |             }
3106 |             sendJson(ex, 200, res);
3107 |         } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
3108 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", e.getMessage()));
3109 |         }
3110 |     }

3112 |     private void handleImportStoredCloudFile(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
3113 |         if (me == null) { sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录")); return; }
3114 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
3115 |         String filePath = p.get("filePath");
3116 |         StoredFileMetadata metadata = metadataFromPath(filePath);
3117 |         if (metadata == null) { sendJson(ex, 404, map("error", "源文件不存在")); return; }
3118 |         if (!CloudService.getInstance().canStore(me, metadata.getSize())) {
3119 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "云盘空间不足"));
3120 |             return;
3121 |         }
3122 |         String taskId = "cloud_upload_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
3123 |         CloudService.getInstance().upsertTask(me.getUserId(), taskId, "upload", "上传文件到云盘", "running",
3124 |                 metadata.getSize(), 0, 0, "正在写入云盘");
3125 |         try {
3126 |             CloudEntry entry = CloudService.getInstance().storeUserFile(me, metadata, p.get("parentPath"),
3127 |                     p.get("fileName") != null ? p.get("fileName") : metadata.getOriginalFileName(), "cloud");
3128 |             CloudService.getInstance().upsertTask(me.getUserId(), taskId, "upload", "上传文件到云盘", "done",
3129 |                     metadata.getSize(), metadata.getSize(), metadata.getSize(), "上传完成");
3130 |             sendJson(ex, 200, cloudEntryToMap(entry));
3131 |         } catch (Exception e) {
3132 |             CloudService.getInstance().upsertTask(me.getUserId(), taskId, "upload", "上传文件到云盘", "failed",
3133 |                     metadata.getSize(), 0, 0, e.getMessage());
3134 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", e.getMessage()));
3135 |         }

3373 |     private void handleSearch(HttpExchange ex, String query, User me) throws IOException {
3374 |         if (me == null) { sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录")); return; }
3375 |         Map<String, String> q = parseQuery(query);
3376 |         String keyword = q.getOrDefault("q", "").trim();
3377 |         String scope = q.getOrDefault("scope", "all"); // users|groups|messages|sent|all
3378 |         String room = q.getOrDefault("room", "");       // 可选：按聊天室筛选
3379 |         if (keyword.isEmpty()) { sendJson(ex, 200, map("users", "[]", "groups", "[]", "messages", "[]")); return; }
3380 |         Map<String, Object> result = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
3381 |         if ("all".equals(scope) || "users".equals(scope)) {
3382 |             List<Map<String, Object>> users = new ArrayList<>();
3383 |             for (User u : UserService.getInstance().getAllUsers()) {
3384 |                 if ((u.getNickname() != null && u.getNickname().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase()))
3385 |                         || (u.getUserId() != null && u.getUserId().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase()))) {
3386 |                     Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
3387 |                     m.put("userId", u.getUserId());
3388 |                     m.put("nickname", u.getNickname());
3389 |                     m.put("avatarPath", u.getAvatarPath());
3390 |                     m.put("levelDisplay", u.getLevelDisplay());
3391 |                     users.add(m);
3392 |                 }
3393 |                 if (users.size() >= 20) break;
3394 |             }
3395 |             result.put("users", users);
3396 |         }
3397 |         if ("all".equals(scope) || "groups".equals(scope)) {
3398 |             List<Map<String, Object>> groups = new ArrayList<>();
3399 |             for (com.chat.model.Group g : GroupService.getInstance().getAllGroups()) {
3400 |                 if ((g.getGroupName() != null && g.getGroupName().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase()))
3401 |                         || (g.getGroupId() != null && g.getGroupId().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase()))) {
3402 |                     Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
3403 |                     m.put("groupId", g.getGroupId());
3404 |                     m.put("groupName", g.getGroupName());
3405 |                     m.put("memberCount", g.getMembers() != null ? g.getMembers().size() : 0);
3406 |                     groups.add(m);
3407 |                 }
3408 |                 if (groups.size() >= 20) break;
3409 |             }
3410 |             result.put("groups", groups);
3411 |         }
3412 |         if ("all".equals(scope) || "messages".equals(scope) || "sent".equals(scope)) {
3413 |             List<Map<String, Object>> msgs = new ArrayList<>();
3414 |             for (com.chat.model.Message msg : MessageService.getInstance().searchMessages(keyword, 30)) {
3415 |                 if (!msg.isRecalled() && msg.getContent() != null) {
3416 |                     // "sent" 范围仅搜索自己发送的消息
3417 |                     if ("sent".equals(scope) && !msg.getFromUserId().equals(me.getUserId())) continue;
3418 |                     // 按聊天室筛选
3419 |                     if (!room.isEmpty() && !room.equals(msg.getChatRoomId())) continue;
3420 |                     boolean canSee = "public".equals(msg.getChatRoomId())
3421 |                             || msg.getFromUserId().equals(me.getUserId())
3422 |                             || (msg.getChatRoomId() != null && msg.getChatRoomId().startsWith("dm_") && msg.getChatRoomId().contains(me.getUserId()))
3423 |                             || (msg.getChatRoomId() != null && msg.getChatRoomId().startsWith("group_") && GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(msg.getChatRoomId().substring(6)) != null && GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(msg.getChatRoomId().substring(6)).isMember(me.getUserId()));
3424 |                     if (canSee) {
3425 |                         Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
3426 |                         m.put("id", msg.getId());
3427 |                         m.put("content", msg.getContent().length() > 100 ? msg.getContent().substring(0, 100) + "..." : msg.getContent());
3428 |                         m.put("chatRoomId", msg.getChatRoomId());
3429 |                         m.put("fromNickname", msg.getFromNickname());
3430 |                         m.put("fromUserId", msg.getFromUserId());
3431 |                         m.put("timestamp", msg.getTimestamp());
3432 |                         m.put("msgType", msg.getMsgType());
3433 |                         msgs.add(m);
3434 |                     }
3435 |                 }
3436 |                 if (msgs.size() >= 20) break;
3437 |             }
3438 |             result.put("messages", msgs);
3439 |         }
3440 |         if ("all".equals(scope) || "ai".equals(scope)) {
3441 |             List<Map<String, Object>> aiConvs = new ArrayList<>();
3442 |             for (com.chat.model.AiConversation c : AiService.getInstance().listConversations(me.getUserId())) {
3443 |                 if (c.getTitle() != null && c.getTitle().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase())) {
3444 |                     Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
3445 |                     m.put("id", c.getId());
3446 |                     m.put("title", c.getTitle());
3447 |                     m.put("type", c.getType());
3448 |                     m.put("modelId", c.getModelId());
3449 |                     m.put("updatedAt", c.getUpdatedAt());
3450 |                     aiConvs.add(m);
3451 |                 }
3452 |                 if (aiConvs.size() >= 20) break;
3453 |             }
3454 |             result.put("aiConversations", aiConvs);
3455 |         }
3456 |         sendJson(ex, 200, result);
3457 |     }

3515 |     private void handleSendAiPromptStream(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
3516 |         if (me == null) { sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录")); return; }
3517 |         if (me.isFeatureBanned("ai")) { sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "AI功能已被封禁")); return; }
3518 |         ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", "application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8");
3519 |         ex.sendResponseHeaders(200, 0);
3520 |         try (OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {
3521 |             try {
3522 |             Map<String, Object> payload = parseJsonObj(body);
3523 |             String conversationId = asString(payload.get("conversationId"));
3524 |             String prompt = asString(payload.get("prompt"));
3525 |             if (conversationId.isEmpty() || prompt.isEmpty()) {
3526 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException("参数不完整");
3527 |             }
3528 |             AiConversation conversation = AiService.getInstance().getConversation(me.getUserId(), conversationId);
3529 |             if (conversation == null) {
3530 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException("会话不存在");
3531 |             }
3532 |             if (!"chat".equals(conversation.getType())) {
3533 |                 Map<String, Object> result = processAiPrompt(payload, me);
3534 |                 writeJsonLine(os, obj(
3535 |                         "type", "done",
3536 |                         "message", result.get("message"),
3537 |                         "task", result.get("task"),
3538 |                         "remainingTokens", result.get("remainingTokens")
3539 |                 ));
3540 |                 return;
3541 |             }
3542 |             String modelId = asString(payload.get("modelId"));
3543 |             if (modelId.isEmpty()) modelId = conversation.getModelId();
3544 |             final String resolvedModelId = modelId;
3545 |             List<Map<String, Object>> attachments = asObjectList(payload.get("attachments"));
3546 |             AiService.getInstance().addMessage(conversationId, "user", "text", prompt, null, resolvedModelId, 0, 0, 0);
3547 |             for (Map<String, Object> attachment : attachments) {
3548 |                 String filePath = asString(attachment.get("filePath"));
3549 |                 if (filePath.isEmpty()) continue;
3550 |                 String type = asString(attachment.get("type"));
3551 |                 String content = asString(attachment.get("name"));
3552 |                 AiService.getInstance().addMessage(conversationId, "user",
3553 |                         type.startsWith("image") ? "image" : "file",
3554 |                         content.isEmpty() ? "附件" : content, filePath, resolvedModelId, 0, 0, 0);
3555 |             }
3556 |             List<AiMessage> history = AiService.getInstance().listMessages(conversationId);
3557 |             history = stripCurrentAiPrompt(history, attachments.size());
3558 |             List<AiMessage> contextMessages = pickAiContextMessages(history, conversation);
3559 |             Map<String, Object> model = AiService.getInstance().listModels().stream()
3560 |                     .filter(item -> Objects.equals(String.valueOf(item.get("id")), resolvedModelId))
3561 |                     .findFirst().orElse(null);
3562 |             int promptTokens = estimateConversationTokens(conversation, contextMessages)
3563 |                     + attachments.stream().mapToInt(item -> 256).sum();
3564 |             int completionTokens = Math.max(8, Math.min(512, promptTokens / 2 + 24));
3565 |             double weightedTokens = buildWeightedTokens(model, promptTokens, completionTokens);
3566 |             double ar = AiService.getInstance().getRemainingTokens(me);
3567 |             if (ar < weightedTokens) {
3568 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException("今日 AI 额度已用尽");
3569 |             }
3570 |             if (weightedTokens > ar * 0.6) {
3571 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException("预估 token 消耗超过剩余额度 60%，已取消生成");
3572 |             }
3573 |             Map<String, Object> streamed = streamChatCompletion(os, resolvedModelId, conversation, prompt, attachments, contextMessages);
3574 |             String content = asString(streamed.get("content"));
3575 |             String reasoningContent = asString(streamed.get("reasoningContent"));
3576 |             Map<String, Object> usage = asObjectMap(streamed.get("usage"));
3577 |             promptTokens = parseInt(asString(usage.get("prompt_tokens")), promptTokens);
3578 |             completionTokens = parseInt(asString(usage.get("completion_tokens")), Math.max(16, estimateTokens(content)));
3579 |             weightedTokens = buildWeightedTokens(model, promptTokens, completionTokens);
3580 |             AiService.getInstance().addUsage(me, resolvedModelId, "chat", promptTokens, completionTokens, weightedTokens);
3581 |             AiMessage message = AiService.getInstance().addMessage(conversationId, "assistant", "text",
3582 |                     content, reasoningContent.isEmpty() ? null : reasoningContent, null, resolvedModelId, promptTokens, completionTokens, weightedTokens);
3583 |             if ("新标签".equals(conversation.getTitle())) {
3584 |                 conversation.setTitle(generateAiConversationTitle(prompt, content));
3585 |             }
3586 |             conversation.setModelId(resolvedModelId);
3587 |             AiService.getInstance().updateConversation(conversation);
3588 |             Map<String, Object> doneMsg = new LinkedHashMap<>();
3589 |             doneMsg.put("id", message.getId());
3590 |             doneMsg.put("content", message.getContent());
3591 |             doneMsg.put("reasoningContent", message.getReasoningContent());
3592 |             doneMsg.put("createdAt", message.getCreatedAt());
3593 |             doneMsg.put("weightedTokens", message.getWeightedTokens());
3594 |             writeJsonLine(os, obj(
3595 |                     "type", "done",
3596 |                     "message", doneMsg,
3597 |                     "remainingTokens", AiService.getInstance().getRemainingTokens(me) == Double.MAX_VALUE
3598 |                             ? -1
3599 |                             : AiService.getInstance().getRemainingTokens(me)
3600 |             ));
3601 |             } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
3602 |                 writeJsonLine(os, obj("type", "error", "error", e.getMessage()));
3603 |             }
3604 |         }
3605 |     }

3615 |             case "note": {

3617 |                 if (note == null) { sendJson(ex, 404, map("error", "分享不存在")); return; }

3621 |                 res.put("content", note.getContent());
3622 |                 res.put("updatedAt", note.getUpdatedAt());
3623 |                 break;
3624 |             }
3625 |             case "cloud": {
3626 |                 CloudShareLink share = CloudService.getInstance().getShare(id);
3627 |                 if (share == null) { sendJson(ex, 404, map("error", "分享不存在")); return; }
3628 |                 CloudEntry entry = CloudService.getInstance().getEntry(share.getEntryId());
3629 |                 User owner = UserService.getInstance().getByUserId(share.getOwnerId());
3630 |                 res.put("share", cloudShareToMap(share));
3631 |                 res.put("entry", cloudEntryToMap(entry));

3633 |                 break;
3634 |             }

3794 |     private void handleAddSuperAdmin(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
3795 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
3796 |         String targetUserId = p.get("targetUserId");
3797 |         String role = p.getOrDefault("role", "admin"); // "coowner" or "admin"
3798 |         
3799 |         boolean iAmPrimary = isPrimarySuperAdmin(me.getUserId());
3800 |         boolean iAmCoOwner = superAdminService.isCoOwner(me.getUserId());
3801 |         
3802 |         if (!iAmPrimary && !iAmCoOwner) {
3803 |             sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "无权限添加管理员"));
3804 |             return;
3805 |         }
3806 |         
3807 |         if ("coowner".equals(role) && !iAmPrimary) {
3808 |             sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "仅服主可添加副服主"));
3809 |             return;
3810 |         }
3811 | 
3812 |         if (targetUserId == null || targetUserId.trim().isEmpty()) {
3813 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "请输入用户ID"));
3814 |             return;
3815 |         }
3816 |         if (UserService.getInstance().getByUserId(targetUserId) == null) {
3817 |             sendJson(ex, 404, map("error", "用户不存在"));
3818 |             return;
3819 |         }
3820 |         
3821 |         boolean ok = false;
3822 |         if ("coowner".equals(role)) {
3823 |             ok = superAdminService.addCoOwner(targetUserId.trim());
3824 |         } else {
3825 |             ok = superAdminService.addSuperAdmin(targetUserId.trim());
3826 |         }
3827 |         
3828 |         if (ok) UserService.getInstance().ensurePrimarySuperAdminLevel();
3829 |         sendJson(ex, ok ? 200 : 400, ok ? map("success", "true") : map("error", "该用户已是目标身份"));
3830 |     }

4174 |     private void handleDecodeQR(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
4175 |         if (me == null) {
4176 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
4177 |             return;
4178 |         }
4179 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
4180 |         String imageData = p.get("image");
4181 |         if (imageData == null || imageData.trim().isEmpty()) {
4182 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "请提供图片数据"));
4183 |             return;
4184 |         }
4185 |         try {
4186 |             if (imageData.contains(",")) {
4187 |                 imageData = imageData.substring(imageData.indexOf(",") + 1);
4188 |             }
4189 |             byte[] imgBytes = Base64.getDecoder().decode(imageData);
4190 |             ByteArrayInputStream bais = new ByteArrayInputStream(imgBytes);
4191 |             BufferedImage img = ImageIO.read(bais);
4192 |             if (img == null) {
4193 |                 sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "无法解析图片"));
4194 |                 return;
4195 |             }
4196 |             LuminanceSource source = new BufferedImageLuminanceSource(img);
4197 |             BinaryBitmap bitmap = new BinaryBitmap(new HybridBinarizer(source));
4198 |             Result result = new MultiFormatReader().decode(bitmap);
4199 |             sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "true", "text", result.getText()));
4200 |         } catch (NotFoundException e) {
4201 |             sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "false", "error", "未识别到二维码"));
4202 |         } catch (Exception e) {
4203 |             sendJson(ex, 500, map("error", "解码失败: " + e.getMessage()));
4204 |         }
4205 |     }

4310 |     private int estimateTokens(String text) {
4311 |         return Math.max(1, (String.valueOf(text).length() + 3) / 4);
4312 |     }

4314 |     private double buildWeightedTokens(Map<String, Object> model, int promptTokens, int completionTokens) {
4315 |         double in = parseDouble(String.valueOf(model != null ? model.get("inputRatio") : 1), 1);
4316 |         double out = parseDouble(String.valueOf(model != null ? model.get("outputRatio") : 1), 1);
4317 |         return promptTokens * in + completionTokens * out;
4318 |     }
4319 | 
4320 |     private double estimateVideoWeightedTokens(Map<String, Object> model, double durationSec) {
4321 |         double out = parseDouble(String.valueOf(model != null ? model.get("outputRatio") : 8), 8);
4322 |         return Math.max(2, durationSec) * out * 1000D;
4323 |     }

4461 |     private List<AiMessage> stripCurrentAiPrompt(List<AiMessage> history, int attachmentCount) {
4462 |         if (history == null || history.isEmpty()) return Collections.emptyList();
4463 |         int trim = Math.max(1, 1 + Math.max(0, attachmentCount));
4464 |         if (history.size() <= trim) return Collections.emptyList();
4465 |         return new ArrayList<>(history.subList(0, history.size() - trim));
4466 |     }
4467 | 
4468 |     private List<AiMessage> pickAiContextMessages(List<AiMessage> history, AiConversation conversation) {
4469 |         int maxItems = Math.max(1, conversation != null ? conversation.getContextCount() : 10);
4470 |         int tokenBudget = 4000;
4471 |         List<AiMessage> reversed = new ArrayList<>(history == null ? Collections.emptyList() : history);
4472 |         Collections.reverse(reversed);
4473 |         List<AiMessage> selected = new ArrayList<>();
4474 |         int used = estimateTokens(conversation != null ? conversation.getSystemPrompt() : "");
4475 |         for (AiMessage message : reversed) {
4476 |             int cost = estimateTokens(message.getContent()) + ("image".equals(message.getType()) ? 256 : 0);
4477 |             if (!selected.isEmpty() && (selected.size() >= maxItems || used + cost > tokenBudget)) {
4478 |                 continue;
4479 |             }
4480 |             selected.add(message);
4481 |             used += cost;
4482 |         }
4483 |         Collections.reverse(selected);
4484 |         return selected;
4485 |     }
4486 | 
4487 |     private int estimateConversationTokens(AiConversation conversation, List<AiMessage> messages) {
4488 |         int tokens = estimateTokens(conversation != null ? conversation.getSystemPrompt() : "");
4489 |         for (AiMessage message : messages) {
4490 |             tokens += estimateTokens(message.getContent());
4491 |             if ("image".equals(message.getType())) tokens += 256;
4492 |         }
4493 |         return Math.max(tokens, 1);
4494 |     }
4495 | 
4496 |     private List<String> splitAiContent(String text, int chunkSize) {
4497 |         List<String> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
4498 |         String value = String.valueOf(text == null ? "" : text);
4499 |         if (value.isEmpty()) {
4500 |             chunks.add("");
4501 |             return chunks;
4502 |         }
4503 |         for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i += Math.max(1, chunkSize)) {
4504 |             chunks.add(value.substring(i, Math.min(value.length(), i + Math.max(1, chunkSize))));
4505 |         }
4506 |         return chunks;
4507 |     }

4509 |     private double estimateImageWeightedTokens(String modelId, String size, int imageCount) {
4510 |         if (modelId.contains("3-0")) return 80000D * imageCount;
4511 |         if (modelId.contains("4-0")) return 60000D * imageCount;
4512 |         if (modelId.contains("4-5")) return 80000D * imageCount;
4513 |         if (modelId.contains("5-0")) return 74000D * imageCount;
4514 |         return 80000D * imageCount;
4515 |     }

4517 |     private Map<String, Object> generateChatCompletion(String modelId, AiConversation conversation, String prompt,
4518 |                                                        List<Map<String, Object>> attachments, List<AiMessage> contextMessages) {
4519 |         try {
4520 |             if (modelId.startsWith("LongCat")) {
4521 |                 return requestLongcatChat(modelId, conversation, prompt, contextMessages);
4522 |             }
4523 |             return requestVolcChat(modelId, conversation, prompt, attachments, contextMessages);
4524 |         } catch (Exception e) {
4525 |             Map<String, Object> fallback = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4526 |             fallback.put("content", buildFallbackAiReply(prompt, conversation, attachments, contextMessages));
4527 |             fallback.put("usage", obj(
4528 |                     "prompt_tokens", estimateConversationTokens(conversation, contextMessages),
4529 |                     "completion_tokens", Math.max(16, estimateTokens(prompt) / 2)
4530 |             ));
4531 |             return fallback;
4532 |         }
