4535 |     private Map<String, Object> streamChatCompletion(OutputStream os, String modelId, AiConversation conversation,
4536 |                                                      String prompt, List<Map<String, Object>> attachments,
4537 |                                                      List<AiMessage> contextMessages) {
4538 |         try {
4539 |             String apiUrl = modelId.startsWith("LongCat") ? LONGCAT_API_URL : VOLC_CHAT_API_URL;
4540 |             String apiKey = modelId.startsWith("LongCat") ? LONGCAT_API_KEY : VOLC_API_KEY;
4541 |             Map<String, Object> body = modelId.startsWith("LongCat")
4542 |                     ? buildLongcatChatBody(modelId, conversation, prompt, contextMessages, true)
4543 |                     : buildVolcChatBody(modelId, conversation, prompt, attachments, contextMessages, true);
4544 |             java.net.http.HttpRequest request = java.net.http.HttpRequest.newBuilder(java.net.URI.create(apiUrl))
4545 |                     .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + apiKey)
4546 |                     .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
4547 |                     .POST(java.net.http.HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(JsonUtil.toJson(body), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
4548 |                     .build();
4549 |             java.net.http.HttpResponse<InputStream> response = java.net.http.HttpClient.newHttpClient()
4550 |                     .send(request, java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofInputStream());
4551 |             if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
4552 |                 String errorBody = new String(response.body().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
4553 |                 Map<String, Object> errorData = parseJsonObj(errorBody);
4554 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException(asString(asObjectMap(errorData.get("error")).get("message")).isEmpty()
4555 |                         ? asString(errorData.get("message"))
4556 |                         : asString(asObjectMap(errorData.get("error")).get("message")));
4557 |             }
4558 |             StringBuilder content = new StringBuilder();
4559 |             StringBuilder reasoningContent = new StringBuilder();
4560 |             Map<String, Object> usage = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4561 |             try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(response.body(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
4562 |                 String line;
4563 |                 while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
4564 |                     String trimmed = line.trim();
4565 |                     if (!trimmed.startsWith("data:")) continue;
4566 |                     String data = trimmed.substring(5).trim();
4567 |                     if (data.isEmpty() || "[DONE]".equals(data)) continue;
4568 |                     Map<String, Object> event = parseJsonObj(data);
4569 |                     if (!asObjectMap(event.get("usage")).isEmpty()) {
4570 |                         usage = asObjectMap(event.get("usage"));
4571 |                     }
4572 |                     List<Map<String, Object>> choices = asObjectList(event.get("choices"));
4573 |                     if (choices.isEmpty()) continue;
4574 |                     Map<String, Object> delta = asObjectMap(choices.get(0).get("delta"));
4575 |                     String reasoningChunk = asString(delta.get("reasoning_content"));
4576 |                     if (!reasoningChunk.isEmpty()) {
4577 |                         reasoningContent.append(reasoningChunk);
4578 |                         writeJsonLine(os, obj("type", "delta", "reasoning_content", reasoningChunk));
4579 |                     }
4580 |                     String chunk = asString(delta.get("content"));
4581 |                     if (!chunk.isEmpty()) {
4582 |                         for (String piece : splitAiContent(chunk, chunk.length() > 24 ? 2 : 1)) {
4583 |                             content.append(piece);
4584 |                             writeJsonLine(os, obj("type", "delta", "content", piece));
4585 |                         }
4586 |                     }
4587 |                 }
4588 |             }
4589 |             if (usage.isEmpty()) {
4590 |                 usage.put("prompt_tokens", estimateConversationTokens(conversation, contextMessages)
4591 |                         + attachments.stream().mapToInt(item -> 256).sum());
4592 |                 usage.put("completion_tokens", Math.max(16, estimateTokens(content.toString())));
4593 |             }
4594 |             Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4595 |             result.put("content", content.toString());
4596 |             result.put("reasoningContent", reasoningContent.toString());
4597 |             result.put("usage", usage);
4598 |             return result;
4599 |         } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
4600 |             throw e;
4601 |         } catch (Exception e) {
4602 |             Map<String, Object> fallback = generateChatCompletion(modelId, conversation, prompt, attachments, contextMessages);
4603 |             for (String chunk : splitAiContent(asString(fallback.get("content")), 48)) {
4604 |                 try {
4605 |                     writeJsonLine(os, obj("type", "delta", "content", chunk));
4606 |                 } catch (IOException ignored) {
4607 |                 }
4608 |             }
4609 |             return fallback;
4610 |         }
4611 |     }

4643 |     private Map<String, Object> buildLongcatChatBody(String modelId, AiConversation conversation, String prompt,
4644 |                                                      List<AiMessage> contextMessages, boolean stream) {
4645 |         List<Map<String, Object>> messages = new ArrayList<>();
4646 |         if (conversation != null && conversation.getSystemPrompt() != null && !conversation.getSystemPrompt().trim().isEmpty()) {
4647 |             messages.add(obj("role", "system", "content", conversation.getSystemPrompt().trim()));
4648 |         }
4649 |         for (AiMessage item : contextMessages) {
4650 |             if (!"text".equals(item.getType())) continue;
4651 |             String msgContent = item.getContent();
4652 |             if (msgContent == null || msgContent.trim().isEmpty()) continue;
4653 |             messages.add(obj("role", item.getRole(), "content", msgContent));
4654 |         }
4655 |         messages.add(obj("role", "user", "content", prompt));
4656 |         Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4657 |         body.put("model", modelId);
4658 |         body.put("messages", messages);
4659 |         body.put("stream", stream);
4660 |         if (conversation != null && conversation.getMaxTokens() > 0) body.put("max_tokens", conversation.getMaxTokens());
4661 |         if (conversation != null) {
4662 |             body.put("temperature", conversation.getTemperature());
4663 |             body.put("top_p", conversation.getTopP());
4664 |         }
4665 |         return body;
4666 |     }

4668 |     private Map<String, Object> buildVolcChatBody(String modelId, AiConversation conversation, String prompt,
4669 |                                                   List<Map<String, Object>> attachments, List<AiMessage> contextMessages,
4670 |                                                   boolean stream) {
4671 |         // 检查模型是否支持图片（纯文本模型如DeepSeek/GLM需要content为string格式）
4672 |         Map<String, Object> modelInfo = AiService.getInstance().listModels().stream()
4673 |                 .filter(m -> Objects.equals(String.valueOf(m.get("id")), modelId))
4674 |                 .findFirst().orElse(null);
4675 |         boolean supportsImage = modelInfo != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(modelInfo.get("supportsImage"));
4676 | 
4677 |         List<Map<String, Object>> messages = new ArrayList<>();
4678 |         if (conversation != null && conversation.getSystemPrompt() != null && !conversation.getSystemPrompt().trim().isEmpty()) {
4679 |             messages.add(obj("role", "system", "content", conversation.getSystemPrompt().trim()));
4680 |         }
4681 |         for (AiMessage item : contextMessages) {
4682 |             if ("assistant".equals(item.getRole()) && "text".equals(item.getType())) {
4683 |                 String msgContent = item.getContent();
4684 |                 if (msgContent == null || msgContent.trim().isEmpty()) continue;
4685 |                 messages.add(obj("role", "assistant", "content", msgContent));
4686 |             } else if ("user".equals(item.getRole())) {
4687 |                 if (!supportsImage) {
4688 |                     // 纯文本模型：content 使用字符串格式
4689 |                     String text = "";
4690 |                     if (item.getContent() != null && !item.getContent().trim().isEmpty()) {
4691 |                         text = item.getContent();
4692 |                     }
4693 |                     if (!text.isEmpty()) {
4694 |                         messages.add(obj("role", "user", "content", text));
4695 |                     }
4696 |                 } else {
4697 |                     // 多模态模型：content 使用数组格式
4698 |                     List<Map<String, Object>> content = new ArrayList<>();
4699 |                     if ("image".equals(item.getType()) && item.getFilePath() != null) {
4700 |                         content.add(obj("type", "image_url",
4701 |                                 "image_url", obj("url", absoluteUrl(item.getFilePath()), "detail", "high")));
4702 |                         if (item.getContent() != null && !item.getContent().trim().isEmpty()) {
4703 |                             content.add(obj("type", "text", "text", item.getContent()));
4704 |                         }
4705 |                     } else if (item.getContent() != null && !item.getContent().trim().isEmpty()) {
4706 |                         content.add(obj("type", "text", "text", item.getContent()));
4707 |                     }
4708 |                     if (!content.isEmpty()) {
4709 |                         messages.add(obj("role", "user", "content", content));
4710 |                     }
4711 |                 }
4712 |             }
4713 |         }
4714 | 
4715 |         if (!supportsImage && (attachments == null || attachments.isEmpty())) {
4716 |             // 纯文本模型：当前 prompt 直接使用字符串
4717 |             if (prompt != null && !prompt.trim().isEmpty()) {
4718 |                 messages.add(obj("role", "user", "content", prompt));
4719 |             }
4720 |         } else {
4721 |             // 多模态模型或有附件：使用数组格式
4722 |             List<Map<String, Object>> userContent = new ArrayList<>();
4723 |             if (attachments != null) {
4724 |                 for (Map<String, Object> attachment : attachments) {
4725 |                     String filePath = asString(attachment.get("filePath"));
4726 |                     if (filePath.isEmpty()) continue;
4727 |                     if (supportsImage) {
4728 |                         userContent.add(obj("type", "image_url",
4729 |                                 "image_url", obj("url", absoluteUrl(filePath), "detail", "high")));
4730 |                     }
4731 |                 }
4732 |             }
4733 |             if (prompt != null && !prompt.trim().isEmpty()) {
4734 |                 userContent.add(obj("type", "text", "text", prompt));
4735 |             }
4736 |             if (!userContent.isEmpty()) {
4737 |                 messages.add(obj("role", "user", "content", userContent));
4738 |             }
4739 |         }
4740 | 
4741 |         Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4742 |         body.put("model", modelId);
4743 |         body.put("messages", messages);
4744 |         body.put("stream", stream);
4745 |         Map<String, Object> streamOpts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4746 |         streamOpts.put("include_usage", true);
4747 |         body.put("stream_options", streamOpts);
4748 | 
4749 |         // 纯文本模型(DeepSeek)使用 max_tokens，多模态模型使用 max_completion_tokens
4750 |         if (conversation != null && conversation.getMaxTokens() > 0) {
4751 |             if (!supportsImage && (modelId.startsWith("deepseek") || modelId.startsWith("glm"))) {
4752 |                 body.put("max_tokens", conversation.getMaxTokens());
4753 |             } else {
4754 |                 body.put("max_completion_tokens", conversation.getMaxTokens());
4755 |             }
4756 |         }
4757 | 
4758 |         // 推理深度
4759 |         boolean supportsThinking = modelInfo != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(modelInfo.get("supportsThinking"));
4760 |         if (supportsThinking && conversation != null && conversation.getReasoningDepth() != null && !"default".equals(conversation.getReasoningDepth())) {
4761 |             if (modelId.startsWith("glm-")) {
4762 |                 Map<String, Object> thinking = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4763 |                 if ("minimal".equals(conversation.getReasoningDepth())) {
4764 |                     thinking.put("type", "disabled");
4765 |                 } else {
4766 |                     thinking.put("type", "enabled");
4767 |                 }
4768 |                 body.put("thinking", thinking);
4769 |             } else if (!modelId.startsWith("deepseek-r1")) {
4770 |                 // DeepSeek-R1 使用自有机制，不发送 reasoning_effort
4771 |                 body.put("reasoning_effort", conversation.getReasoningDepth());
4772 |             }
4773 |         }
4774 |         return body;
4775 |     }

4808 |                     }
4809 |                 } catch (Exception dlErr) {
4810 |                     System.err.println("[AI] 图片下载到本地失败: " + dlErr.getMessage());
4811 |                 }
4812 |             }
4813 |             Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4814 |             result.put("url", url);
4815 |             result.put("usage", asObjectMap(resp.get("usage")));
4816 |             return result;
4817 |         } catch (Exception e) {
4818 |             throw new IOException(e.getMessage(), e);
4819 |         }
4820 |     }

4891 |     private void refreshAiProviderTasks(String userId) {
4892 |         for (AiMediaTask task : AiService.getInstance().listTasks(userId)) {
4893 |             if (!"video".equals(task.getTaskType()) || task.getProviderTaskId() == null || task.getProviderTaskId().trim().isEmpty()) continue;
4894 |             if ("done".equals(task.getStatus()) || "succeeded".equals(task.getStatus())
4895 |                     || "failed".equals(task.getStatus()) || "cancelled".equals(task.getStatus())
4896 |                     || "expired".equals(task.getStatus())) continue;
4897 |             try {
4898 |                 Map<String, Object> remote = getJson(VOLC_VIDEO_TASK_API_URL + "/" + URLEncoder.encode(task.getProviderTaskId(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8), VOLC_API_KEY);
4899 |                 String status = asString(remote.get("status"));
4900 |                 if (!status.isEmpty()) task.setStatus(status);
4901 |                 Map<String, Object> usage = asObjectMap(remote.get("usage"));
4902 |                 double oldFinalTokens = task.getFinalTokens();
4903 |                 double newFinalTokens = !usage.isEmpty()
4904 |                         ? parseDouble(asString(usage.get("total_tokens")), oldFinalTokens)
4905 |                         : oldFinalTokens;
4906 |                 task.setFinalTokens(newFinalTokens);
4907 |                 Map<String, Object> output = asObjectMap(remote.get("content"));
4908 |                 if (output.isEmpty()) output = asObjectMap(remote.get("output"));
4909 |                 String videoUrl = asString(output.get("video_url"));
4910 |                 if (videoUrl.isEmpty()) videoUrl = asString(output.get("url"));
4911 |                 if (!videoUrl.isEmpty()) task.setOutputPath(videoUrl);
4912 |                 if (Math.abs(newFinalTokens - oldFinalTokens) > 0.0001D) {
4913 |                     User taskOwner = UserService.getInstance().getByUserId(userId);
4914 |                     if (taskOwner != null) {
4915 |                         AiService.getInstance().addUsage(taskOwner, task.getModelId(), "video-finalize", 0, 0, newFinalTokens - oldFinalTokens);
4916 |                     }
4917 |                 }
4918 |                 if (("succeeded".equals(task.getStatus()) || "done".equals(task.getStatus()))
4919 |                         && task.getOutputPath() != null && !task.getOutputPath().trim().isEmpty()) {
4920 |                     // Auto-download generated video to local storage (7-day expiry workaround)
4921 |                     String op = task.getOutputPath();
4922 |                     if (op.startsWith("http") && !op.contains("/files/")) {
4923 |                         try {
4924 |                             java.net.http.HttpRequest dlReq = java.net.http.HttpRequest.newBuilder()
4925 |                                     .uri(java.net.URI.create(op)).GET().build();
4926 |                             java.net.http.HttpResponse<java.io.InputStream> dlResp = java.net.http.HttpClient.newHttpClient()
4927 |                                     .send(dlReq, java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofInputStream());
4928 |                             if (dlResp.statusCode() >= 200 && dlResp.statusCode() < 300) {
4929 |                                 StoredFileMetadata meta = FileStore.getInstance().store(
4930 |                                         dlResp.body(), "video_" + task.getId() + ".mp4", "video/mp4", userId);
4931 |                                 task.setOutputPath("/files/" + meta.getStoredName());
4932 |                             }
4933 |                         } catch (Exception ignored) {}
4934 |                     }
4935 |                     List<AiMessage> existing = AiService.getInstance().listMessages(task.getConversationId());
4936 |                     boolean hasVideoMessage = existing.stream().anyMatch(item ->
4937 |                             "assistant".equals(item.getRole())
4938 |                                     && "video".equals(item.getType())
4939 |                                     && Objects.equals(item.getFilePath(), task.getOutputPath()));
4940 |                     if (!hasVideoMessage) {
4941 |                         AiService.getInstance().addMessage(task.getConversationId(), "assistant", "video",
4942 |                                 "视频生成完成", task.getOutputPath(), task.getModelId(), 0, 1, task.getFinalTokens());
4943 |                     }
4944 |                 }
4945 |                 AiService.getInstance().updateTask(task);
4946 |             } catch (Exception ignored) {
4947 |             }
4948 |         }
4949 |     }

4951 |     private String absoluteUrl(String filePath) {
4952 |         String path = asString(filePath);
4953 |         if (path.startsWith("http://") || path.startsWith("https://") || path.startsWith("data:")) return path;

4985 |         try {
4986 |             java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService executor = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
4987 |             java.util.concurrent.Future<String> future = executor.submit(() -> {
4988 |                 Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();

4990 |                 List<Map<String, Object>> msgs = new ArrayList<>();
4991 |                 msgs.add(obj("role", "system", "content", "你是一个标题生成助手。根据对话内容（用户问题和AI回答），生成一个简短的中文会话标题（不超过8个字）。只返回标题本身，不要解释，不要标点。"));

5002 |                     String title = asString(asObjectMap(choices.get(0).get("message")).get("content")).trim();
5003 |                     if (!title.isEmpty()) return title;
5004 |                 }
5005 |                 return null;
5006 |             });
5007 |             String title = future.get(3, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS);
5008 |             executor.shutdownNow();
5009 |             if (title != null && !title.isEmpty() && !"null".equals(title)) {
5010 |                 return title.length() > 18 ? title.substring(0, 18) + "..." : title;
5011 |             }

5014 |         }

5259 |         if (s >= 60)

5261 |         return s + "秒";

5583 |     private String loginAnnouncementScript() {
5584 |         return "let loginAnnouncementItems=[];let loginAnnouncementActiveId='';"
5585 |                 + "function loginAnnEsc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/[&<>\\\"']/g,m=>({\"&\":\"&amp;\",\"<\":\"&lt;\",\">\":\"&gt;\",\"\\\"\":\"&quot;\",\"'\":\"&#39;\"}[m]||m));}"
5586 |                 + "function loginAnnFmt(v){if(!v)return'-';try{return new Date(v).toLocaleString('zh-CN');}catch(e){return'-';}}"
5587 |                 + "function loginAnnMd(text){let html=loginAnnEsc(text||'');html=html.replace(/```(\\w*)\\n([\\s\\S]*?)```/g,(_,lang,code)=>'<pre><code>'+code+'</code></pre>');html=html.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,'<code>$1</code>');html=html.replace(/^### (.+)$/gm,'<h4>$1</h4>');html=html.replace(/^## (.+)$/gm,'<h3>$1</h3>');html=html.replace(/^# (.+)$/gm,'<h2>$1</h2>');html=html.replace(/\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>');html=html.replace(/\\*(.+?)\\*/g,'<em>$1</em>');html=html.replace(/^[-*] (.+)$/gm,'<li>$1</li>');html=html.replace(/(<li>[\\s\\S]*?<\\/li>)/g,'<ul>$1</ul>');html=html.replace(/<\\/ul>\\s*<ul>/g,'');html=html.replace(/^> (.+)$/gm,'<blockquote>$1</blockquote>');html=html.replace(/<\\/blockquote>\\s*<blockquote>/g,'<br>');html=html.replace(/\\[([^\\]]+)\\]\\(([^)]+)\\)/g,'<a href=\"$2\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">$1</a>');html=html.replace(/\\n/g,'<br>');return html;}"
5588 |                 + "async function loginAnnApi(url){const r=await fetch(url,{cache:'no-store'});let d={};try{d=await r.json();}catch(e){throw new Error('服务器返回了无法解析的内容');}if(!r.ok||(d&&d.error))throw new Error((d&&d.error)||'加载失败');return d;}"
5589 |                 + "function renderLoginAnnouncementCards(items){const list=document.getElementById('loginAnnList');if(!list)return;list.innerHTML=Array.isArray(items)&&items.length?items.map(item=>'<button type=\"button\" class=\"login-ann-item '+(item.id===loginAnnouncementActiveId?'active':'')+'\" onclick=\"selectLoginAnnouncement(\\''+loginAnnEsc(item.id)+'\\')\"><div class=\"login-ann-item-title\">'+loginAnnEsc(item.title||'系统公告')+'</div><div class=\"login-ann-item-meta\">'+loginAnnFmt(item.updatedAt||item.createdAt)+'<br>@'+loginAnnEsc(item.authorNickname||'系统')+'</div></button>').join(''):'<div class=\"login-ann-empty\">当前还没有公告</div>';}"
5590 |                 + "function renderLoginAnnouncementContent(item){document.getElementById('loginAnnTitle').textContent=item&&item.title?item.title:'服务器公告';document.getElementById('loginAnnMeta').textContent=item&&item.id?('发布于 '+loginAnnFmt(item.updatedAt||item.createdAt)+' · 发布者 '+(item.authorNickname||'系统')):'暂无公告';document.getElementById('loginAnnContent').innerHTML=item&&item.id?loginAnnMd(item.content||''):'<div class=\"login-ann-empty\">当前还没有公告</div>';}"
5591 |                 + "function selectLoginAnnouncement(id){loginAnnouncementActiveId=id||'';const item=(loginAnnouncementItems||[]).find(v=>v.id===loginAnnouncementActiveId)||(loginAnnouncementItems||[])[0]||null;renderLoginAnnouncementCards(loginAnnouncementItems||[]);renderLoginAnnouncementContent(item);}"
5592 |                 + "async function loadLoginAnnouncements(preferredId){const list=await loginAnnApi('/api/announcements');loginAnnouncementItems=Array.isArray(list)?list:[];loginAnnouncementActiveId=preferredId||((loginAnnouncementItems[0]||{}).id||'');renderLoginAnnouncementCards(loginAnnouncementItems);selectLoginAnnouncement(loginAnnouncementActiveId);}"
5593 |                 + "async function openLoginAnnouncementList(preferredId){document.getElementById('loginAnnOverlay').classList.add('show');try{await loadLoginAnnouncements(preferredId);}catch(e){document.getElementById('loginAnnList').innerHTML='<div class=\"login-ann-empty\">'+loginAnnEsc(e.message||'加载失败')+'</div>';document.getElementById('loginAnnContent').innerHTML='<div class=\"login-ann-empty\">'+loginAnnEsc(e.message||'加载失败')+'</div>';document.getElementById('loginAnnMeta').textContent='公告加载失败';}}"
5594 |                 + "function closeLoginAnnouncement(){document.getElementById('loginAnnOverlay').classList.remove('show');}"
5595 |                 + "async function bootLoginAnnouncements(){try{const latest=await loginAnnApi('/api/announcements/latest');if(latest&&latest.id){const key='login_announcement_seen_id';if(localStorage.getItem(key)!==latest.id){localStorage.setItem(key,latest.id);openLoginAnnouncementList(latest.id);}}}catch(e){}}"
5596 |                 + "document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeLoginAnnouncement();});bootLoginAnnouncements();";
5597 |     }

5600 |     private long getNextLevelExp(User user) {
5601 |         int lv = user.getEffectiveLevel();
5602 |         if (lv >= 6) return -1; // Lv6及以上已是满级
5603 |         if (lv >= User.LEVEL_CONFIG.length) return -1;
5604 |         return User.LEVEL_CONFIG[lv][0];
5605 |     }

0052 |                 System.setProperty("user.dir", jarDir.getAbsolutePath());

0054 |         } catch (Exception e) {

0059 |     private static java.nio.file.Path resolveCodeSourceRoot() {
0060 |         try {
0061 |             java.net.URL loc = RequestHandler.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation();
0062 |             java.io.File source = new java.io.File(loc.toURI());
0063 |             java.io.File root = source.isDirectory() ? source : source.getParentFile();
0064 |             if (root != null) {
0065 |                 return root.toPath().toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0066 |             }
0067 |         } catch (Exception ignored) {
0068 |         }
0069 |         return Paths.get(".").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0070 |     }

0072 |     private static long readLongSetting(String propertyKey, String envKey, long defaultValue) {
0073 |         String raw = System.getProperty(propertyKey);
0074 |         if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty()) {
0075 |             raw = System.getenv(envKey);
0076 |         }
0077 |         if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty()) {
0078 |             return defaultValue;
0079 |         }
0080 |         try {
0081 |             return Long.parseLong(raw.trim());
0082 |         } catch (Exception ignored) {
0083 |             return defaultValue;
0084 |         }
0085 |     }

0087 |     private java.nio.file.Path resolveAssetFile(String name) {
0088 |         if (name == null || name.contains("..") || name.startsWith("/") || name.startsWith("\\") || name.contains(":") || java.nio.file.Paths.get(name).isAbsolute()) {
0089 |             return null;
0090 |         }
0091 |         List<Map.Entry<java.nio.file.Path, java.nio.file.Path>> pairs = new ArrayList<>();
0092 |         if (CODE_SOURCE_ROOT != null) {
0093 |             java.nio.file.Path base1 = CODE_SOURCE_ROOT.resolve("assets").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0094 |             java.nio.file.Path base2 = CODE_SOURCE_ROOT.resolve("classes").resolve("assets").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0095 |             java.nio.file.Path parent = CODE_SOURCE_ROOT.getParent();
0096 |             pairs.add(Map.entry(base1, base1.resolve(name).toAbsolutePath().normalize()));
0097 |             pairs.add(Map.entry(base2, base2.resolve(name).toAbsolutePath().normalize()));
0098 |             if (parent != null) {
0099 |                 java.nio.file.Path base3 = parent.resolve("src").resolve("main").resolve("resources").resolve("assets").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0100 |                 pairs.add(Map.entry(base3, base3.resolve(name).toAbsolutePath().normalize()));
0101 |             }
0102 |         }
0103 |         java.nio.file.Path base4 = java.nio.file.Paths.get("target", "classes", "assets").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0104 |         java.nio.file.Path base5 = java.nio.file.Paths.get("src", "main", "resources", "assets").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0105 |         pairs.add(Map.entry(base4, base4.resolve(name).toAbsolutePath().normalize()));
0106 |         pairs.add(Map.entry(base5, base5.resolve(name).toAbsolutePath().normalize()));
0107 | 
0108 |         for (Map.Entry<java.nio.file.Path, java.nio.file.Path> entry : pairs) {
0109 |             java.nio.file.Path baseDir = entry.getKey();
0110 |             java.nio.file.Path candidate = entry.getValue();
0111 |             try {
0112 |                 if (candidate.startsWith(baseDir) && java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(candidate)) {
0113 |                     java.nio.file.Path realPath = candidate.toRealPath();
0114 |                     java.nio.file.Path realBase = baseDir.toRealPath();
0115 |                     if (realPath.startsWith(realBase) && java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(realPath)) {
0116 |                         return realPath;
0117 |                     }
0118 |                 }
0119 |             } catch (Exception ignored) {
0120 |             }
0121 |         }
0122 |         return null;
0123 |     }

0128 |     private void cleanExpiredRateLimits(long now) {
0129 |         if (!msgRateLimit.isEmpty()) {
0130 |             msgRateLimit.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> {
0131 |                 long[] b = entry.getValue();
0132 |                 synchronized (b) {
0133 |                     return (now - b[1]) > 300000;
0134 |                 }
0135 |             });
0136 |         }
0137 |     }

0147 |     @Override
0148 |     public void handle(HttpExchange ex) throws IOException {
0149 |         try {
0150 |             String method = ex.getRequestMethod();
0151 |             String path = ex.getRequestURI().getPath();
0152 |             String query = ex.getRequestURI().getQuery();
0153 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().add("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
0154 |             if ("OPTIONS".equalsIgnoreCase(method)) {
0155 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().add("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS");
0156 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().add("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Requested-With");
0157 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().add("Access-Control-Max-Age", "3600");
0158 |                 ex.sendResponseHeaders(204, -1);
0159 |                 return;
0160 |             }
0161 |             String sid = SessionManager.getInstance().getSessionIdFromCookie(
0162 |                     ex.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Cookie"));
0163 |             User me = SessionManager.getInstance().getUser(sid);
0164 |             if (me != null && sid != null) {
0165 |                 SessionManager.getInstance().refreshSession(sid);
0166 |             }
0167 |             I18n.CURRENT_LANG.set(me != null && me.getLanguage() != null ? me.getLanguage() : "zh-CN");
0168 | 
0169 |             // 封禁用户拦截判定（同时对 GET 与 POST 生效）
0170 |             if (me != null && me.isCurrentlyBanned()) {
0171 |                 boolean allowedWhenBanned = path.equals("/login") || path.equals("/register")
0172 |                         || path.equals("/logout") || path.equals("/api/logout")
0173 |                         || path.equals("/api/login") || path.equals("/api/register")
0174 |                         || path.equals("/api/check-user")
0175 |                         || path.startsWith("/assets/")
0176 |                         || path.equals("/favicon.ico");
0177 |                 if (!allowedWhenBanned) {
0178 |                     if (path.startsWith("/api/")) {
0179 |                         sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "账户已被封禁", "banned", String.valueOf(true),
0180 |                                 "banExpiresAt", String.valueOf(me.getBanExpiresAt()),
0181 |                                 "banRemainingMillis", String.valueOf(me.getBanRemainingMillis()),
0182 |                                 "banReason", me.getBanReason() != null ? me.getBanReason() : ""));
0183 |                     } else {
0184 |                         sendText(ex, 403, "账户已被封禁");
0185 |                     }
0186 |                     return;
0187 |                 }
0188 |             }
0189 |             
0190 |             // 全局未登录拦截（/files/ 将在 serveFile 中进一步做 canAccessFile 精准鉴权）
0191 |             if (me == null) {
0192 |                 boolean isPublic = path.equals("/login") || path.equals("/register") 
0193 |                         || path.equals("/api/login") || path.equals("/api/register")
0194 |                         || path.startsWith("/assets/")
0195 |                         || path.startsWith("/share/")
0196 |                         || path.equals("/favicon.ico");
0197 |                 if (!isPublic) {
0198 |                     if (path.startsWith("/files/")) {
0199 |                         // 在 serveFile 中进行 canAccessFile 校验
0200 |                     } else if (path.startsWith("/api/")) {
0201 |                         sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
0202 |                         return;
0203 |                     } else {
0204 |                         redirect(ex, "/login");
0205 |                         return;
0206 |                     }
0207 |                 }
0208 |             }
0209 | 
0210 |             try {
0211 |                 if ("GET".equals(method))
0212 |                     handleGet(ex, path, query, me, sid);
0213 |                 else if ("POST".equals(method)) {
0214 |                     if (me != null && me.isFeatureBanned("upload") && path.startsWith("/api/upload-file")) {
0215 |                         sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "上传功能已被封禁"));
0216 |                         return;
0217 |                     }
0218 |                     if ("/api/upload-file-stream".equals(path)) {
0219 |                         handleUploadFileStream(ex, ex.getRequestBody(), query, me);
0220 |                     } else if ("/api/store-file-stream".equals(path)) {
0221 |                         handleStoreFileStream(ex, ex.getRequestBody(), query, me);
0222 |                     } else if ("/api/games/upload-binary".equals(path)) {
0223 |                         handleUploadGameBinary(ex, ex.getRequestBody(), query, me);
0224 |                     } else if ("/api/upload-file-form".equals(path)) {
0225 |                         sendJson(ex, 410, map("error", "旧版表单上传已停用，请使用流式上传接口"));
0226 |                     } else {
0227 |                         handlePost(ex, path, readBody(ex), me, sid);
0228 |                     }
0229 |                 } else
0230 |                     sendText(ex, 405, "Method Not Allowed");
0231 |             } catch (OutOfMemoryError oom) {
0232 |                 System.err.println("[OOM] 内存不足: " + ex.getRequestURI().getPath());
0233 |                 try { sendText(ex, 413, "文件过大，内存不足，请上传较小的文件"); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
0234 |             } catch (Exception e) {
0235 |                 e.printStackTrace();
0236 |                 if (path.startsWith("/api/")) {
0237 |                     sendJson(ex, 500, map("error", "服务器内部错误: " + e.getMessage()));
0238 |                 } else {
0239 |                     sendText(ex, 500, "Error: " + e.getMessage());
0240 |                 }
0241 |             }
0242 |         } finally {
0243 |             I18n.CURRENT_LANG.remove();
0244 |         }
0245 |     }

0247 |     // ======================== GET ========================
0248 |     private void handleGet(HttpExchange ex, String path, String query, User me, String sid) throws IOException {
0249 |         if (path.startsWith("/files/")) {
0250 |             serveFile(ex, path, query, me);
0251 |             return;
0252 |         }
0253 |         if (path.startsWith("/cloud-files/")) {
0254 |             serveCloudFile(ex, path, query, me);
0255 |             return;
0256 |         }
0257 |         if (path.startsWith("/assets/")) {
0258 |             serveAsset(ex, path);
0259 |             return;
0260 |         }
0261 |         if ("/favicon.ico".equals(path)) {
0262 |             ex.sendResponseHeaders(204, -1);
0263 |             return;
0264 |         }
0265 |         if ("/".equals(path) || "/index".equals(path)) {
0266 |             redirect(ex, me != null ? "/chat" : "/login");
0267 |             return;
0268 |         }
0269 |         if ("/login".equals(path)) {
0270 |             if (me != null) {
0271 |                 redirect(ex, "/chat");
0272 |                 return;
0273 |             }
0274 |             send(ex, 200, "text/html;charset=utf-8", buildLoginPage());
0275 |             return;
0276 |         }
0277 |         if (isAppPagePath(path)) {
0278 |             if (me == null) {
0279 |                 redirect(ex, "/login");
0280 |                 return;
0281 |             }
0282 |             send(ex, 200, "text/html;charset=utf-8", buildChatPage(me));
0283 |             return;
0284 |         }
0285 |         // 分享链接页面（无需登录即可访问）
0286 |         if (path.startsWith("/share/")) {
0287 |             send(ex, 200, "text/html;charset=utf-8", buildSharePage(path, me));
0288 |             return;
0289 |         }
0290 |         switch (path) {
0291 |             case "/favicon.ico":
0292 |                 ex.sendResponseHeaders(204, -1);
0293 |                 break;
0294 |             case "/api/me":
0295 |                 handleGetMe(ex, me);
0296 |                 break;
0297 |             default:
0298 |                 if (me != null && me.isCurrentlyBanned() && path.startsWith("/api/")) {
0299 |                     sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "账户已被封禁", "banned", String.valueOf(true),
0300 |                             "banExpiresAt", String.valueOf(me.getBanExpiresAt()),
0301 |                             "banRemainingMillis", String.valueOf(me.getBanRemainingMillis()),
0302 |                             "banReason", me.getBanReason() != null ? me.getBanReason() : ""));
0303 |                     return;
0304 |                 }
0305 |                 handleGetApiRoute(ex, path, query, me, sid);
0306 |                 break;
0307 |         }
0308 |     }

0817 |     private void serveAsset(HttpExchange ex, String path) throws IOException {
0818 |         String name = path.substring("/assets/".length());
0819 |         if (name.contains("..") || name.startsWith("/") || name.startsWith("\\") || name.contains(":")) {
0820 |             sendText(ex, 400, "非法请求");
0821 |             return;
0822 |         }
0823 |         java.nio.file.Path assetFile = resolveAssetFile(name);
0824 |         if (assetFile != null) {
0825 |             byte[] data = Files.readAllBytes(assetFile);
0826 |             String mime = name.endsWith(".js") ? "application/javascript;charset=utf-8"
0827 |                     : name.endsWith(".css") ? "text/css;charset=utf-8"
0828 |                     : "application/octet-stream";
0829 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", mime);
0830 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "max-age=3600");
0831 |             ex.sendResponseHeaders(200, data.length);
0832 |             try (OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {
0833 |                 os.write(data);
0834 |             }
0835 |             return;
0836 |         }
0837 |         try (InputStream is = getClass().getResourceAsStream("/assets/" + name)) {
0838 |             if (is == null) {
0839 |                 sendText(ex, 404, "资源不存在");
0840 |                 return;
0841 |             }
0842 |             byte[] data = is.readAllBytes();
0843 |             String mime = name.endsWith(".js") ? "application/javascript;charset=utf-8"
0844 |                     : name.endsWith(".css") ? "text/css;charset=utf-8"
0845 |                     : "application/octet-stream";
0846 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", mime);
0847 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "max-age=3600");
0848 |             ex.sendResponseHeaders(200, data.length);
0849 |             try (OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {
0850 |                 os.write(data);
0851 |             }
0852 |         }
0853 |     }

0855 |     // ======================== 文件服务 ========================
0856 |     private String extractFileName(String path) {
0857 |         if (path == null) return null;
0858 |         int lastSlash = Math.max(path.lastIndexOf('/'), path.lastIndexOf('\\'));
0859 |         return lastSlash >= 0 ? path.substring(lastSlash + 1) : path;
0860 |     }

0862 |     private boolean canAccessFile(String storedName, User me) {
0863 |         if (storedName == null || storedName.trim().isEmpty()) return false;
0864 |         
0865 |         if (me != null && isSuperAdmin(me.getUserId())) {
0866 |             return true;
0867 |         }
0868 | 
0869 |         // 检查公共静态资源（头像、音乐、视频、游戏、动态、公告、公开分享链接）
0870 |         for (User u : UserService.getInstance().getAllUsers()) {
0871 |             if (u.getAvatarPath() != null && Objects.equals(extractFileName(u.getAvatarPath()), storedName)) {
0872 |                 return true;
0873 |             }
0874 |         }
0875 |         for (com.chat.model.MusicTrack track : MusicService.getInstance().listTracks()) {
0876 |             if ((track.getFilePath() != null && Objects.equals(extractFileName(track.getFilePath()), storedName)) ||
0877 |                 (track.getCover() != null && Objects.equals(extractFileName(track.getCover()), storedName))) {
0878 |                 return true;
0879 |             }
0880 |         }
0881 |         for (com.chat.model.VideoEntry v : VideoService.getInstance().listEntries()) {
0882 |             if ((v.getFilePath() != null && Objects.equals(extractFileName(v.getFilePath()), storedName)) ||
0883 |                 (v.getCoverPath() != null && Objects.equals(extractFileName(v.getCoverPath()), storedName))) {
0884 |                 return true;
0885 |             }
0886 |         }
0887 |         for (com.chat.model.GameEntry g : GameService.getInstance().listGames()) {
0888 |             if ((g.getCoverPath() != null && Objects.equals(extractFileName(g.getCoverPath()), storedName)) ||
0889 |                 (g.getPreviewVideoPath() != null && Objects.equals(extractFileName(g.getPreviewVideoPath()), storedName))) {
0890 |                 return true;
0891 |             }
0892 |             if (g.getVersions() != null) {
0893 |                 for (var ver : g.getVersions()) {
0894 |                     if (ver.getFilePath() != null && Objects.equals(extractFileName(ver.getFilePath()), storedName)) return true;
0895 |                 }
0896 |             }
0897 |         }
0898 |         for (com.chat.model.Announcement a : AnnouncementService.getInstance().listAll()) {
0899 |             if (a.getContent() != null) {
0900 |                 String content = a.getContent();
0901 |                 java.util.regex.Matcher m = java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("(?:/files/|files/)([^\\s\"'>)]+)").matcher(content);
0902 |                 while (m.find()) {
0903 |                     String extracted = extractFileName(m.group(1));
0904 |                     if (Objects.equals(extracted, storedName)) {
0905 |                         return true;
0906 |                     }
0907 |                 }
0908 |             }
0909 |         }
0910 |         if (MomentService.getInstance().hasAccessToAttachment(storedName, me != null ? me.getUserId() : null)) {
0911 |             return true;
0912 |         }
0913 |         if (CloudService.getInstance().isPublicFileShare(storedName)) {
0914 |             return true;
0915 |         }
0916 | 
0917 |         if (me == null) {
0918 |             return false;
0919 |         }
0920 | 
0921 |         String uid = me.getUserId();
0922 |         if (MessageService.getInstance().hasAccessToFile(uid, storedName)) {
0923 |             return true;
0924 |         }
0925 |         if (CloudService.getInstance().hasAccessToFile(uid, storedName)) {
0926 |             return true;
0927 |         }
0928 |         if (NoteService.getInstance().hasAccessToFile(uid, storedName)) {
0929 |             return true;
0930 |         }
0931 | 
0932 |         return false;
0933 |     }

0935 |     private void serveFile(HttpExchange ex, String path, String query, User me) throws IOException {
0936 |         String stored = path.substring("/files/".length());
0937 |         if (stored.contains("..") || stored.contains("/") || stored.contains("\\") || stored.contains(":")) {
0938 |             sendText(ex, 400, "非法请求");
0939 |             return;
0940 |         }
0941 | 
0942 |         if (!canAccessFile(stored, me)) {
0943 |             if (me == null) {
0944 |                 sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录或无权访问私密文件"));
0945 |             } else {
0946 |                 sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "无权访问该私密文件"));
0947 |             }
0948 |             return;
0949 |         }
0950 |         try {
0951 |             StoredFileMetadata metadata = FileStore.getInstance().getMetadata(stored);
0952 |             if (metadata == null) {
0953 |                 sendText(ex, 404, "文件不存在");
0954 |                 return;
0955 |             }
0956 |             String mime = metadata.getContentType() != null ? metadata.getContentType() : FileStore.guessMime(stored);
0957 |             String requestedName = parseQuery(query).get("name");
0958 |             String displayName = requestedName != null && !requestedName.trim().isEmpty()
0959 |                     ? FileStore.normalizeUploadedFileName(requestedName)
0960 |                     : FileStore.normalizeUploadedFileName(metadata.getOriginalFileName());
0961 |             boolean forceDownload = "1".equals(parseQuery(query).get("download"));
0962 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", mime);
0963 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "max-age=86400");
0964 |             boolean inline = mime.startsWith("image/") || mime.startsWith("video/")
0965 |                     || mime.startsWith("audio/") || mime.startsWith("text/html") || mime.startsWith("text/markdown");
0966 |             if (inline && !forceDownload) {
0967 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Disposition", "inline");
0968 |             } else {
0969 |                 String encoded = URLEncoder.encode(displayName, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
0970 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Disposition",
0971 |                         "attachment; filename=\"" + asciiFileName(displayName) + "\"; filename*=UTF-8''" + encoded);
0972 |             }
0973 |             ex.sendResponseHeaders(200, metadata.getSize());
0974 |             try (InputStream in = FileStore.getInstance().openStream(stored);
0975 |                  OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {
0976 |                 byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
0977 |                 int read;
0978 |                 while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
0979 |                     os.write(buffer, 0, read);
0980 |                 }
0981 |             }
0982 |         } catch (Exception ignored) {
0983 |             /* 客户端断开或IO错误，忽略 */ }
0984 |     }

0986 |     private void serveCloudFile(HttpExchange ex, String path, String query, User me) throws IOException {
0987 |         if (me == null) {
0988 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
0989 |             return;
0990 |         }
0991 |         String sub = path.substring("/cloud-files/".length());
0992 |         if (sub.contains("..") || sub.startsWith("/") || sub.startsWith("\\") || sub.contains(":")) {
0993 |             sendText(ex, 400, "非法请求");
0994 |             return;
0995 |         }
0996 |         java.nio.file.Path baseDir = Paths.get("chatserver", "cloud-files").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0997 |         java.nio.file.Path filePath = baseDir.resolve(sub).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0998 |         if (!filePath.startsWith(baseDir)) {
0999 |             sendText(ex, 400, "非法请求");
1000 |             return;
1001 |         }
1002 |         int firstSlash = sub.indexOf('/');
1003 |         if (firstSlash <= 0) {
1004 |             sendText(ex, 400, "非法路径格式");
1005 |             return;
1006 |         }
1007 |         String ownerId = sub.substring(0, firstSlash);
1008 |         boolean isOwner = me.getUserId().equals(ownerId);
1009 |         boolean isAdmin = SuperAdminService.getInstance().isSuperAdmin(me.getUserId()) ||
1010 |                           Objects.equals(SuperAdminService.getInstance().getPrimarySuperAdminId(), me.getUserId());
1011 |         if (!isOwner && !isAdmin) {
1012 |             sendText(ex, 403, "无权访问此私有文件");
1013 |             return;
1014 |         }
1015 |         if (!Files.isRegularFile(filePath)) {
1016 |             sendText(ex, 404, "文件不存在");
1017 |             return;
1018 |         }
1019 |         try {
1020 |             String mime = Files.probeContentType(filePath);
1021 |             if (mime == null) mime = "application/octet-stream";
1022 |             String requestedName = parseQuery(query).get("name");
1023 |             String displayName = requestedName != null && !requestedName.trim().isEmpty()
1024 |                     ? requestedName : filePath.getFileName().toString();
1025 |             boolean forceDownload = "1".equals(parseQuery(query).get("download"));
1026 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", mime);
1027 |             ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "max-age=86400");
1028 |             boolean inline = mime.startsWith("image/") || mime.startsWith("video/")
1029 |                     || mime.startsWith("audio/") || mime.startsWith("text/html") || mime.startsWith("text/markdown");
1030 |             if (inline && !forceDownload) {
1031 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Disposition", "inline");
1032 |             } else {
1033 |                 String encoded = URLEncoder.encode(displayName, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
1034 |                 ex.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Disposition",
1035 |                         "attachment; filename=\"" + asciiFileName(displayName) + "\"; filename*=UTF-8''" + encoded);
1036 |             }
1037 |             long fileSize = Files.size(filePath);
1038 |             ex.sendResponseHeaders(200, fileSize);
1039 |             try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(filePath);
1040 |                  OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {
1041 |                 byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
1042 |                 int read;
1043 |                 while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
1044 |                     os.write(buffer, 0, read);
1045 |                 }
1046 |             }
1047 |         } catch (Exception ignored) {
1048 |             /* 客户端断开或IO错误，忽略 */ }
1049 |     }

1062 |     private void handleRegister(HttpExchange ex, String body) throws IOException {
1063 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
1064 |         String username = p.get("username"), nickname = p.get("nickname"),
1065 |                 password = p.get("password"), repeat = p.get("repeatPassword");
1066 |         if (username == null || nickname == null || password == null || repeat == null) {
1067 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "昵称和密码不能为空"));
1068 |             return;
1069 |         }
1070 |         if (!password.equals(repeat)) {
1071 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "两次密码不一致"));
1072 |             return;
1073 |         }
1074 |         // 生成随机 userId：6位数字(100000-999999), 用完则8位(10000000-99999999)
1075 |         String autoUserId = generateRandomUserId();
1076 |         boolean ok = UserService.getInstance().register(username.trim(), nickname.trim(), autoUserId, password);
1077 |         if (ok) {
1078 |             User u = UserService.getInstance().getByUsername(username.trim());
1079 |             String s = SessionManager.getInstance().createSession(u);
1080 |             sendSessionCookie(ex, s);
1081 |             sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "true", "nickname", u.getNickname()));
1082 |         } else
1083 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "注册失败，用户名已存在"));
1084 |     }
1085 | 
1086 |     private String generateRandomUserId() {
1087 |         // 先尝试 6 位随机数 (100000-999999)
1088 |         java.util.Set<String> allIds = UserService.getInstance().getAllUsers().stream()
1089 |                 .map(u -> u.getUserId()).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toSet());
1090 |         Random rand = new Random();
1091 |         for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 200; attempt++) {
1092 |             int id = 100000 + rand.nextInt(900000);
1093 |             String sid = String.valueOf(id);
1094 |             if (!allIds.contains(sid)) return sid;
1095 |         }
1096 |         // 6 位用完，用 8 位随机数 (10000000-99999999)
1097 |         for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 200; attempt++) {
1098 |             int id = 10000000 + rand.nextInt(90000000);
1099 |             String sid = String.valueOf(id);
1100 |             if (!allIds.contains(sid)) return sid;
1101 |         }
1102 |         // 极端情况：时间戳结合循环自增，且必须通过 allIds 防重碰撞校验
1103 |         long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
1104 |         for (int offset = 0; offset < 10000; offset++) {
1105 |             String candidate = String.valueOf(now + offset);
1106 |             if (candidate.length() > 8) {
1107 |                 candidate = candidate.substring(candidate.length() - 8);
1108 |             }
1109 |             if (!allIds.contains(candidate)) return candidate;
1110 |         }
1111 |         String uuidFallback;
1112 |         do {
1113 |             uuidFallback = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "").substring(0, 8);
1114 |         } while (allIds.contains(uuidFallback));
1115 |         return uuidFallback;
1116 |     }

1130 |                     banInfo.put("banExpiresAt", u.getBanExpiresAt());

1144 |     private boolean canUserReadRoom(User me, String room) {
1145 |         if (me == null) return false;
1146 |         if (isSuperAdmin(me.getUserId())) return true;
1147 |         if (room == null || room.trim().isEmpty() || "public".equals(room)) return true;
1148 | 
1149 |         String normalized = room;
1150 |         if (!room.startsWith("public") && !room.startsWith("group_") && !room.startsWith("private_")) {
1151 |             normalized = MessageService.normalizePrivateRoomId(me.getUserId(), room);
1152 |         }
1153 | 
1154 |         if (normalized.startsWith("private_")) {
1155 |             String[] parts = normalized.split("_", 3);
1156 |             if (parts.length >= 3) {
1157 |                 String u1 = parts[1];
1158 |                 String u2 = parts[2];
1159 |                 return me.getUserId().equals(u1) || me.getUserId().equals(u2);
1160 |             }
1161 |             return false;
1162 |         } else if (normalized.startsWith("group_")) {
1163 |             String groupId = normalized.substring("group_".length());
1164 |             Group g = GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(groupId);
1165 |             return g != null && g.isMember(me.getUserId());
1166 |         } else if (normalized.startsWith("g")) {
1167 |             Group g = GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(normalized);
1168 |             return g != null && g.isMember(me.getUserId());
1169 |         }
1170 |         return false;
1171 |     }

1190 |     // ===== 事件流 =====
1191 |     private static final java.util.Deque<Map<String, Object>> EVENT_QUEUE = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque<>();
1192 |     private static final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong EVENT_ID = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong(
1193 |             0);
1194 |     private static final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger(0);
1195 | 
1196 |     private static void pushEvent(String type, Map<String, Object> data) {
1197 |         Map<String, Object> ev = new LinkedHashMap<>();
1198 |         ev.put("eid", String.valueOf(EVENT_ID.incrementAndGet()));
1199 |         ev.put("type", type);
1200 |         ev.putAll(data);
1201 |         EVENT_QUEUE.addLast(ev);
1202 |         if (EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE.incrementAndGet() > 1000) {
1203 |             while (EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE.get() > 1000) {
1204 |                 if (EVENT_QUEUE.pollFirst() != null) {
1205 |                     EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE.decrementAndGet();
1206 |                 } else {
1207 |                     break;
1208 |                 }
1209 |             }
1210 |         }
1211 |     }
1212 | 
1213 |     private void handleGetEvents(HttpExchange ex, String query, User me) throws IOException {
1214 |         if (me == null) {
1215 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
1216 |             return;
1217 |         }
1218 |         long since = parseLong(parseQuery(query).get("since"), 0);
1219 |         List<Map<String, Object>> result = EVENT_QUEUE.stream()
1220 |                 .filter(ev -> parseLong(String.valueOf(ev.get("eid")), 0) > since)
1221 |                 .filter(ev -> isEventVisibleToUser(ev, me))
1222 |                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
1223 |         sendJson(ex, 200, result);
1224 |     }
1225 | 
1226 |     private boolean isEventVisibleToUser(Map<String, Object> ev, User me) {
1227 |         if (ev == null || me == null) return false;
1228 |         String myUid = me.getUserId();
1229 |         
1230 |         Object roomObj = ev.get("room");
1231 |         if (roomObj == null) roomObj = ev.get("chatRoomId");
1232 |         if (roomObj != null) {
1233 |             String r = String.valueOf(roomObj);
1234 |             if (r.startsWith("private_")) {
1235 |                 String[] parts = r.split("_", 3);
1236 |                 if (parts.length >= 3) {
1237 |                     if (!parts[1].equals(myUid) && !parts[2].equals(myUid)) {
1238 |                         return false;
1239 |                     }
1240 |                 }
1241 |             } else if (r.startsWith("group_") || r.startsWith("g")) {
1242 |                 com.chat.model.Group g = GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(r);
1243 |                 if (g == null && r.startsWith("group_")) {
1244 |                     g = GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(r.substring(6));
1245 |                 }
1246 |                 if (g != null && !g.isMember(myUid)) {
1247 |                     return false;
1248 |                 }
1249 |             }
1250 |         }
1251 |         
1252 |         Object targetObj = ev.get("targetUserId");
1253 |         if (targetObj != null && !targetObj.equals("null")) {
1254 |             String targetUid = String.valueOf(targetObj);
1255 |             Object fromObj = ev.get("fromUserId");
1256 |             String fromUid = fromObj != null ? String.valueOf(fromObj) : null;
1257 |             if (!targetUid.equals(myUid) && (fromUid == null || !fromUid.equals(myUid))) {
1258 |                 return false;
1259 |             }
1260 |         }
1261 |         return true;
1262 |     }

1566 |                 .map(comment -> {
1567 |                     User commentUser = UserService.getInstance().getByUserId(comment.getFromUserId());
1568 |                     Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();
1569 |                     row.put("fromUserId", comment.getFromUserId());
1570 |                     row.put("fromNickname", commentUser != null && commentUser.getNickname() != null
1571 |                             && !commentUser.getNickname().trim().isEmpty()
1572 |                                     ? commentUser.getNickname()
1573 |                                     : comment.getFromNickname());
1574 |                     row.put("avatarPath", commentUser != null ? commentUser.getAvatarPath() : null);
1575 |                     row.put("content", comment.getContent());
1576 |                     row.put("timestamp", comment.getTimestamp());
1577 |                     return row;
1578 |                 })
1579 |                 .collect(Collectors.toList()));
1580 |         return data;

1593 |     private void handleAddSticker(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {

1595 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
1596 |             return;

1625 |             sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "true", "path", path));
1626 |         } catch (Exception e) {

1657 |     private void handleSendMessage(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
1658 |         if (me == null) {
1659 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
1660 |             return;
1661 |         }
1662 |         if (me.isFeatureBanned("chat")) {
1663 |             Map<String, Object> fbInfo = UserService.getInstance().getFeatureBanInfo(me.getUserId(), "chat");
1664 |             sendJson(ex, 403, fbInfo != null ? fbInfo : map("error", "聊天功能已被封禁"));
1665 |             return;
1666 |         }
1667 |         // 消息限速检查
1668 |         if (!isSuperAdmin(me.getUserId())) {
1669 |             int limit = me.getMsgsPerMinuteByLevel();
1670 |             long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
1671 |             cleanExpiredRateLimits(now);
1672 |             long[] bucket = msgRateLimit.computeIfAbsent(me.getUserId(), k -> new long[]{0, now});
1673 |             synchronized (bucket) {
1674 |                 if (now - bucket[1] > 60000) { bucket[0] = 0; bucket[1] = now; }
1675 |                 bucket[0]++;
1676 |                 if (bucket[0] > limit) {
1677 |                     long waitSec = Math.max(1, (60000 - (now - bucket[1])) / 1000);
1678 |                     sendJson(ex, 429, map("error", "发送过于频繁，请等待1分钟后再试", "rateLimited", "true", "waitSeconds", String.valueOf(waitSec)));
1679 |                     return;
1680 |                 }
1681 |             }

1683 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);

1699 |                 sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "全员禁言中，仅群主和管理员可发言"));

1706 |                 sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "全员禁言中，仅管理员可发言"));
1707 |                 return;

1714 |         if (clientMsgId != null && !clientMsgId.trim().isEmpty()) {

1855 |     private void maybeDelaySendResponse(String clientMsgId) {
1856 |         if (TEST_SEND_RESPONSE_DELAY_MS <= 0) return;
1857 |         String key = clientMsgId == null ? "" : clientMsgId.trim();
1858 |         if (key.isEmpty() || !DELAYED_SEND_RESPONSES.add(key)) return;
1859 |         try {
1860 |             Thread.sleep(TEST_SEND_RESPONSE_DELAY_MS);
1861 |         } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
1862 |             Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
1863 |         }
1864 |     }

1866 |     private int countLines(String text) {
1867 |         if (text == null || text.isEmpty()) {
1868 |             return 0;
1869 |         }
1870 |         int lines = 1;
1871 |         for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
1872 |             if (text.charAt(i) == '\n') {
1873 |                 lines++;
1874 |             }
1875 |         }
1876 |         return lines;
1877 |     }

1904 |     private void handleStoreFileStream(HttpExchange ex, InputStream bodyStream, String query, User me) throws IOException {
1905 |         if (me == null) {
1906 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
1907 |             return;

1910 |             sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "上传功能已被封禁"));

1913 |         Map<String, String> params = parseQuery(query);

1915 |         if (fileName == null || fileName.trim().isEmpty()) {
1916 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "缺少文件名"));

1918 |         }

1920 |             StoredFileMetadata storedFile = storeStreamFile(ex, bodyStream, fileName, 6L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024,
1921 |                     "文件不能超过6GB", me.getUserId());

1926 |             res.put("fileSize", storedFile.getSize());
1927 |             res.put("contentType", storedFile.getContentType());
1928 |             sendJson(ex, 200, res);

1931 |         } catch (Exception e) {

1936 |     private void handleUploadFileStream(HttpExchange ex, InputStream bodyStream, String query, User me) throws IOException {
1937 |         if (me == null) {
1938 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
1939 |             return;
1940 |         }
1941 |         Map<String, String> params = parseQuery(query);
1942 |         String fileName = params.get("fileName");
1943 |         String room = params.getOrDefault("room", "public");
1944 |         String type = params.getOrDefault("type", "file");
1945 |         if (fileName == null || fileName.trim().isEmpty()) {
1946 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "缺少文件名"));
1947 |             return;
1948 |         }
1949 |         long contentLength = parseLong(ex.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Content-Length"), -1);
1950 |         long sixGb = 6L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
1951 |         if (contentLength >= sixGb) {
1952 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "文件不能超过6GB"));
1953 |             return;
1954 |         }
1955 |         try {
1956 |             StoredFileMetadata storedFile = storeStreamFile(ex, bodyStream, fileName, sixGb, "文件不能超过6GB", me.getUserId());
1957 |             sendUploadedMessage(ex, me, room, type, storedFile, fileName);
1958 |         } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
1959 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", e.getMessage()));
1960 |         } catch (Exception e) {
1961 |             sendJson(ex, 500, map("error", "上传失败: " + e.getMessage()));
1962 |         }
1963 |     }
1964 | 
1965 |     private StoredFileMetadata storeStreamFile(HttpExchange ex, InputStream bodyStream, String fileName,
1966 |                                                long maxBytes, String tooLargeMessage, String userId) throws Exception {
1967 |         String normalizedFileName = FileStore.normalizeUploadedFileName(fileName);
1968 |         long contentLength = parseLong(ex.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Content-Length"), -1);
1969 |         if (contentLength > maxBytes) {
1970 |             throw new IllegalArgumentException(tooLargeMessage);
1971 |         }
1972 |         InputStream limitedStream = maxBytes > 0 ? limitInputStream(bodyStream, maxBytes, tooLargeMessage) : bodyStream;
1973 |         return FileStore.getInstance().store(
1974 |                 limitedStream,
1975 |                 normalizedFileName,
1976 |                 ex.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Content-Type"),
1977 |                 userId);
1978 |     }
1979 | 
1980 |     private InputStream limitInputStream(InputStream inputStream, long maxBytes, String tooLargeMessage) {
1981 |         return new FilterInputStream(inputStream) {
1982 |             private long count = 0L;
1983 | 
1984 |             private void ensureWithinLimit(long delta) {
1985 |                 if (delta <= 0) return;
1986 |                 count += delta;
1987 |                 if (count > maxBytes) {
1988 |                     throw new IllegalArgumentException(tooLargeMessage);
1989 |                 }
1990 |             }
1991 | 
1992 |             @Override
1993 |             public int read() throws IOException {
1994 |                 int value = super.read();
1995 |                 if (value != -1) ensureWithinLimit(1);
1996 |                 return value;
1997 |             }
1998 | 
1999 |             @Override
2000 |             public int read(byte[] b, int off, int len) throws IOException {
2001 |                 int read = super.read(b, off, len);
2002 |                 if (read > 0) ensureWithinLimit(read);
2003 |                 return read;
2004 |             }
2005 |         };
2006 |     }
2007 | 
2008 |     private void sendUploadedMessage(HttpExchange ex, User me, String room, String type,
2009 |                                      StoredFileMetadata storedFile, String originalFileName) throws IOException {
2010 |         long fileSizeBytes = storedFile.getSize();
2011 |         long MB50 = 50L * 1024 * 1024;
2012 |         long MB300 = 300L * 1024 * 1024;
2013 |         long GB3 = 3L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
2014 |         Long expireAt = null;
2015 |         long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
2016 |         if (fileSizeBytes > GB3)
2017 |             expireAt = now + 1L * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
2018 |         else if (fileSizeBytes > MB300)
2019 |             expireAt = now + 7L * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
2020 |         else if (fileSizeBytes > MB50)
2021 |             expireAt = now + 60L * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
2022 | 
2023 |         Message msg = MessageService.getInstance().sendMessage(
2024 |                 me.getUserId(), me.getNickname(), null, null, room,
2025 |                 type, FileStore.normalizeUploadedFileName(originalFileName),
2026 |                 storedFile.getAccessPath(), null, null, null, me.getBubbleSkin());
2027 |         if (msg == null) {
2028 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "发送失败"));
2029 |             return;
2030 |         }
2031 |         // Auto-save uploaded files to cloud drive
2032 |         try {
2033 |             CloudService.getInstance().storeUserFile(me, storedFile, "/uploads", originalFileName, "chat");
2034 |         } catch (Exception ignored) {
2035 |         }
2036 |         Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();
2037 |         res.put("id", msg.getId());
2038 |         res.put("fromUserId", msg.getFromUserId());
2039 |         res.put("fromNickname", msg.getFromNickname());
2040 |         res.put("chatRoomId", msg.getChatRoomId());
2041 |         res.put("msgType", msg.getMsgType());
2042 |         res.put("filePath", msg.getFilePath());
2043 |         res.put("fileName", msg.getFileName());
2044 |         res.put("content", msg.getContent());
2045 |         res.put("timestamp", msg.getTimestamp());
2046 |         res.put("recalled", msg.isRecalled());
2047 |         res.put("bubbleSkin", msg.getBubbleSkin());
2048 |         res.put("avatarPath", me.getAvatarPath());
2049 |         if (expireAt != null)
2050 |             res.put("expireAt", expireAt);
2051 |         res.put("fileSize", fileSizeBytes);
2052 |         sendJson(ex, 200, res);

2061 |     private boolean canUserReadMessage(User me, Message msg) {
2062 |         if (me == null || msg == null) return false;
2063 |         if (isSuperAdmin(me.getUserId())) return true;
2064 |         String room = msg.getChatRoomId();
2065 |         if (room == null || "public".equals(room)) return true;
2066 |         if (room.startsWith("group_")) {
2067 |             Group g = GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(room.substring(6));
2068 |             return g != null && g.isMember(me.getUserId());
2069 |         }
2070 |         if (room.startsWith("private_")) {
2071 |             return room.contains(me.getUserId())
2072 |                     || me.getUserId().equals(msg.getFromUserId())
2073 |                     || me.getUserId().equals(msg.getToUserId());
2074 |         }
2075 |         return me.getUserId().equals(msg.getFromUserId()) || me.getUserId().equals(msg.getToUserId());
2076 |     }

2078 |     private void handleForwardMessage(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
2079 |         if (me == null) {
2080 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
2081 |             return;
2082 |         }
2083 |         if (me.isFeatureBanned("chat")) {
2084 |             sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "聊天功能已被封禁"));
2085 |             return;
2086 |         }
2087 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
2088 |         String msgId = p.get("messageId"), targetRoom = p.get("targetRoom");
2089 |         if (msgId == null || targetRoom == null) {
2090 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "参数不完整"));
2091 |             return;
2092 |         }
2093 |         Message orig = MessageService.getInstance().getById(msgId);
2094 |         if (orig == null) {
2095 |             sendJson(ex, 404, map("error", "原消息不存在"));
2096 |             return;
2097 |         }
2098 |         if (!canUserReadMessage(me, orig)) {
2099 |             sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "无权访问该原消息"));
2100 |             return;
2101 |         }
2102 |         if (orig.isRecalled()) {
2103 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "已撤回的消息不能转发"));
2104 |             return;
2105 |         }
2106 |         if (targetRoom.startsWith("group_")) {
2107 |             Group g = GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(targetRoom.substring(6));
2108 |             if (g == null || !g.isMember(me.getUserId())) {
2109 |                 sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "你不在该群"));
2110 |                 return;
2111 |             }
2112 |             if (g.isMuted(me.getUserId())) {
2113 |                 sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "你已被禁言"));
2114 |                 return;
2115 |             }
2116 |             if (g.isAllMuted() && !g.isOwner(me.getUserId()) && !(g.getAdmins() != null && g.getAdmins().contains(me.getUserId()))) {
2117 |                 sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "全员禁言中，仅群主和管理员可发言"));
2118 |                 return;
2119 |             }
2120 |         }
2121 |         if ("public".equals(targetRoom)) {
2122 |             com.chat.model.PublicRoomConfig prConfig = PublicRoomService.getInstance().getConfig();
2123 |             if (prConfig.isAllMuted() && !PublicRoomService.getInstance().isAdmin(me.getUserId())) {
2124 |                 sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "全员禁言中，仅管理员可发言"));
2125 |                 return;
2126 |             }
2127 |             if (prConfig.getMutedUserIds().contains(me.getUserId())) {
2128 |                 sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "你已被禁言"));
2129 |                 return;
2130 |             }
2131 |         }
2132 |         Message fwd = MessageService.getInstance().sendMessage(
2133 |                 me.getUserId(), me.getNickname(), null, orig.getContent(), targetRoom,
2134 |                 orig.getMsgType(), orig.getFileName(), orig.getFilePath(),
2135 |                 orig.getFromNickname(), orig.getFromUserId(), null, me.getBubbleSkin());
2136 |         sendJson(ex, 200, fwd);
2137 |     }

2146 |             return;

2210 |     private void handleRecallMessage(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
2211 |         if (me == null) {
2212 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
2213 |             return;
2214 |         }
2215 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
2216 |         String messageId = p.get("messageId");
2217 |         Message msg = MessageService.getInstance().getById(messageId);
2218 |         if (msg == null) {
2219 |             sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "false", "error", "消息不存在"));
2220 |             return;
2221 |         }
2222 |         
2223 |         boolean isAdmin = isSuperAdmin(me.getUserId());
2224 |         if (!isAdmin && msg.getChatRoomId().startsWith("group_")) {
2225 |             Group g = GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(msg.getChatRoomId().substring(6));
2226 |             if (g != null && (g.getOwnerId().equals(me.getUserId()) || (g.getAdmins() != null && g.getAdmins().contains(me.getUserId())))) {
2227 |                 isAdmin = true;
2228 |             }
2229 |         } else if (!isAdmin && "public".equals(msg.getChatRoomId())) {
2230 |             PublicRoomConfig pc = PublicRoomService.getInstance().getConfig();
2231 |             if (pc.getAdminIds() != null && pc.getAdminIds().contains(me.getUserId())) {
2232 |                 isAdmin = true;
2233 |             }
2234 |         }
2235 |         
2236 |         String r;
2237 |         if (isAdmin && !msg.getFromUserId().equals(me.getUserId())) {
2238 |             Message deleted = MessageService.getInstance().adminDeleteMessage(messageId, me.getUserId());
2239 |             r = deleted != null ? "ok" : "not_found";
2240 |         } else {
2241 |             r = MessageService.getInstance().recallMessage(messageId, me.getUserId(), isAdmin);
2242 |         }
2243 |         
2244 |         switch (r) {
2245 |             case "ok": {
2246 |                 Message recalled = MessageService.getInstance().getById(messageId);
2247 |                 Map<String, Object> evData = new LinkedHashMap<>();
2248 |                 evData.put("messageId", messageId);
2249 |                 evData.put("room", recalled != null ? recalled.getChatRoomId() : "");
2250 |                 pushEvent("recall", evData);
2251 |                 sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "true"));
2252 |                 break;
2253 |             }
2254 |             case "not_owner":
2255 |                 sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "false", "error", "只能撤回自己的消息"));
2256 |                 break;
2257 |             case "timeout":
2258 |                 sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "false", "error", "超过10分钟无法撤回"));
2259 |                 break;
2260 |             default:
2261 |                 sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "false", "error", "消息不存在"));
2262 |                 break;
2263 |         }
2264 |     }

2400 |     private void handlePostMoment(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
2401 |         if (me == null) {
2402 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
2403 |             return;
2404 |         }
2405 |         if (me.isFeatureBanned("moment") || me.isFeatureBanned("moments")) {
2406 |             sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "动态功能已被封禁"));
2407 |             return;
2408 |         }
2409 |         Map<String, Object> p = parseJsonObj(body);
2410 |         String content = (String) p.get("content"), vis = (String) p.getOrDefault("visibility", "public");
2411 |         @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
2412 |         List<String> allowed = (List<String>) p.get("allowedViewers");
2413 |         if (content == null || content.trim().isEmpty()) {
2414 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "内容不能为空"));
2415 |             return;
2416 |         }
2417 |         String trimmedContent = content.trim();
2418 |         if (countLines(trimmedContent) > 4000) {
2419 |             byte[] bytes = trimmedContent.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
2420 |             try {
2421 |                 if (!CloudService.getInstance().canStore(me, bytes.length)) {
2422 |                     sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "云盘空间已满，无法存储"));
2423 |                     return;
2424 |                 }
2425 |                 try (ByteArrayInputStream input = new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes)) {
2426 |                     StoredFileMetadata stored = FileStore.getInstance().store(input, "pasted.txt", "text/plain; charset=UTF-8", me.getUserId());
2427 |                     String fileMsgContent = "📋 超长内容已自动保存为文件";
2428 |                     Moment.Attachment att = new Moment.Attachment();
2429 |                     att.setType("file");
2430 |                     att.setFilePath(stored.getAccessPath());
2431 |                     att.setFileName("pasted.txt");
2432 |                     Moment moment = MomentService.getInstance().post(me.getUserId(), me.getNickname(), fileMsgContent, vis, allowed, List.of(att));
2433 |                     sendJson(ex, 200, momentToMap(moment));
2434 |                     return;
2435 |                 }
2436 |             } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
2437 |                 sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", e.getMessage()));
2438 |                 return;
2439 |             } catch (Exception e) {
2440 |                 sendJson(ex, 500, map("error", "保存 pasted.txt 失败: " + e.getMessage()));
2441 |                 return;
2442 |             }
2443 |         }
2444 |         sendJson(ex, 200,
2445 |                 momentToMap(MomentService.getInstance().post(me.getUserId(), me.getNickname(), trimmedContent, vis,
2446 |                         allowed)));
2447 |     }

2826 |     private void handleCreateGame(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {

2832 |             String today = java.time.LocalDate.now(java.time.ZoneId.of("Asia/Shanghai")).toString();
2833 |             if (!today.equals(me.getGameUploadDay())) {
2834 |                 me.setGameUploadDay(today);
2835 |                 me.setDailyGameUploads(0);
2836 |             }
2837 |             int limit = me.getDailyGameUploadLimitByLevel();
2838 |             if (limit != Integer.MAX_VALUE && me.getDailyGameUploads() >= limit) {
2839 |                 sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "今日游戏上传数量已达上限(" + limit + "个)，升级可提升限额"));

2850 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "参数不完整"));
