3374 |     private void handleRenameCloudEntry(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException { handleCloudEntryMutation(ex, me, body, "rename"); }
3375 |     private void handleDeleteCloudEntry(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException { handleCloudEntryMutation(ex, me, body, "delete"); }
3376 |     private void handleRestoreCloudEntry(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException { handleCloudEntryMutation(ex, me, body, "restore"); }
3377 |     private void handlePurgeCloudEntry(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException { handleCloudEntryMutation(ex, me, body, "purge"); }

3380 |     private void handleCloudEntryMutation(HttpExchange ex, User me, String body, String op) throws IOException {
3381 |         if (me == null) { sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录")); return; }
3382 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
3383 |         String entryId = p.get("entryId");
3384 |         if (entryId == null || entryId.trim().isEmpty()) { sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "缺少条目ID")); return; }
3385 |         try {
3386 |             Object res;
3387 |             switch (op) {
3388 |                 case "rename": res = cloudEntryToMap(CloudService.getInstance().renameEntry(me.getUserId(), entryId, p.get("name"))); break;
3389 |                 case "delete": CloudService.getInstance().deleteEntry(me.getUserId(), entryId); res = map("success", "true"); break;
3390 |                 case "restore": CloudService.getInstance().restoreEntry(me.getUserId(), entryId); res = map("success", "true"); break;
3391 |                 case "purge": CloudService.getInstance().permanentlyDelete(me.getUserId(), entryId); res = map("success", "true"); break;
3392 |                 default: res = cloudEntryToMap(CloudService.getInstance().moveEntry(me.getUserId(), entryId, p.get("parentPath"))); break;
3393 |             }
3394 |             sendJson(ex, 200, res);
3395 |         } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
3396 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", e.getMessage()));
3397 |         }
3398 |     }

3400 |     private void handleImportStoredCloudFile(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
3401 |         if (me == null) { sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录")); return; }
3402 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
3403 |         String filePath = p.get("filePath");
3404 |         StoredFileMetadata metadata = metadataFromPath(filePath);
3405 |         if (metadata == null) { sendJson(ex, 404, map("error", "源文件不存在")); return; }
3406 |         if (!CloudService.getInstance().canStore(me, metadata.getSize())) {
3407 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "云盘空间不足"));
3408 |             return;
3409 |         }
3410 |         String taskId = "cloud_upload_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
3411 |         CloudService.getInstance().upsertTask(me.getUserId(), taskId, "upload", "上传文件到云盘", "running",
3412 |                 metadata.getSize(), 0, 0, "正在写入云盘");
3413 |         try {
3414 |             CloudEntry entry = CloudService.getInstance().storeUserFile(me, metadata, p.get("parentPath"),
3415 |                     p.get("fileName") != null ? p.get("fileName") : metadata.getOriginalFileName(), "cloud");
3416 |             CloudService.getInstance().upsertTask(me.getUserId(), taskId, "upload", "上传文件到云盘", "done",
3417 |                     metadata.getSize(), metadata.getSize(), metadata.getSize(), "上传完成");
3418 |             sendJson(ex, 200, cloudEntryToMap(entry));
3419 |         } catch (Exception e) {
3420 |             CloudService.getInstance().upsertTask(me.getUserId(), taskId, "upload", "上传文件到云盘", "failed",
3421 |                     metadata.getSize(), 0, 0, e.getMessage());
3422 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", e.getMessage()));
3423 |         }
3424 |     }

3521 |     private void handleExtractMusicMeta(HttpExchange ex, String query, User me) throws IOException {
3522 |         if (me == null || !isSuperAdmin(me.getUserId())) { sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "无权限")); return; }
3523 |         Map<String, String> params = parseQuery(query);
3524 |         String filePath = params.get("filePath");
3525 |         if (filePath == null || filePath.trim().isEmpty()) { sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "缺少filePath")); return; }
3526 |         String storedName = filePath.startsWith("/files/") ? filePath.substring("/files/".length()) : filePath;
3527 |         if (storedName.contains("..") || storedName.contains(":") || storedName.startsWith("/") || storedName.startsWith("\\") || java.nio.file.Paths.get(storedName).isAbsolute()) {
3528 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "非法的文件路径或存在路径穿越风险"));
3529 |             return;
3530 |         }
3531 |         if (!canAccessFile(storedName, me)) {
3532 |             sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "无权访问该私密音频文件"));
3533 |             return;
3534 |         }
3535 |         try {
3536 |             java.nio.file.Path localPath = FileStore.getInstance().resolveStoredPath(storedName);
3537 |             if (!java.nio.file.Files.exists(localPath) || !java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(localPath)) { sendJson(ex, 404, map("error", "文件未找到")); return; }
3538 |             Map<String, Object> meta = new LinkedHashMap<>();
3539 |             meta.put("title", "");
3540 |             meta.put("artist", "");
3541 |             meta.put("album", "");
3542 |             meta.put("lyrics", "");
3543 |             meta.put("cover", "");
3544 |             meta.put("hasTitle", false);
3545 |             meta.put("hasArtist", false);
3546 |             meta.put("hasAlbum", false);
3547 |             meta.put("hasCover", false);
3548 |             try {
3549 |                 AudioFile af = AudioFileIO.read(localPath.toFile());
3550 |                 Tag tag = af.getTag();
3551 |                 if (tag != null) {
3552 |                     String title = tag.getFirst(FieldKey.TITLE);
3553 |                     String artist = tag.getFirst(FieldKey.ARTIST);
3554 |                     String album = tag.getFirst(FieldKey.ALBUM);
3555 |                     String lyrics = tag.getFirst(FieldKey.LYRICS);
3556 |                     if (title != null && !title.trim().isEmpty()) { meta.put("title", title.trim()); meta.put("hasTitle", true); }
3557 |                     if (artist != null && !artist.trim().isEmpty()) { meta.put("artist", artist.trim()); meta.put("hasArtist", true); }
3558 |                     if (album != null && !album.trim().isEmpty()) { meta.put("album", album.trim()); meta.put("hasAlbum", true); }
3559 |                     if (lyrics != null && !lyrics.trim().isEmpty()) { meta.put("lyrics", lyrics.trim()); }
3560 |                     Artwork artwork = tag.getFirstArtwork();
3561 |                     if (artwork != null && artwork.getBinaryData() != null) {
3562 |                         byte[] imgData = artwork.getBinaryData();
3563 |                         String ext = "jpg";
3564 |                         String mime = artwork.getMimeType();
3565 |                         if (mime != null) {
3566 |                             if (mime.contains("png")) ext = "png";
3567 |                             else if (mime.contains("webp")) ext = "webp";
3568 |                         }
3569 |                         String safeStoredName = storedName.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]", "_");
3570 |                         String coverStoredName = "cover_" + safeStoredName + "." + ext;
3571 |                         java.nio.file.Path coverPath = FileStore.getInstance().resolveStoredPath(coverStoredName);
3572 |                         java.nio.file.Files.write(coverPath, imgData);
3573 |                         meta.put("cover", "/files/" + coverStoredName);
3574 |                         meta.put("hasCover", true);
3575 |                     }
3576 |                 }
3577 |             } catch (Exception e) {
3578 |                 System.err.println("[MusicMeta] 元数据提取失败: " + e.getMessage());
3579 |             }
3580 |             sendJson(ex, 200, meta);
3581 |         } catch (SecurityException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
3582 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "非法路径穿越请求: " + e.getMessage()));
3583 |         } catch (Exception e) {
3584 |             sendJson(ex, 500, map("error", "元数据提取失败: " + e.getMessage()));
3585 |         }
3586 |     }

3672 |     private void handleSearch(HttpExchange ex, String query, User me) throws IOException {
3673 |         if (me == null) { sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录")); return; }
3674 |         Map<String, String> q = parseQuery(query);
3675 |         String keyword = q.getOrDefault("q", "").trim();
3676 |         String scope = q.getOrDefault("scope", "all"); // users|groups|messages|sent|all
3677 |         String room = q.getOrDefault("room", "");       // 可选：按聊天室筛选
3678 |         if (keyword.isEmpty()) { sendJson(ex, 200, map("users", "[]", "groups", "[]", "messages", "[]")); return; }
3679 |         Map<String, Object> result = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
3680 |         if ("all".equals(scope) || "users".equals(scope)) {
3681 |             List<Map<String, Object>> users = new ArrayList<>();
3682 |             for (User u : UserService.getInstance().getAllUsers()) {
3683 |                 if ((u.getNickname() != null && u.getNickname().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase()))
3684 |                         || (u.getUserId() != null && u.getUserId().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase()))) {
3685 |                     Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
3686 |                     m.put("userId", u.getUserId());
3687 |                     m.put("nickname", u.getNickname());
3688 |                     m.put("avatarPath", u.getAvatarPath());
3689 |                     m.put("levelDisplay", u.getLevelDisplay());
3690 |                     users.add(m);
3691 |                 }
3692 |                 if (users.size() >= 20) break;
3693 |             }
3694 |             result.put("users", users);
3695 |         }
3696 |         if ("all".equals(scope) || "groups".equals(scope)) {
3697 |             List<Map<String, Object>> groups = new ArrayList<>();
3698 |             for (com.chat.model.Group g : GroupService.getInstance().getAllGroups()) {
3699 |                 if ((g.getGroupName() != null && g.getGroupName().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase()))
3700 |                         || (g.getGroupId() != null && g.getGroupId().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase()))) {
3701 |                     Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
3702 |                     m.put("groupId", g.getGroupId());
3703 |                     m.put("groupName", g.getGroupName());
3704 |                     m.put("memberCount", g.getMembers() != null ? g.getMembers().size() : 0);
3705 |                     groups.add(m);
3706 |                 }
3707 |                 if (groups.size() >= 20) break;
3708 |             }
3709 |             result.put("groups", groups);
3710 |         }
3711 |         if ("all".equals(scope) || "messages".equals(scope) || "sent".equals(scope)) {
3712 |             List<Map<String, Object>> msgs = new ArrayList<>();
3713 |             for (com.chat.model.Message msg : MessageService.getInstance().searchMessages(keyword, 30)) {
3714 |                 if (!msg.isRecalled() && msg.getContent() != null) {
3715 |                     // "sent" 范围仅搜索自己发送的消息
3716 |                     if ("sent".equals(scope) && !msg.getFromUserId().equals(me.getUserId())) continue;
3717 |                     // 按聊天室筛选
3718 |                     if (!room.isEmpty() && !room.equals(msg.getChatRoomId())) continue;
3719 |                     boolean canSee = "public".equals(msg.getChatRoomId())
3720 |                             || msg.getFromUserId().equals(me.getUserId())
3721 |                             || (msg.getChatRoomId() != null && msg.getChatRoomId().startsWith("private_") && msg.getChatRoomId().contains(me.getUserId()))
3722 |                             || (msg.getChatRoomId() != null && msg.getChatRoomId().startsWith("group_") && GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(msg.getChatRoomId().substring(6)) != null && GroupService.getInstance().getGroup(msg.getChatRoomId().substring(6)).isMember(me.getUserId()));
3723 |                     if (canSee) {
3724 |                         Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
3725 |                         m.put("id", msg.getId());
3726 |                         m.put("content", msg.getContent().length() > 100 ? msg.getContent().substring(0, 100) + "..." : msg.getContent());
3727 |                         m.put("chatRoomId", msg.getChatRoomId());
3728 |                         m.put("fromNickname", msg.getFromNickname());
3729 |                         m.put("fromUserId", msg.getFromUserId());
3730 |                         m.put("timestamp", msg.getTimestamp());
3731 |                         m.put("msgType", msg.getMsgType());
3732 |                         msgs.add(m);
3733 |                     }
3734 |                 }
3735 |                 if (msgs.size() >= 20) break;
3736 |             }
3737 |             result.put("messages", msgs);
3738 |         }
3739 |         if ("all".equals(scope) || "ai".equals(scope)) {
3740 |             List<Map<String, Object>> aiConvs = new ArrayList<>();
3741 |             for (com.chat.model.AiConversation c : AiService.getInstance().listConversations(me.getUserId())) {
3742 |                 if (c.getTitle() != null && c.getTitle().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase())) {
3743 |                     Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
3744 |                     m.put("id", c.getId());
3745 |                     m.put("title", c.getTitle());
3746 |                     m.put("type", c.getType());
3747 |                     m.put("modelId", c.getModelId());
3748 |                     m.put("updatedAt", c.getUpdatedAt());
3749 |                     aiConvs.add(m);
3750 |                 }
3751 |                 if (aiConvs.size() >= 20) break;
3752 |             }
3753 |             result.put("aiConversations", aiConvs);
3754 |         }
3755 |         sendJson(ex, 200, result);
3756 |     }

3865 |             int promptTokens = estimateConversationTokens(conversation, contextMessages)
3866 |                     + attachments.stream().mapToInt(item -> 256).sum();

3872 |             }

3875 |             }

3877 |             String content = asString(streamed.get("content"));

3883 |             AiService.getInstance().addUsage(me, resolvedModelId, "chat", promptTokens, completionTokens, weightedTokens);
3884 |             AiMessage message = AiService.getInstance().addMessage(conversationId, "assistant", "text",
3885 |                     content, reasoningContent.isEmpty() ? null : reasoningContent, null, resolvedModelId, promptTokens, completionTokens, weightedTokens);
3886 |             if ("新标签".equals(conversation.getTitle())) {

3888 |             }
3889 |             conversation.setModelId(resolvedModelId);
3890 |             AiService.getInstance().updateConversation(conversation);
3891 |             Map<String, Object> doneMsg = new LinkedHashMap<>();

3901 |                             ? -1

3947 |                 sendJson(ex, 200, video);
3948 |                 return;

4097 |     private void handleAddSuperAdmin(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
4098 |         if (me == null) {
4099 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
4100 |             return;
4101 |         }
4102 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
4103 |         String targetUserId = p.get("targetUserId");
4104 |         String role = p.getOrDefault("role", "admin"); // "coowner" or "admin"
4105 |         
4106 |         boolean iAmPrimary = isPrimarySuperAdmin(me.getUserId());
4107 |         boolean iAmCoOwner = superAdminService.isCoOwner(me.getUserId());
4108 |         
4109 |         if (!iAmPrimary && !iAmCoOwner) {
4110 |             sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "无权限添加管理员"));
4111 |             return;
4112 |         }
4113 |         
4114 |         if ("coowner".equals(role) && !iAmPrimary) {
4115 |             sendJson(ex, 403, map("error", "仅服主可添加副服主"));
4116 |             return;
4117 |         }
4118 | 
4119 |         if (targetUserId == null || targetUserId.trim().isEmpty()) {
4120 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "请输入用户ID"));
4121 |             return;
4122 |         }
4123 |         if (UserService.getInstance().getByUserId(targetUserId) == null) {
4124 |             sendJson(ex, 404, map("error", "用户不存在"));
4125 |             return;
4126 |         }
4127 |         
4128 |         boolean ok = false;
4129 |         if ("coowner".equals(role)) {
4130 |             ok = superAdminService.addCoOwner(targetUserId.trim());
4131 |         } else {
4132 |             ok = superAdminService.addSuperAdmin(targetUserId.trim());
4133 |         }
4134 |         
4135 |         if (ok) UserService.getInstance().ensurePrimarySuperAdminLevel();
4136 |         sendJson(ex, ok ? 200 : 400, ok ? map("success", "true") : map("error", "该用户已是目标身份"));

4489 |     private void handleDecodeQR(HttpExchange ex, String body, User me) throws IOException {
4490 |         if (me == null) {
4491 |             sendJson(ex, 401, map("error", "未登录"));
4492 |             return;
4493 |         }
4494 |         Map<String, String> p = parseJson(body);
4495 |         String imageData = p.get("image");
4496 |         if (imageData == null || imageData.trim().isEmpty()) {
4497 |             sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "请提供图片数据"));
4498 |             return;
4499 |         }
4500 |         try {
4501 |             if (imageData.contains(",")) {
4502 |                 imageData = imageData.substring(imageData.indexOf(",") + 1);
4503 |             }
4504 |             byte[] imgBytes = Base64.getDecoder().decode(imageData);
4505 |             BufferedImage img;
4506 |             try (InputStream bais = new ByteArrayInputStream(imgBytes)) {
4507 |                 img = ImageIO.read(bais);
4508 |             }
4509 |             if (img == null) {
4510 |                 sendJson(ex, 400, map("error", "无法解析图片"));
4511 |                 return;
4512 |             }
4513 |             LuminanceSource source = new BufferedImageLuminanceSource(img);
4514 |             BinaryBitmap bitmap = new BinaryBitmap(new HybridBinarizer(source));
4515 |             Result result = new MultiFormatReader().decode(bitmap);
4516 |             sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "true", "text", result.getText()));
4517 |         } catch (NotFoundException e) {
4518 |             sendJson(ex, 200, map("success", "false", "error", "未识别到二维码"));
4519 |         } catch (Exception e) {
4520 |             sendJson(ex, 500, map("error", "解码失败: " + e.getMessage()));
4521 |         }
4522 |     }

4625 |     private int estimateTokens(String text) {
4626 |         return Math.max(1, (String.valueOf(text).length() + 3) / 4);
4627 |     }
4628 | 
4629 |     private double buildWeightedTokens(Map<String, Object> model, int promptTokens, int completionTokens) {
4630 |         double in = parseDouble(String.valueOf(model != null ? model.get("inputRatio") : 1), 1);
4631 |         double out = parseDouble(String.valueOf(model != null ? model.get("outputRatio") : 1), 1);
4632 |         return promptTokens * in + completionTokens * out;
4633 |     }
4634 | 
4635 |     private double estimateVideoWeightedTokens(Map<String, Object> model, double durationSec) {
4636 |         double out = parseDouble(String.valueOf(model != null ? model.get("outputRatio") : 8), 8);
4637 |         return Math.max(2, durationSec) * out * 1000D;
4638 |     }

4674 |             String imageSize = asString(imageOptions.getOrDefault("size", conversation.getImageSize()));

4679 |                     int w = Integer.parseInt(parts[0].trim()), h = Integer.parseInt(parts[1].trim());
4680 |                     if (w * h < 3686400) imageSize = "1920x1920";
4681 |                 } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { imageSize = "1920x1920"; }
4682 |             } else {
4683 |                 imageSize = "1920x1920";
4684 |             }
4685 |             String imageStyle = asString(imageOptions.getOrDefault("style", conversation.getImageStyle()));

4690 |             }
4691 |             if (weightedTokens > ar * 0.6) {
4692 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException("\u9884\u4F30\u70B9\u6570\u4E0D\u8DB3\uFF0C\u65E0\u6CD5\u751F\u6210\u3002\u9700\u8981 " + Math.round(weightedTokens) + " \u70B9\uFF0C\u5269\u4F59 " + Math.round(ar) + " \u70B9\u3002");
4693 |             }
4694 |             AiMediaTask task = AiService.getInstance().createTask(me.getUserId(), conversationId, "image", modelId, prompt, weightedTokens);
4695 |             task.setStatus("running");
4696 |             AiService.getInstance().updateTask(task);

4698 |             String outputPath = asString(imageResult.get("url"));
4699 |             Map<String, Object> usage = asObjectMap(imageResult.get("usage"));
4700 |             task.setStatus("done");
4701 |             task.setOutputPath(outputPath);
4702 |             task.setFinalTokens(parseDouble(asString(usage.get("total_tokens")), weightedTokens));
4703 |             AiService.getInstance().updateTask(task);
4704 |             AiService.getInstance().addUsage(me, modelId, "image", 0, imageCount, task.getFinalTokens());

4706 |                     "图片生成完成\n尺寸：" + (imageSize.isEmpty() ? "默认" : imageSize) + "\n风格：" + (imageStyle.isEmpty() ? "通用" : imageStyle),

4710 |         } else if ("video".equals(type)) {

4712 |             double duration = Math.max(1, parseDouble(asString(videoOptions.getOrDefault("duration", conversation.getVideoDuration())), 5));
4713 |             String size = asString(videoOptions.getOrDefault("size", conversation.getVideoSize()));
4714 |             long seed = parseLong(asString(videoOptions.getOrDefault("seed", conversation.getVideoSeed())), 0);
4715 |             String firstFramePath = asString(videoOptions.getOrDefault("firstFramePath", conversation.getVideoFirstFramePath()));
4716 |             String lastFramePath = asString(videoOptions.getOrDefault("lastFramePath", conversation.getVideoLastFramePath()));
4717 |             double weightedTokens = estimateVideoWeightedTokens(model, duration);

4722 |             if (weightedTokens > ar * 0.6) {

4776 |     private List<AiMessage> stripCurrentAiPrompt(List<AiMessage> history, int attachmentCount) {
4777 |         if (history == null || history.isEmpty()) return Collections.emptyList();
4778 |         int trim = Math.max(1, 1 + Math.max(0, attachmentCount));
4779 |         if (history.size() <= trim) return Collections.emptyList();
4780 |         return new ArrayList<>(history.subList(0, history.size() - trim));
4781 |     }
4782 | 
4783 |     private List<AiMessage> pickAiContextMessages(List<AiMessage> history, AiConversation conversation) {
4784 |         int maxItems = Math.max(1, conversation != null ? conversation.getContextCount() : 10);
4785 |         int tokenBudget = 4000;
4786 |         List<AiMessage> reversed = new ArrayList<>(history == null ? Collections.emptyList() : history);
4787 |         Collections.reverse(reversed);
4788 |         List<AiMessage> selected = new ArrayList<>();
4789 |         int used = estimateTokens(conversation != null ? conversation.getSystemPrompt() : "");
4790 |         for (AiMessage message : reversed) {
4791 |             int cost = estimateTokens(message.getContent()) + ("image".equals(message.getType()) ? 256 : 0);
4792 |             if (!selected.isEmpty() && (selected.size() >= maxItems || used + cost > tokenBudget)) {
4793 |                 continue;
4794 |             }
4795 |             selected.add(message);
4796 |             used += cost;
4797 |         }
4798 |         Collections.reverse(selected);
4799 |         return selected;
4800 |     }
4801 | 
4802 |     private int estimateConversationTokens(AiConversation conversation, List<AiMessage> messages) {
4803 |         int tokens = estimateTokens(conversation != null ? conversation.getSystemPrompt() : "");
4804 |         for (AiMessage message : messages) {
4805 |             tokens += estimateTokens(message.getContent());
4806 |             if ("image".equals(message.getType())) tokens += 256;
4807 |         }
4808 |         return Math.max(tokens, 1);
4809 |     }

4811 |     private List<String> splitAiContent(String text, int chunkSize) {
4812 |         List<String> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
4813 |         String value = String.valueOf(text == null ? "" : text);
4814 |         if (value.isEmpty()) {
4815 |             chunks.add("");
4816 |             return chunks;
4817 |         }
4818 |         for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i += Math.max(1, chunkSize)) {
4819 |             chunks.add(value.substring(i, Math.min(value.length(), i + Math.max(1, chunkSize))));
4820 |         }
4821 |         return chunks;
4822 |     }

4824 |     private double estimateImageWeightedTokens(String modelId, String size, int imageCount) {
4825 |         if (modelId.contains("3-0")) return 80000D * imageCount;
4826 |         if (modelId.contains("4-0")) return 60000D * imageCount;
4827 |         if (modelId.contains("4-5")) return 80000D * imageCount;
4828 |         if (modelId.contains("5-0")) return 74000D * imageCount;
4829 |         return 80000D * imageCount;
4830 |     }

4845 |             ));

4850 |     private Map<String, Object> streamChatCompletion(OutputStream os, String modelId, AiConversation conversation,
4851 |                                                      String prompt, List<Map<String, Object>> attachments,
4852 |                                                      List<AiMessage> contextMessages) {
4853 |         try {
4854 |             String apiUrl = modelId.startsWith("LongCat") ? LONGCAT_API_URL : VOLC_CHAT_API_URL;
4855 |             String apiKey = modelId.startsWith("LongCat") ? LONGCAT_API_KEY : VOLC_API_KEY;
4856 |             Map<String, Object> body = modelId.startsWith("LongCat")
4857 |                     ? buildLongcatChatBody(modelId, conversation, prompt, contextMessages, true)
4858 |                     : buildVolcChatBody(modelId, conversation, prompt, attachments, contextMessages, true);
4859 |             java.net.http.HttpRequest request = java.net.http.HttpRequest.newBuilder(java.net.URI.create(apiUrl))
4860 |                     .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + apiKey)
4861 |                     .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
4862 |                     .POST(java.net.http.HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(JsonUtil.toJson(body), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
4863 |                     .build();
4864 |             java.net.http.HttpResponse<InputStream> response = SHARED_HTTP_CLIENT
4865 |                     .send(request, java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofInputStream());
4866 |             if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
4867 |                 String errorBody = new String(response.body().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
4868 |                 Map<String, Object> errorData = parseJsonObj(errorBody);
4869 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException(asString(asObjectMap(errorData.get("error")).get("message")).isEmpty()
4870 |                         ? asString(errorData.get("message"))
4871 |                         : asString(asObjectMap(errorData.get("error")).get("message")));
4872 |             }
4873 |             StringBuilder content = new StringBuilder();
4874 |             StringBuilder reasoningContent = new StringBuilder();
4875 |             Map<String, Object> usage = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4876 |             try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(response.body(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
4877 |                 String line;
4878 |                 while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
4879 |                     String trimmed = line.trim();
4880 |                     if (!trimmed.startsWith("data:")) continue;
4881 |                     String data = trimmed.substring(5).trim();
4882 |                     if (data.isEmpty() || "[DONE]".equals(data)) continue;
4883 |                     Map<String, Object> event = parseJsonObj(data);
4884 |                     if (!asObjectMap(event.get("usage")).isEmpty()) {
4885 |                         usage = asObjectMap(event.get("usage"));
4886 |                     }
4887 |                     List<Map<String, Object>> choices = asObjectList(event.get("choices"));
4888 |                     if (choices.isEmpty()) continue;
4889 |                     Map<String, Object> delta = asObjectMap(choices.get(0).get("delta"));
4890 |                     String reasoningChunk = asString(delta.get("reasoning_content"));
4891 |                     if (!reasoningChunk.isEmpty()) {
4892 |                         reasoningContent.append(reasoningChunk);
4893 |                         writeJsonLine(os, obj("type", "delta", "reasoning_content", reasoningChunk));
4894 |                     }
4895 |                     String chunk = asString(delta.get("content"));
4896 |                     if (!chunk.isEmpty()) {
4897 |                         for (String piece : splitAiContent(chunk, chunk.length() > 24 ? 2 : 1)) {
4898 |                             content.append(piece);
4899 |                             writeJsonLine(os, obj("type", "delta", "content", piece));
4900 |                         }
4901 |                     }
4902 |                 }
4903 |             }
4904 |             if (usage.isEmpty()) {
4905 |                 usage.put("prompt_tokens", estimateConversationTokens(conversation, contextMessages)
4906 |                         + attachments.stream().mapToInt(item -> 256).sum());
4907 |                 usage.put("completion_tokens", Math.max(16, estimateTokens(content.toString())));
4908 |             }
4909 |             Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4910 |             result.put("content", content.toString());
4911 |             result.put("reasoningContent", reasoningContent.toString());
4912 |             result.put("usage", usage);
4913 |             return result;
4914 |         } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
4915 |             throw e;
4916 |         } catch (Exception e) {
4917 |             Map<String, Object> fallback = generateChatCompletion(modelId, conversation, prompt, attachments, contextMessages);
4918 |             for (String chunk : splitAiContent(asString(fallback.get("content")), 48)) {
4919 |                 try {
4920 |                     writeJsonLine(os, obj("type", "delta", "content", chunk));
4921 |                 } catch (IOException ignored) {
4922 |                 }
4923 |             }
4924 |             return fallback;
4925 |         }
4926 |     }

4958 |     private Map<String, Object> buildLongcatChatBody(String modelId, AiConversation conversation, String prompt,
4959 |                                                      List<AiMessage> contextMessages, boolean stream) {
4960 |         List<Map<String, Object>> messages = new ArrayList<>();
4961 |         if (conversation != null && conversation.getSystemPrompt() != null && !conversation.getSystemPrompt().trim().isEmpty()) {
4962 |             messages.add(obj("role", "system", "content", conversation.getSystemPrompt().trim()));
4963 |         }
4964 |         for (AiMessage item : contextMessages) {
4965 |             if (!"text".equals(item.getType())) continue;
4966 |             String msgContent = item.getContent();
4967 |             if (msgContent == null || msgContent.trim().isEmpty()) continue;
4968 |             messages.add(obj("role", item.getRole(), "content", msgContent));
4969 |         }
4970 |         messages.add(obj("role", "user", "content", prompt));
4971 |         Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
4972 |         body.put("model", modelId);
4973 |         body.put("messages", messages);
4974 |         body.put("stream", stream);
4975 |         if (conversation != null && conversation.getMaxTokens() > 0) body.put("max_tokens", conversation.getMaxTokens());
4976 |         if (conversation != null) {
4977 |             body.put("temperature", conversation.getTemperature());
4978 |             body.put("top_p", conversation.getTopP());
4979 |         }
4980 |         return body;
4981 |     }

4983 |     private Map<String, Object> buildVolcChatBody(String modelId, AiConversation conversation, String prompt,
4984 |                                                   List<Map<String, Object>> attachments, List<AiMessage> contextMessages,
4985 |                                                   boolean stream) {
4986 |         // 检查模型是否支持图片（纯文本模型如DeepSeek/GLM需要content为string格式）
4987 |         Map<String, Object> modelInfo = AiService.getInstance().listModels().stream()
4988 |                 .filter(m -> Objects.equals(String.valueOf(m.get("id")), modelId))
4989 |                 .findFirst().orElse(null);
4990 |         boolean supportsImage = modelInfo != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(modelInfo.get("supportsImage"));
4991 | 
4992 |         List<Map<String, Object>> messages = new ArrayList<>();
4993 |         if (conversation != null && conversation.getSystemPrompt() != null && !conversation.getSystemPrompt().trim().isEmpty()) {
4994 |             messages.add(obj("role", "system", "content", conversation.getSystemPrompt().trim()));
4995 |         }
4996 |         for (AiMessage item : contextMessages) {
4997 |             if ("assistant".equals(item.getRole()) && "text".equals(item.getType())) {
4998 |                 String msgContent = item.getContent();
4999 |                 if (msgContent == null || msgContent.trim().isEmpty()) continue;
5000 |                 messages.add(obj("role", "assistant", "content", msgContent));
5001 |             } else if ("user".equals(item.getRole())) {
5002 |                 if (!supportsImage) {
5003 |                     // 纯文本模型：content 使用字符串格式
5004 |                     String text = "";
5005 |                     if (item.getContent() != null && !item.getContent().trim().isEmpty()) {
5006 |                         text = item.getContent();
5007 |                     }
5008 |                     if (!text.isEmpty()) {
5009 |                         messages.add(obj("role", "user", "content", text));
5010 |                     }
5011 |                 } else {
5012 |                     // 多模态模型：content 使用数组格式
5013 |                     List<Map<String, Object>> content = new ArrayList<>();
5014 |                     if ("image".equals(item.getType()) && item.getFilePath() != null) {
5015 |                         content.add(obj("type", "image_url",
5016 |                                 "image_url", obj("url", absoluteUrl(item.getFilePath()), "detail", "high")));
5017 |                         if (item.getContent() != null && !item.getContent().trim().isEmpty()) {
5018 |                             content.add(obj("type", "text", "text", item.getContent()));
5019 |                         }
5020 |                     } else if (item.getContent() != null && !item.getContent().trim().isEmpty()) {
5021 |                         content.add(obj("type", "text", "text", item.getContent()));
5022 |                     }
5023 |                     if (!content.isEmpty()) {
5024 |                         messages.add(obj("role", "user", "content", content));
5025 |                     }
5026 |                 }
5027 |             }
5028 |         }
5029 | 
5030 |         if (!supportsImage && (attachments == null || attachments.isEmpty())) {
5031 |             // 纯文本模型：当前 prompt 直接使用字符串
5032 |             if (prompt != null && !prompt.trim().isEmpty()) {
5033 |                 messages.add(obj("role", "user", "content", prompt));
5034 |             }
5035 |         } else {
5036 |             // 多模态模型或有附件：使用数组格式
5037 |             List<Map<String, Object>> userContent = new ArrayList<>();
5038 |             if (attachments != null) {
5039 |                 for (Map<String, Object> attachment : attachments) {
5040 |                     String filePath = asString(attachment.get("filePath"));
5041 |                     if (filePath.isEmpty()) continue;
5042 |                     if (supportsImage) {
5043 |                         userContent.add(obj("type", "image_url",
5044 |                                 "image_url", obj("url", absoluteUrl(filePath), "detail", "high")));
5045 |                     }
5046 |                 }
5047 |             }
5048 |             if (prompt != null && !prompt.trim().isEmpty()) {
5049 |                 userContent.add(obj("type", "text", "text", prompt));
5050 |             }
5051 |             if (!userContent.isEmpty()) {
5052 |                 messages.add(obj("role", "user", "content", userContent));
5053 |             }
5054 |         }
5055 | 
5056 |         Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
5057 |         body.put("model", modelId);
5058 |         body.put("messages", messages);
5059 |         body.put("stream", stream);
5060 |         Map<String, Object> streamOpts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
5061 |         streamOpts.put("include_usage", true);
5062 |         body.put("stream_options", streamOpts);
5063 | 
5064 |         // 纯文本模型(DeepSeek)使用 max_tokens，多模态模型使用 max_completion_tokens
5065 |         if (conversation != null && conversation.getMaxTokens() > 0) {
5066 |             if (!supportsImage && (modelId.startsWith("deepseek") || modelId.startsWith("glm"))) {
5067 |                 body.put("max_tokens", conversation.getMaxTokens());
5068 |             } else {
5069 |                 body.put("max_completion_tokens", conversation.getMaxTokens());
5070 |             }
5071 |         }
5072 | 
5073 |         // 推理深度
5074 |         boolean supportsThinking = modelInfo != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(modelInfo.get("supportsThinking"));
5075 |         if (supportsThinking && conversation != null && conversation.getReasoningDepth() != null && !"default".equals(conversation.getReasoningDepth())) {
5076 |             if (modelId.startsWith("glm-")) {
5077 |                 Map<String, Object> thinking = new LinkedHashMap<>();
5078 |                 if ("minimal".equals(conversation.getReasoningDepth())) {
5079 |                     thinking.put("type", "disabled");
5080 |                 } else {
5081 |                     thinking.put("type", "enabled");
5082 |                 }
5083 |                 body.put("thinking", thinking);
5084 |             } else if (!modelId.startsWith("deepseek-r1")) {
5085 |                 // DeepSeek-R1 使用自有机制，不发送 reasoning_effort
5086 |                 body.put("reasoning_effort", conversation.getReasoningDepth());
5087 |             }
5088 |         }
5089 |         return body;
5090 |     }

5118 |                         String ext = cdnUrl.contains(".png") ? ".png" : ".jpg";
5119 |                         StoredFileMetadata meta = FileStore.getInstance().store(
5120 |                                 dlResp.body(), "ai_image_" + System.currentTimeMillis() + ext,

5122 |                         url = "/files/" + meta.getStoredName();
5123 |                     }
5124 |                 } catch (Exception dlErr) {
5125 |                     System.err.println("[AI] 图片下载到本地失败: " + dlErr.getMessage());
5126 |                 }
5127 |             }
5128 |             Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
5129 |             result.put("url", url);
5130 |             result.put("usage", asObjectMap(resp.get("usage")));
5131 |             return result;
5132 |         } catch (Exception e) {
5133 |             throw new IOException(e.getMessage(), e);
5134 |         }
5135 |     }

5153 |     private List<Map<String, Object>> buildVideoContents(String prompt, String firstFramePath, String lastFramePath) {
5154 |         List<Map<String, Object>> content = new ArrayList<>();
5155 |         if (prompt != null && !prompt.trim().isEmpty()) {

5175 |     private Map<String, Object> postJson(String url, String apiKey, Map<String, Object> body) throws Exception {
5176 |         java.net.http.HttpRequest request = java.net.http.HttpRequest.newBuilder(java.net.URI.create(url))
5177 |                 .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + apiKey)
5178 |                 .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
5179 |                 .POST(java.net.http.HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(JsonUtil.toJson(body), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
5180 |                 .build();
5181 |         java.net.http.HttpResponse<String> response = SHARED_HTTP_CLIENT
5182 |                 .send(request, java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
5183 |         Map<String, Object> data = parseJsonObj(response.body());
5184 |         if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
5185 |             throw new IllegalArgumentException(asString(asObjectMap(data.get("error")).get("message")).isEmpty()
5186 |                     ? asString(data.get("message"))
5187 |                     : asString(asObjectMap(data.get("error")).get("message")));
5188 |         }
5189 |         return data;
5190 |     }

5196 |                 .build();

5198 |                 .send(request, java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
5199 |         Map<String, Object> data = parseJsonObj(response.body());

5201 |             throw new IllegalArgumentException(asString(asObjectMap(data.get("error")).get("message")));

5203 |         return data;
5204 |     }

5206 |     private void refreshAiProviderTasks(String userId) {
5207 |         for (AiMediaTask task : AiService.getInstance().listTasks(userId)) {
5208 |             if (!"video".equals(task.getTaskType()) || task.getProviderTaskId() == null || task.getProviderTaskId().trim().isEmpty()) continue;
5209 |             if ("done".equals(task.getStatus()) || "succeeded".equals(task.getStatus())
5210 |                     || "failed".equals(task.getStatus()) || "cancelled".equals(task.getStatus())
5211 |                     || "expired".equals(task.getStatus())) continue;
5212 |             try {
5213 |                 Map<String, Object> remote = getJson(VOLC_VIDEO_TASK_API_URL + "/" + URLEncoder.encode(task.getProviderTaskId(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8), VOLC_API_KEY);
5214 |                 String status = asString(remote.get("status"));
5215 |                 if (!status.isEmpty()) task.setStatus(status);
5216 |                 Map<String, Object> usage = asObjectMap(remote.get("usage"));
5217 |                 double oldFinalTokens = task.getFinalTokens();
5218 |                 double newFinalTokens = !usage.isEmpty()
5219 |                         ? parseDouble(asString(usage.get("total_tokens")), oldFinalTokens)
5220 |                         : oldFinalTokens;
5221 |                 task.setFinalTokens(newFinalTokens);
5222 |                 Map<String, Object> output = asObjectMap(remote.get("content"));
5223 |                 if (output.isEmpty()) output = asObjectMap(remote.get("output"));
5224 |                 String videoUrl = asString(output.get("video_url"));
5225 |                 if (videoUrl.isEmpty()) videoUrl = asString(output.get("url"));
5226 |                 if (!videoUrl.isEmpty()) task.setOutputPath(videoUrl);
5227 |                 if (Math.abs(newFinalTokens - oldFinalTokens) > 0.0001D) {
5228 |                     User taskOwner = UserService.getInstance().getByUserId(userId);
5229 |                     if (taskOwner != null) {
5230 |                         AiService.getInstance().addUsage(taskOwner, task.getModelId(), "video-finalize", 0, 0, newFinalTokens - oldFinalTokens);
5231 |                     }
5232 |                 }
5233 |                 if (("succeeded".equals(task.getStatus()) || "done".equals(task.getStatus()))
5234 |                         && task.getOutputPath() != null && !task.getOutputPath().trim().isEmpty()) {
5235 |                     // Auto-download generated video to local storage (7-day expiry workaround)
5236 |                     String op = task.getOutputPath();
5237 |                     if (op.startsWith("http") && !op.contains("/files/")) {
5238 |                         try {
5239 |                             java.net.http.HttpRequest dlReq = java.net.http.HttpRequest.newBuilder()
5240 |                                     .uri(java.net.URI.create(op)).GET().build();
5241 |                             java.net.http.HttpResponse<java.io.InputStream> dlResp = SHARED_HTTP_CLIENT
5242 |                                     .send(dlReq, java.net.http.HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofInputStream());
5243 |                             if (dlResp.statusCode() >= 200 && dlResp.statusCode() < 300) {
5244 |                                 StoredFileMetadata meta = FileStore.getInstance().store(
5245 |                                         dlResp.body(), "video_" + task.getId() + ".mp4", "video/mp4", userId);
5246 |                                 task.setOutputPath("/files/" + meta.getStoredName());
5247 |                             }
5248 |                         } catch (Exception ignored) {}
5249 |                     }
5250 |                     List<AiMessage> existing = AiService.getInstance().listMessages(task.getConversationId());
5251 |                     boolean hasVideoMessage = existing.stream().anyMatch(item ->
5252 |                             "assistant".equals(item.getRole())
5253 |                                     && "video".equals(item.getType())
5254 |                                     && Objects.equals(item.getFilePath(), task.getOutputPath()));
5255 |                     if (!hasVideoMessage) {
5256 |                         AiService.getInstance().addMessage(task.getConversationId(), "assistant", "video",
5257 |                                 "视频生成完成", task.getOutputPath(), task.getModelId(), 0, 1, task.getFinalTokens());
5258 |                     }
5259 |                 }
5260 |                 AiService.getInstance().updateTask(task);
5261 |             } catch (Exception ignored) {
5262 |             }
5263 |         }
5264 |     }

5266 |     private String absoluteUrl(String filePath) {
5267 |         String path = asString(filePath);
5268 |         if (path.startsWith("http://") || path.startsWith("https://") || path.startsWith("data:")) return path;
5269 |         StoredFileMetadata metadata = metadataFromPath(path);
5270 |         if (metadata == null) return path;
5271 |         try (InputStream in = FileStore.getInstance().openStream(metadata.getStoredName())) {
5272 |             String base64 = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(in.readAllBytes());
5273 |             return "data:" + (metadata.getContentType() != null ? metadata.getContentType() : "application/octet-stream")
5274 |                     + ";base64," + base64;
5275 |         } catch (Exception e) {
5276 |             return path;
5277 |         }
5278 |     }

5295 |     private String generateAiConversationTitle(String prompt, String response) {
5296 |         String text = String.valueOf(prompt == null ? "" : prompt).trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
5297 |         if (text.isEmpty()) return "新标签";
5298 |         String respText = String.valueOf(response == null ? "" : response).trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
5299 |         String combined = respText.isEmpty() ? text : text + "\n" + respText;
5300 |         try {
5301 |             java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService executor = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
5302 |             java.util.concurrent.Future<String> future = executor.submit(() -> {
5303 |                 Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
5304 |                 body.put("model", "LongCat-Flash-Lite");
5305 |                 List<Map<String, Object>> msgs = new ArrayList<>();
5306 |                 msgs.add(obj("role", "system", "content", "你是一个标题生成助手。根据对话内容（用户问题和AI回答），生成一个简短的中文会话标题（不超过8个字）。只返回标题本身，不要解释，不要标点。"));
5307 |                 msgs.add(obj("role", "user", "content", "用户：" + text));
5308 |                 if (!respText.isEmpty()) {
5309 |                     msgs.add(obj("role", "assistant", "content", respText));
5310 |                 }
5311 |                 body.put("messages", msgs);
5312 |                 body.put("stream", false);
5313 |                 body.put("max_tokens", 32);
5314 |                 Map<String, Object> resp = postJson(LONGCAT_API_URL, LONGCAT_API_KEY, body);
5315 |                 List<Map<String, Object>> choices = asObjectList(resp.get("choices"));
5316 |                 if (!choices.isEmpty()) {
5317 |                     String title = asString(asObjectMap(choices.get(0).get("message")).get("content")).trim();
5318 |                     if (!title.isEmpty()) return title;
5319 |                 }
5320 |                 return null;
5321 |             });
5322 |             String title = future.get(3, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS);
5323 |             executor.shutdownNow();
5324 |             if (title != null && !title.isEmpty() && !"null".equals(title)) {
5325 |                 return title.length() > 18 ? title.substring(0, 18) + "..." : title;
5326 |             }
5327 |         } catch (Exception e) {
5328 |             // Fall through to fallback
5329 |         }
5330 |         return text.length() > 18 ? text.substring(0, 18) + "..." : text;
5331 |     }

5903 |     private String loginAnnouncementScript() {
5904 |         return "let loginAnnouncementItems=[];let loginAnnouncementActiveId='';"
5905 |                 + "function loginAnnEsc(v){return String(v==null?'':v).replace(/[&<>\\\"']/g,m=>({\"&\":\"&amp;\",\"<\":\"&lt;\",\">\":\"&gt;\",\"\\\"\":\"&quot;\",\"'\":\"&#39;\"}[m]||m));}"

5909 |                 + "function renderLoginAnnouncementCards(items){const list=document.getElementById('loginAnnList');if(!list)return;list.innerHTML=Array.isArray(items)&&items.length?items.map(item=>'<button type=\"button\" class=\"login-ann-item '+(item.id===loginAnnouncementActiveId?'active':'')+'\" onclick=\"selectLoginAnnouncement(\\''+loginAnnEsc(item.id)+'\\')\"><div class=\"login-ann-item-title\">'+loginAnnEsc(item.title||'系统公告')+'</div><div class=\"login-ann-item-meta\">'+loginAnnFmt(item.updatedAt||item.createdAt)+'<br>@'+loginAnnEsc(item.authorNickname||'系统')+'</div></button>').join(''):'<div class=\"login-ann-empty\">当前还没有公告</div>';}"

6249 |     private String topbar(User user) {
6250 |         String av = user.getAvatarPath() != null && !user.getAvatarPath().isEmpty()
6251 |                 ? "<img src='" + eH(user.getAvatarPath())
6252 |                         + "' style='width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5)'>"
6253 |                 : "<div style='width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:700'>"
6254 |                         + eH(String.valueOf(user.getNickname().charAt(0)).toUpperCase()) + "</div>";
6255 |         String badges = "";
6256 |         if (isPrimarySuperAdmin(user.getUserId())) {
6257 |             badges += " <span class='owner-b'>服主</span>";
6258 |         }
6259 |         if (isSuperAdmin(user.getUserId())) {
6260 |             badges += " <span class='sa-b'>⭐超管</span>";
6261 |         }
6262 |         String levelBadge = " <span class='lv-badge lv-" + user.getEffectiveLevel() + "'>" + eJ(user.getLevelDisplay()) + "</span>";
6263 |         return "<div class='topbar'>"
6264 |                 + "<div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px'><span style='font-size:22px'>💬</span><h1>聊天</h1></div>"

6267 |                 + "<button class='tb-btn' onclick='openSearch()' title='搜索'>🔍</button>"
6268 |                 + "<div class='tb-user'>" + av
6269 |                 + "<span>" + eH(user.getNickname()) + badges + levelBadge
6270 |                 + "</span></div>"
6271 |                 + (isSuperAdmin(user.getUserId())
6272 |                 ? "<button class='tb-btn' onclick='openServerAdmin()'>服务器管理</button>" : "")

0284 |     public double getRemainingTokens(User user) {

0286 |         if (SuperAdminService.getInstance().getPrimarySuperAdminId() != null
0287 |                 && SuperAdminService.getInstance().getPrimarySuperAdminId().equals(user.getUserId())) {
0288 |             return Double.MAX_VALUE;

0290 |         String day = LocalDate.now(ZONE).toString();
0291 |         refreshUserUsageDay(user, day);
0292 |         double limit = user.getAiDailyLimitByLevel();
0293 |         if (limit == Double.MAX_VALUE) return Double.MAX_VALUE;
0294 |         return Math.max(0, limit - user.getAiUsedTokensToday());
0295 |     }

0631 |             lock.readLock().unlock();
0632 |         }

0635 |     public CloudEntry unzipEntry(User user, String entryId) {
0636 |         if (user == null) {
0637 |             throw new IllegalArgumentException("未登录");
0638 |         }
0639 |         String taskId = "cloud_unzip_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
0640 |         upsertTask(user.getUserId(), taskId, "unzip", "解压压缩包", "running", 0, 0, 0, "正在读取压缩包");
0641 |         lock.writeLock().lock();
0642 |         try {
0643 |             CloudEntry source = findEntryUnsafe(entryId);
0644 |             if (source == null || !Objects.equals(source.getOwnerId(), user.getUserId()) || source.isFolder()) {
0645 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException("压缩文件不存在");
0646 |             }
0647 |             if (source.getStoredName() == null || !String.valueOf(source.getName()).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".zip")) {
0648 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException("仅支持解压 ZIP 文件");
0649 |             }
0650 |             String baseName = source.getName().replaceFirst("(?i)\\.zip$", "");

0652 |             CloudEntry rootFolder = new CloudEntry();

0654 |             rootFolder.setId("cloud_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", ""));
0655 |             rootFolder.setOwnerId(user.getUserId());

0657 |             rootFolder.setName(rootName);
0658 |             rootFolder.setType("folder");
0659 |             rootFolder.setCreatedAt(now);
0660 |             rootFolder.setUpdatedAt(now);
0661 |             rootFolder.setSourceModule("cloud-unzip");
0662 |             entries.add(rootFolder);
0663 | 
0664 |             long totalBytes = 0;
0665 |             long doneBytes = 0;
0666 |             Set<String> createdFolders = new HashSet<>();
0667 |             createdFolders.add(buildEntryPath(rootFolder));
0668 |             try (InputStream raw = openStreamCompat(user.getUserId(), source.getStoredName());
0669 |                  ZipInputStream zis = new ZipInputStream(raw, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
0670 |                 ZipEntry zipEntry;
0671 |                 Path zipBase = Paths.get("zip_tmp").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0672 |                 while ((zipEntry = zis.getNextEntry()) != null) {
0673 |                     String normalizedPath = String.valueOf(zipEntry.getName()).replace("\\", "/");
0674 |                     if (normalizedPath.isEmpty() || normalizedPath.startsWith("/")) {
0675 |                         zis.closeEntry();
0676 |                         continue;
0677 |                     }
0678 |                     Path targetPath = zipBase.resolve(normalizedPath).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
0679 |                     if (!targetPath.startsWith(zipBase)) {
0680 |                         zis.closeEntry();
0681 |                         continue;
0682 |                     }
0683 |                     if (zipEntry.isDirectory()) {
0684 |                         ensureFolderPathUnsafe(user.getUserId(), buildEntryPath(rootFolder), normalizedPath, createdFolders);
0685 |                         zis.closeEntry();
0686 |                         continue;
0687 |                     }
0688 |                     int slash = normalizedPath.lastIndexOf('/');
0689 |                     String relativeParent = slash >= 0 ? normalizedPath.substring(0, slash) : "";
0690 |                     String fileName = slash >= 0 ? normalizedPath.substring(slash + 1) : normalizedPath;
0691 |                     String targetParent = ensureFolderPathUnsafe(user.getUserId(), buildEntryPath(rootFolder), relativeParent, createdFolders);
0692 |                     long[] entrySizeBytes = new long[1];
0693 |                     String storedFileName = storeUserFileStream(user.getUserId(), zis, fileName, entrySizeBytes, user, totalBytes);
0694 |                     long bytesLen = entrySizeBytes[0];
0695 |                     totalBytes += bytesLen;
0696 |                     CloudEntry fileEntry = new CloudEntry();
0697 |                     fileEntry.setId("cloud_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", ""));
0698 |                     fileEntry.setOwnerId(user.getUserId());
0699 |                     fileEntry.setParentPath(targetParent);
0700 |                     fileEntry.setName(resolveDuplicateNameUnsafe(user.getUserId(), targetParent, sanitizeName(fileName)));
0701 |                     fileEntry.setType("file");
0702 |                     fileEntry.setStoredName(storedFileName);
0703 |                     fileEntry.setContentType(guessContentType(fileName));
0704 |                     fileEntry.setSize(bytesLen);
0705 |                     fileEntry.setCreatedAt(System.currentTimeMillis());
0706 |                     fileEntry.setUpdatedAt(System.currentTimeMillis());
0707 |                     fileEntry.setSourceModule("cloud-unzip");
0708 |                     entries.add(fileEntry);
0709 |                     doneBytes += bytesLen;
0710 |                     zis.closeEntry();
0711 |                 }
0712 |             } catch (Exception e) {
0713 |                 rollbackCreatedEntriesUnsafe(user.getUserId(), buildEntryPath(rootFolder));
0714 |                 entries.removeIf(item -> Objects.equals(item.getId(), rootFolder.getId()));
0715 |                 removeTask(user.getUserId(), taskId);
0716 |                 throw e instanceof IllegalArgumentException ? (IllegalArgumentException) e : new IllegalArgumentException("解压失败");
0717 |             }
0718 |             saveUnsafe();
0719 |             upsertTask(user.getUserId(), taskId, "unzip", "解压压缩包", "done", totalBytes, doneBytes, 0, "解压完成");
0720 |             return copyEntry(rootFolder);

0722 |             lock.writeLock().unlock();

0726 |     public CloudEntry compressEntry(User user, String entryId) {

0729 |         }

0732 |         lock.writeLock().lock();

0734 |             CloudEntry source = findEntryUnsafe(entryId);
0735 |             if (source == null || !Objects.equals(source.getOwnerId(), user.getUserId())) {
0736 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException("文件或文件夹不存在");
0737 |             }
0738 |             List<CloudEntry> descendants;
0739 |             if (source.isFolder()) {
0740 |                 descendants = listDescendantsUnsafe(user.getUserId(), buildEntryPath(source));
0741 |             } else {
0742 |                 descendants = Collections.emptyList();
0743 |             }
0744 |             long totalBytes = descendants.stream().filter(item -> !item.isFolder()).mapToLong(CloudEntry::getSize).sum();
0745 |             if (!source.isFolder()) {
0746 |                 totalBytes = source.getSize();
0747 |             }
0748 |             if (!canStore(user, totalBytes)) {
0749 |                 throw new IllegalArgumentException("云盘空间不足，无法压缩");
0750 |             }
0751 |             Path tempZip = null;
0752 |             String storedFileName;
0753 |             long zipSize = 0;
0754 |             try {
0755 |                 tempZip = Files.createTempFile("cloud_zip_", ".tmp");
0756 |                 try (OutputStream fout = Files.newOutputStream(tempZip);
0757 |                      ZipOutputStream zos = new ZipOutputStream(fout, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
0758 |                     if (source.isFolder()) {
0759 |                         if (descendants.isEmpty()) {
0760 |                             zos.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(source.getName() + "/"));
0761 |                             zos.closeEntry();
0762 |                         }
0763 |                         for (CloudEntry item : descendants) {
0764 |                             String fullPath = buildEntryPath(item);
0765 |                             String relative = fullPath.substring(buildEntryPath(source).length() + 1).replace("\\", "/");
0766 |                             if (item.isFolder()) {
0767 |                                 if (!relative.isEmpty()) {
0768 |                                     zos.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(relative + "/"));
0769 |                                     zos.closeEntry();
0770 |                                 }
0771 |                                 continue;
0772 |                             }
0773 |                             zos.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(relative));
0774 |                             try (InputStream in = openStreamCompat(user.getUserId(), item.getStoredName())) {

0892 |                             zos.closeEntry();

1056 |     private void load() {

1058 |         try {
1059 |             entries.clear();
1060 |             shares.clear();
1061 |             tasks.clear();
1062 |             downloads.clear();
1063 |             loadList(entriesFile(), new TypeToken<List<CloudEntry>>() {}.getType(), entries);
1064 |             loadList(sharesFile(), new TypeToken<List<CloudShareLink>>() {}.getType(), shares);
1065 |             loadList(tasksFile(), new TypeToken<List<CloudTask>>() {}.getType(), tasks);
1066 |             loadList(downloadsFile(), new TypeToken<List<CloudDownloadRecord>>() {}.getType(), downloads);
1067 |         } finally {
1068 |             lock.writeLock().unlock();
1069 |         }
1070 |     }

1072 |     private <T> void loadList(Path file, Type type, List<T> target) {
1073 |         try {
1074 |             if (!Files.exists(file)) {
1075 |                 return;
1076 |             }
1077 |             String json = Files.readString(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();
1078 |             if (json.isEmpty()) {
1079 |                 return;
1080 |             }
1081 |             List<T> list = JsonUtil.fromJson(json, type);
1082 |             if (list != null) {
1083 |                 target.addAll(list.stream().filter(Objects::nonNull).collect(Collectors.toList()));
1084 |             }
1085 |         } catch (Exception e) {
1086 |             System.err.println("[CloudService] 加载失败: " + file.getFileName() + " -> " + e.getMessage());
1087 |             try {
1088 |                 Path backup = file.resolveSibling(file.getFileName() + ".bak");
1089 |                 Files.copy(file, backup, java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
1090 |                 System.err.println("[CloudService] 已备份损坏文件到: " + backup);
1091 |             } catch (Exception ignored) {}
1092 |         }
1093 |     }

1111 |                         && !entry.isDeleted()
1112 |                         && entry.isFolder()
1113 |                         && Objects.equals(buildEntryPath(entry), normalized));

1120 |     private boolean hasNameConflictUnsafe(String ownerId, String parentPath, String name, String excludeId) {
1121 |         return entries.stream().anyMatch(entry ->
1122 |                 Objects.equals(entry.getOwnerId(), ownerId)
1123 |                         && !entry.isDeleted()
1124 |                         && Objects.equals(normalizePath(entry.getParentPath()), normalizePath(parentPath))
1125 |                         && Objects.equals(entry.getName(), name)
1126 |                         && !Objects.equals(entry.getId(), excludeId));
1127 |     }

1129 |     private String resolveDuplicateNameUnsafe(String ownerId, String parentPath, String name) {
1130 |         String base = name;
1131 |         String ext = "";
1132 |         int idx = name.lastIndexOf('.');
1133 |         if (idx > 0) {
1134 |             base = name.substring(0, idx);
1135 |             ext = name.substring(idx);
1136 |         }
1137 |         int suffix = 1;
1138 |         String candidate = name;
1139 |         while (hasNameConflictUnsafe(ownerId, parentPath, candidate, null)) {
1140 |             candidate = base + "_" + suffix + ext;
1141 |             suffix++;
1142 |         }
1143 |         return candidate;
1144 |     }

1152 |     private void purgeRecycleUnsafe(boolean saveAfter) {
1153 |         long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
1154 |         List<CloudEntry> expired = entries.stream()
1155 |                 .filter(CloudEntry::isDeleted)
1156 |                 .filter(entry -> entry.getDeletedAt() > 0 && now - entry.getDeletedAt() >= RECYCLE_EXPIRE_MS)
1157 |                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
1158 |         if (expired.isEmpty()) {
1159 |             return;
1160 |         }
1161 |         Set<String> expiredIds = expired.stream().map(CloudEntry::getId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
1162 |         entries.removeIf(e -> expiredIds.contains(e.getId()));
1163 |         for (CloudEntry entry : expired) {
1164 |             cleanupStoredFile(entry.getOwnerId(), entry.getStoredName());
1165 |         }
1166 |         if (saveAfter) {
1167 |             saveUnsafe();
1168 |         }
1169 |     }

1171 |     private void cleanupStoredFile(String ownerId, String storedName) {
1172 |         if (storedName == null || storedName.trim().isEmpty()) {
1173 |             return;
1174 |         }
1175 |         boolean stillUsed = entries.stream()
1176 |                 .anyMatch(entry -> !entry.isFolder() && Objects.equals(entry.getStoredName(), storedName));
1177 |         if (!stillUsed) {
1178 |             Path userFile = userFilesDir(ownerId).resolve(storedName);
1179 |             try {
1180 |                 Files.deleteIfExists(userFile);
1181 |             } catch (Exception ignored) {}
1182 |             try {
1183 |                 FileStore.getInstance().deleteStoredFile(storedName);
1184 |             } catch (Exception ignored) {}
1185 |         }
1186 |     }

1188 |     private String normalizePath(String path) {
1189 |         if (path == null || path.trim().isEmpty()) {
1190 |             return "/";
1191 |         }
1192 |         String normalized = path.replace("\\", "/").trim();
1193 |         if (!normalized.startsWith("/")) {
1194 |             normalized = "/" + normalized;
1195 |         }
1196 |         while (normalized.contains("//")) {
1197 |             normalized = normalized.replace("//", "/");
1198 |         }
1199 |         if (normalized.length() > 1 && normalized.endsWith("/")) {
1200 |             normalized = normalized.substring(0, normalized.length() - 1);
1201 |         }
1202 |         return normalized.isEmpty() ? "/" : normalized;
1203 |     }
1204 | 
1205 |     private String sanitizeName(String name) {
1206 |         String cleaned = FileStore.normalizeUploadedFileName(name);
1207 |         if (cleaned.contains("/")) {
1208 |             cleaned = cleaned.substring(cleaned.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
1209 |         }
1210 |         if (cleaned.trim().isEmpty()) {
1211 |             throw new IllegalArgumentException("名称不能为空");
1212 |         }
1213 |         return cleaned.trim();
1214 |     }
1215 | 
1216 |     private String buildEntryPath(CloudEntry entry) {
1217 |         String parent = normalizePath(entry.getParentPath());
1218 |         return "/".equals(parent) ? "/" + entry.getName() : parent + "/" + entry.getName();
1219 |     }

1221 |     private List<CloudEntry> listDescendantsUnsafe(String ownerId, String rootPath) {
1222 |         return entries.stream()
1223 |                 .filter(entry -> Objects.equals(entry.getOwnerId(), ownerId))
1224 |                 .filter(entry -> !entry.isDeleted())
1225 |                 .filter(entry -> buildEntryPath(entry).startsWith(rootPath + "/"))
1226 |                 .sorted(Comparator.comparing(CloudEntry::isFolder).reversed().thenComparing(this::buildEntryPath))
1227 |                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
1228 |     }
1229 | 
1230 |     private String ensureFolderPathUnsafe(String ownerId, String rootPath, String relativePath, Set<String> createdFolders) {
1231 |         String currentParent = rootPath;
1232 |         if (relativePath == null || relativePath.trim().isEmpty()) {
1233 |             return rootPath;
1234 |         }
1235 |         for (String rawPart : relativePath.split("/")) {
1236 |             String part = sanitizeName(rawPart);
1237 |             String nextPath = currentParent + "/" + part;
1238 |             if (!createdFolders.contains(nextPath)) {
1239 |                 String parentPath = normalizePath(currentParent);
1240 |                 CloudEntry folder = new CloudEntry();
1241 |                 folder.setId("cloud_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", ""));
1242 |                 folder.setOwnerId(ownerId);
1243 |                 folder.setParentPath(parentPath);
1244 |                 folder.setName(resolveDuplicateNameUnsafe(ownerId, parentPath, part));
1245 |                 folder.setType("folder");
1246 |                 folder.setCreatedAt(System.currentTimeMillis());
1247 |                 folder.setUpdatedAt(System.currentTimeMillis());
1248 |                 folder.setSourceModule("cloud-unzip");
1249 |                 entries.add(folder);
1250 |                 nextPath = buildEntryPath(folder);
1251 |                 createdFolders.add(nextPath);
1252 |             }
1253 |             currentParent = nextPath;
1254 |         }
1255 |         return currentParent;
1256 |     }
1257 | 
1258 |     private void rollbackCreatedEntriesUnsafe(String ownerId, String rootPath) {
1259 |         List<CloudEntry> created = entries.stream()
1260 |                 .filter(entry -> Objects.equals(entry.getOwnerId(), ownerId))
1261 |                 .filter(entry -> buildEntryPath(entry).startsWith(rootPath + "/"))
1262 |                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
1263 |         for (CloudEntry entry : created) {
1264 |             entries.removeIf(item -> Objects.equals(item.getId(), entry.getId()));
1265 |             cleanupStoredFile(ownerId, entry.getStoredName());
1266 |         }
1267 |     }

1273 |     private String guessContentType(String fileName) {
1274 |         String lower = String.valueOf(fileName).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
1275 |         if (lower.endsWith(".txt") || lower.endsWith(".md")) return "text/plain; charset=utf-8";
1276 |         if (lower.endsWith(".json")) return "application/json";
1277 |         if (lower.endsWith(".html")) return "text/html; charset=utf-8";
1278 |         if (lower.endsWith(".css")) return "text/css; charset=utf-8";
1279 |         if (lower.endsWith(".js")) return "application/javascript";
1280 |         if (lower.endsWith(".png")) return "image/png";
1281 |         if (lower.endsWith(".jpg") || lower.endsWith(".jpeg")) return "image/jpeg";
1282 |         if (lower.endsWith(".gif")) return "image/gif";
1283 |         if (lower.endsWith(".webp")) return "image/webp";
1284 |         if (lower.endsWith(".mp4")) return "video/mp4";
1285 |         if (lower.endsWith(".zip")) return "application/zip";
1286 |         return "application/octet-stream";
1287 |     }

1289 |     private String appendTimestampBeforeExtension(String fileName, long timestampSeconds) {
1290 |         int idx = fileName.lastIndexOf('.');
1291 |         if (idx > 0) {
1292 |             return fileName.substring(0, idx) + "_" + timestampSeconds + fileName.substring(idx);
1293 |         }
1294 |         return fileName + "_" + timestampSeconds;
1295 |     }

1297 |     private String extractExtension(String fileName) {
1298 |         if (fileName == null || fileName.trim().isEmpty()) {
1299 |             return "";
1300 |         }
1301 |         int idx = fileName.lastIndexOf('.');
1302 |         if (idx > 0 && idx < fileName.length() - 1) {
1303 |             return fileName.substring(idx + 1).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
1304 |         }
1305 |         return "";

0131 |     public Map<String, Integer> addAllUsersAsFriends(String ownerUserId) {
0132 |         Map<String, Integer> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
0133 |         int total = 0;
0134 |         int added = 0;
0135 |         int repaired = 0;
0136 |         int already = 0;
0137 |         int skipped = 0;
0138 |         int acceptedRequests = 0;
0139 | 
0140 |         UserService us = UserService.getInstance();
0141 |         User owner = us.getByUserId(ownerUserId);
0142 |         if (owner == null) {
0143 |             result.put("total", total);
0144 |             result.put("added", added);
0145 |             result.put("repaired", repaired);
0146 |             result.put("already", already);
0147 |             result.put("skipped", skipped);
0148 |             result.put("acceptedRequests", acceptedRequests);
0149 |             return result;
0150 |         }
0151 | 
0152 |         lock.writeLock().lock();
0153 |         try {
0154 |             if (owner.getFriends() == null) owner.setFriends(new ArrayList<>());
0155 |             Set<String> targetIds = new HashSet<>();
0156 |             for (User target : us.getAllUsers()) {
0157 |                 String targetId = target != null ? target.getUserId() : null;
0158 |                 if (targetId == null || targetId.trim().isEmpty() || targetId.equals(ownerUserId)) {
0159 |                     skipped++;
0160 |                     continue;
0161 |                 }
0162 |                 total++;
0163 |                 targetIds.add(targetId);
0164 |                 if (target.getFriends() == null) target.setFriends(new ArrayList<>());
0165 |                 boolean ownerHad = owner.getFriends().contains(targetId);
0166 |                 boolean targetHad = target.getFriends().contains(ownerUserId);
0167 |                 if (!ownerHad) owner.addFriend(targetId);
0168 |                 if (!targetHad) target.addFriend(ownerUserId);
0169 |                 if (!ownerHad) {
0170 |                     added++;
0171 |                 } else if (!targetHad) {
0172 |                     repaired++;
0173 |                 } else {
0174 |                     already++;
0175 |                 }
0176 |             }
0177 | 
0178 |             synchronized (requests) {
0179 |                 for (FriendRequest req : requests) {
0180 |                     if (!"pending".equals(req.getStatus())) continue;
0181 |                     boolean ownerSent = ownerUserId.equals(req.getFromUserId()) && targetIds.contains(req.getToUserId());
0182 |                     boolean ownerReceived = ownerUserId.equals(req.getToUserId()) && targetIds.contains(req.getFromUserId());
0183 |                     if (ownerSent || ownerReceived) {
0184 |                         req.setStatus("accepted");
0185 |                         acceptedRequests++;
0186 |                     }
0187 |                 }
0188 |             }
0189 | 
0190 |             if (added > 0 || repaired > 0) us.save();
0191 |             if (acceptedRequests > 0) save();
0192 |         } finally {
0193 |             lock.writeLock().unlock();
0194 |         }
0195 | 
0196 |         result.put("total", total);
0197 |         result.put("added", added);
0198 |         result.put("repaired", repaired);
0199 |         result.put("already", already);
0200 |         result.put("skipped", skipped);
0201 |         result.put("acceptedRequests", acceptedRequests);
0202 |         return result;
0203 |     }

0205 |     public boolean handleRequest(String requestId, String action, String currentUserId) {

0207 |         synchronized (requests) {

0209 |                     .filter(r -> r.getId().equals(requestId) && r.getToUserId().equals(currentUserId))
0210 |                     .findFirst();

0213 |         FriendRequest req = opt.get();

0216 |             UserService us = UserService.getInstance();
0217 |             User from = us.getByUserId(req.getFromUserId());
0218 |             User to   = us.getByUserId(req.getToUserId());
0219 |             if (from != null && to != null) {
0220 |                 from.addFriend(to.getUserId());
0221 |                 to.addFriend(from.getUserId());
0222 |                 us.save();
0223 |             }
0224 |         } else {
0225 |             req.setStatus("rejected");
0226 |         }
0227 |         save();
0228 |         return true;
0229 |     }

0401 |     private void normalizeGame(GameEntry game) {

0418 |             game.setHeatScore(0D);
0419 |         }
0420 |         sortVersions(game);
0421 |         GameVersion firstVersion = game.getVersions().isEmpty() ? null : game.getVersions().get(0);
0422 |         GameVersion latestVersion = game.getLatestVersion();
0423 |         if (game.getCreatedAt() <= 0 && firstVersion != null) {
0424 |             game.setCreatedAt(firstVersion.getUploadTime());
0425 |         }
0426 |         if (game.getUpdatedAt() <= 0) {
0427 |             game.setUpdatedAt(latestVersion != null ? latestVersion.getUploadTime() : game.getCreatedAt());
0428 |         }
0429 |         if (latestVersion != null && latestVersion.getUploadTime() > game.getUpdatedAt()) {
0430 |             game.setUpdatedAt(latestVersion.getUploadTime());
0431 |         }

0433 |             game.setDeveloperId(firstVersion.getUploaderId());
0434 |         }
0435 |         if (isBlank(game.getDeveloperNickname()) && firstVersion != null) {
0436 |             game.setDeveloperNickname(firstVersion.getUploaderNickname());

0451 |     private void cleanupHeatCounters(GameEntry game) {
0452 |         if (game == null) {
0453 |             return;
0454 |         }
0455 |         LocalDate cutoff = LocalDate.now(GAME_ZONE).minusDays(14);
0456 |         Iterator<Map.Entry<String, Integer>> iterator = game.getDailyHeatContributions().entrySet().iterator();
0457 |         while (iterator.hasNext()) {
0458 |             Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry = iterator.next();
0459 |             String key = entry.getKey();
0460 |             int sep = key.indexOf("::");
0461 |             if (sep <= 0) {
0462 |                 iterator.remove();
0463 |                 continue;
0464 |             }
0465 |             try {
0466 |                 LocalDate date = LocalDate.parse(key.substring(0, sep));
0467 |                 if (date.isBefore(cutoff)) {
0468 |                     iterator.remove();
0469 |                 }
0470 |             } catch (Exception ignored) {
0471 |                 iterator.remove();
0472 |             }
0473 |         }
0474 |     }

0476 |     private double effectiveHeatScore(GameEntry game) {
0477 |         if (game == null) {
0478 |             return 0D;
0479 |         }
0480 |         return roundHeat(Math.max(0D, game.getHeatScore()) + publishTimeBoost(game));
0481 |     }
