0483 |     private double publishTimeBoost(GameEntry game) {
0484 |         if (game == null) {
0485 |             return 0D;
0486 |         }
0487 |         long publishedAt = game.getCreatedAt() > 0 ? game.getCreatedAt() : game.getUpdatedAt();
0488 |         if (publishedAt <= 0) {
0489 |             return 0D;
0490 |         }
0491 |         long ageMs = Math.max(0L, System.currentTimeMillis() - publishedAt);
0492 |         double ageHours = ageMs / (double) HOUR_MS;
0493 |         double timeWeight;
0494 |         if (ageMs <= NEW_GAME_BOOST_WINDOW_MS) {
0495 |             timeWeight = 28D * (1D - ageMs / (double) NEW_GAME_BOOST_WINDOW_MS);
0496 |         } else {
0497 |             timeWeight = 8D / (1D + Math.max(0D, ageHours - 5D) / 24D);
0498 |         }
0499 |         double baseHeat = Math.max(0D, game.getHeatScore());
0500 |         double todayVisits = recentVisitCount(game);
0501 |         double popularityDamping = 1D + baseHeat / 36D + todayVisits / 10D;
0502 |         return roundHeat(Math.max(0D, timeWeight / popularityDamping));
0503 |     }

0505 |     private int recentVisitCount(GameEntry game) {
0506 |         if (game == null || game.getDailyHeatContributions() == null) {
0507 |             return 0;
0508 |         }
0509 |         String todayPrefix = LocalDate.now(GAME_ZONE) + "::";
0510 |         int total = 0;
0511 |         for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : game.getDailyHeatContributions().entrySet()) {
0512 |             if (entry.getKey() != null && entry.getKey().startsWith(todayPrefix)) {
0513 |                 total += Math.max(0, entry.getValue() == null ? 0 : entry.getValue());
0514 |             }
0515 |         }
0516 |         return total;
0517 |     }

0175 |     private boolean canView(Moment m, String viewerUserId, Set<String> viewerFriends) {
0176 |         if (m == null) return false;
0177 |         if (m.getFromUserId() != null && m.getFromUserId().equals(viewerUserId)) return true; // 自己总能看到
0178 |         String vis = m.getVisibility();
0179 |         if (vis == null || "public".equals(vis)) return true;
0180 |         if ("private".equals(vis)) return false; // 完全私密
0181 |         boolean isFriend = viewerFriends != null && m.getFromUserId() != null && viewerFriends.contains(m.getFromUserId());
0182 |         if ("friends".equals(vis)) return isFriend;
0183 |         List<String> list = m.getAllowedViewers() != null ? m.getAllowedViewers() : Collections.emptyList();
0184 |         if ("specific".equals(vis)) return list.contains(viewerUserId);
0185 |         if ("no-specific".equals(vis)) return isFriend && !list.contains(viewerUserId);
0186 |         return false;
0187 |     }

0358 |             try {
0359 |                 return (long) Double.parseDouble(s);
0360 |             } catch (Exception e) {
0361 |                 return def;
0362 |             }
0363 |         }
0364 |     }

0521 |             boolean changed = false;

0530 |                 user.setPasswordPolicyVersion(User.CURRENT_PASSWORD_POLICY_VERSION);
0531 |                 changed = true;
0532 |             }
0533 |             if (changed) save();
0534 |             return user;

0536 |         return null;

0017 | public class MessageService {
0018 |     private static final MessageService INSTANCE = new MessageService();
0019 |     public static MessageService getInstance() { return INSTANCE; }

0021 |     public static final int PAGE_SIZE = 20;

0023 |     private static final String CHATS_DIR = "chatserver/chats";

0028 |     private static final String OLD_GROUPS  = "chatserver/groups";
0029 | 
0030 |     // rooms untouched for this long get evicted from memory
0031 |     private static final long CACHE_TTL_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000L;
0032 |     // how often to check for stale rooms
0033 |     private static final long CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000L;
0034 | 
0035 |     private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, RoomData> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
0036 |     private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, String> messageIdToRoomIdMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
0037 |     private final AtomicLong idCounter = new AtomicLong(1);
0038 |     private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
0039 |     private volatile long lastCleanupMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
0040 | 
0041 |     /** Lightweight handle for a single room's messages. */
0042 |     private static final class RoomData {
0043 |         final List<Message> messages = new ArrayList<>();
0044 |         volatile long lastAccessMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
0045 |     }
0046 | 
0047 |     // ---------------------------------------------------------------
0048 | 
0049 |     private MessageService() {
0050 |         try { Files.createDirectories(Paths.get(CHATS_DIR)); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
0051 |         migrateOldData();
0052 |         initIdCounter();
0053 |         System.out.println("[MessageService] 已初始化 缓存模式 TTL=" + (CACHE_TTL_MS / 60000) + "min");
0054 |     }
0055 | 
0056 |     // ========================  disk I/O  ==========================

0058 |     private Path messageFile(String roomId) {

0062 |     private List<Message> loadFromDisk(String roomId) {
0063 |         Path f = messageFile(roomId);
0064 |         if (!Files.exists(f)) return new ArrayList<>();
0065 |         try {
0066 |             String json = new String(Files.readAllBytes(f), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
0067 |             Type t = new TypeToken<List<Message>>(){}.getType();
0068 |             List<Message> list = JsonUtil.fromJson(json, t);
0069 |             if (list == null) return new ArrayList<>();
0070 |             for (Message m : list) {
0071 |                 if (m.getMsgType() == null) m.setMsgType("text");
0072 |                 if (m.getContent() == null) m.setContent("");
0073 |             }
0074 |             return list;
0075 |         } catch (Exception e) {
0076 |             System.err.println("[MessageService] load " + roomId + " err: " + e.getMessage());
0077 |             try {
0078 |                 Path bak = f.resolveSibling(f.getFileName() + ".bak");
0079 |                 Files.copy(f, bak, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
0080 |             } catch (Exception ignored) {}
0081 |             return new ArrayList<>();
0082 |         }
0083 |     }

0085 |     public void saveRoom(String roomId) {
0086 |         RoomData rd = loadRoom(roomId);
0087 |         List<Message> snapshot;
0088 |         synchronized (rd.messages) {
0089 |             snapshot = new ArrayList<>(rd.messages);
0090 |         }
0091 |         saveToDisk(roomId, snapshot);
0092 |     }

0094 |     private void saveToDisk(String roomId, Collection<Message> messages) {
0095 |         try {
0096 |             String json = JsonUtil.toJson(messages);
0097 |             Path f = messageFile(roomId);
0098 |             Files.createDirectories(f.getParent());
0099 |             com.chat.util.JsonUtil.writeBytesAtomic(f, json.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
0100 |         } catch (Exception e) {
0101 |             System.err.println("[MessageService] save " + roomId + " err: " + e.getMessage());
0102 |         }
0103 |     }
0104 | 
0105 |     // ========================  cache layer  =======================
0106 | 
0107 |     /** Return cached room, or load from disk and cache it. */
0108 |     private RoomData loadRoom(String roomId) {
0109 |         RoomData rd = cache.get(roomId);
0110 |         if (rd != null) {
0111 |             rd.lastAccessMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
0112 |             return rd;
0113 |         }
0114 |         lock.writeLock().lock();
0115 |         try {
0116 |             rd = cache.get(roomId);
0117 |             if (rd != null) {
0118 |                 rd.lastAccessMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
0119 |                 return rd;
0120 |             }
0121 |             rd = new RoomData();
0122 |             rd.messages.addAll(loadFromDisk(roomId));
0123 |             cache.put(roomId, rd);
0124 |             return rd;
0125 |         } finally {
0126 |             lock.writeLock().unlock();
0127 |         }
0128 |     }
0129 | 
0130 |     /** Evict rooms not accessed within TTL. */
0131 |     private void evictStale() {
0132 |         long deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() - CACHE_TTL_MS;
0133 |         lock.writeLock().lock();
0134 |         try {
0135 |             Iterator<Map.Entry<String, RoomData>> it = cache.entrySet().iterator();
0136 |             while (it.hasNext()) {
0137 |                 Map.Entry<String, RoomData> e = it.next();
0138 |                 if (e.getValue().lastAccessMs < deadline) {
0139 |                     List<Message> snapshot;
0140 |                     synchronized (e.getValue().messages) {
0141 |                         snapshot = new ArrayList<>(e.getValue().messages);
0142 |                     }
0143 |                     saveToDisk(e.getKey(), snapshot);
0144 |                     it.remove();
0145 |                 }
0146 |             }
0147 |         } finally {
0148 |             lock.writeLock().unlock();
0149 |         }
0150 |     }
0151 | 
0152 |     /** Rate-limited cleanup trigger. */
0153 |     private void triggerCleanup() {
0154 |         long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
0155 |         if (now - lastCleanupMs > CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS) {
0156 |             lastCleanupMs = now;
0157 |             evictStale();
0158 |         }
0159 |     }

0281 |     public List<Message> getMessagesPaged(String chatRoomId, long beforeId, String currentUserId) {
0282 |         String roomId = normalizeRoomId(currentUserId, chatRoomId);
0283 |         RoomData rd = loadRoom(roomId);
0284 |         synchronized (rd.messages) {
0285 |             long refTimestamp = -1;
0286 |             if (beforeId > 0) {
0287 |                 for (Message m : rd.messages) {
0288 |                     if (String.valueOf(beforeId).equals(m.getId())) {
0289 |                         refTimestamp = m.getTimestamp();
0290 |                         break;
0291 |                     }
0292 |                 }
0293 |             }
0294 |             final long targetTime = refTimestamp;
0295 |             List<Message> filtered = rd.messages.stream()
0296 |                 .filter(m -> {
0297 |                     if (beforeId == 0) return true;
0298 |                     try {
0299 |                         return Long.parseLong(m.getId()) < beforeId;
0300 |                     } catch (Exception e) {
0301 |                         if (targetTime > 0) {
0302 |                             return m.getTimestamp() < targetTime;
0303 |                         } else {
0304 |                             return m.getTimestamp() < beforeId;
0305 |                         }
0306 |                     }
0307 |                 })
0308 |                 .collect(Collectors.toList());
0309 |             int size = filtered.size();
0310 |             if (size == 0) return Collections.emptyList();
0311 |             return new ArrayList<>(filtered.subList(Math.max(0, size - PAGE_SIZE), size));
0312 |         }
0313 |     }

0433 |     public String recallMessage(String messageId, String requestUserId, boolean ignoreTimeout) {
0434 |         // ensure the owning room is in cache
0435 |         Message found = getById(messageId);
0436 |         if (found == null) return "not_found";
0437 |         String roomId = found.getChatRoomId();

0439 |         if (rd == null) return "not_found";
0440 |         List<Message> snapshot = null;
0441 |         String fpToClean = null;
0442 |         synchronized (rd.messages) {
0443 |             for (Message m : rd.messages) {
0444 |                 if (m.getId().equals(messageId)) {
0445 |                     if (!m.getFromUserId().equals(requestUserId)) return "not_owner";
0446 |                     if (!ignoreTimeout && System.currentTimeMillis() - m.getTimestamp() > 10 * 60 * 1000L) return "timeout";
0447 |                     fpToClean = m.getFilePath();
0448 |                     m.setRecalled(true);
0449 |                     m.setContent("【该消息已撤回】");
0450 |                     m.setFilePath(null);
0451 |                     snapshot = new ArrayList<>(rd.messages);
0452 |                     break;
0453 |                 }
0454 |             }
0455 |         }
0456 |         if (snapshot == null) return "not_found";
0457 |         saveToDisk(roomId, snapshot);
0458 |         cleanupOrphanedFile(fpToClean);
0459 |         return "ok";
0460 |     }

0499 |     public List<Message> deleteMessagesOlderThanDetailed(String roomId, long olderThanMs) {

0501 |         List<Message> removed = new ArrayList<>();
0502 |         synchronized (rd.messages) {

0509 |                     it.remove();
0510 |                 }
0511 |             }
0512 |         }
0513 |         if (!removed.isEmpty()) saveToDisk(roomId, rd.messages);
0514 |         return removed;
0515 |     }

0519 |     public List<Message> searchMessages(String keyword, int limit) {
0520 |         if (keyword == null || keyword.trim().isEmpty()) return Collections.emptyList();
0521 |         String lower = keyword.toLowerCase();
0522 |         List<Message> results = new ArrayList<>();
0523 |         Set<String> searchedRoomIds = new HashSet<>();
0524 | 
0525 |         for (Map.Entry<String, RoomData> entry : cache.entrySet()) {
0526 |             String roomId = entry.getKey();
0527 |             searchedRoomIds.add(roomId);
0528 |             RoomData rd = entry.getValue();
0529 |             List<Message> snapshot;
0530 |             synchronized (rd.messages) {
0531 |                 if (rd.messages.isEmpty()) continue;
0532 |                 snapshot = new ArrayList<>(rd.messages);
0533 |             }
0534 |             for (Message m : snapshot) {
0535 |                 if (m.getContent() != null && m.getContent().toLowerCase().contains(lower)) {
0536 |                     results.add(m);
0537 |                     if (results.size() >= limit) return results;
0538 |                 }
0539 |             }
0540 |         }
0541 | 
0542 |         try {
0543 |             Path chatsPath = Paths.get(CHATS_DIR);
0544 |             if (Files.exists(chatsPath) && Files.isDirectory(chatsPath)) {
0545 |                 try (DirectoryStream<Path> stream = Files.newDirectoryStream(chatsPath)) {
0546 |                     for (Path roomDir : stream) {
0547 |                         if (Files.isDirectory(roomDir)) {
0548 |                             String roomId = roomDir.getFileName().toString();
0549 |                             if (searchedRoomIds.contains(roomId)) continue;
0550 | 
0551 |                             List<Message> messages = loadFromDisk(roomId);
0552 |                             for (Message m : messages) {
0553 |                                 if (m.getContent() != null && m.getContent().toLowerCase().contains(lower)) {
0554 |                                     results.add(m);
0555 |                                     if (results.size() >= limit) return results;
0556 |                                 }
0557 |                             }
0558 |                         }
0559 |                     }
0560 |                 }
0561 |             }
0562 |         } catch (Exception e) {
0563 |             System.err.println("[MessageService] searchMessages disk search err: " + e.getMessage());
0564 |         }
0565 | 
0566 |         return results;
0567 |     }

0625 |         if (storedName.isEmpty()) return;

0633 |         }
0634 |         try {

0646 |                         }
0647 |                     }
0648 |                 }
0649 |             }
0650 |         } catch (Exception ignored) {}
0651 |         try { FileStore.getInstance().deleteStoredFile(storedName); } catch (Exception ignored) {}

0245 |         if (text.isEmpty() || text.codePointCount(0, text.length()) <= maxChars) {
0246 |             return text;
0247 |         }
0248 |         return text.substring(0, text.offsetByCodePoints(0, maxChars));

0251 |     private String extractFileName(String path) {
0252 |         if (path == null) return null;
0253 |         int lastSlash = Math.max(path.lastIndexOf('/'), path.lastIndexOf('\\'));
0254 |         return lastSlash >= 0 ? path.substring(lastSlash + 1) : path;
0255 |     }

0257 |     private boolean contentContainsFile(String content, String storedName) {
0258 |         if (content == null || storedName == null || content.isEmpty()) return false;
0259 |         java.util.regex.Matcher m = java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("(?:/files/|files/)([^\\s\"'>)]+)").matcher(content);
0260 |         while (m.find()) {
0261 |             String extracted = extractFileName(m.group(1));
0262 |             if (Objects.equals(extracted, storedName)) {
0263 |                 return true;
0264 |             }
0265 |         }
0266 |         return false;
0267 |     }

0269 |     public boolean hasAccessToFile(String userId, String storedName) {
0270 |         if (storedName == null || storedName.trim().isEmpty()) return false;
0271 |         lock.readLock().lock();
0272 |         try {
0273 |             // 1. 笔记所有者可访问自己笔记中的附件
0274 |             if (userId != null && notes.stream()
0275 |                     .filter(n -> Objects.equals(n.getOwnerId(), userId))
0276 |                     .anyMatch(n -> contentContainsFile(n.getContent(), storedName))) {
0277 |                 return true;
0278 |             }
0279 |             // 2. 处于公开分享状态的笔记，任何人均可访问其嵌入附件（支持分享链接预览）
0280 |             return notes.stream()
0281 |                     .filter(n -> n.getShareId() != null && !n.getShareId().isEmpty())
0282 |                     .anyMatch(n -> contentContainsFile(n.getContent(), storedName));
0283 |         } finally {
0284 |             lock.readLock().unlock();
0285 |         }
0286 |     }
0287 | }

0001 | package com.chat.util;
0002 | 
0003 | import javax.crypto.SecretKeyFactory;
0004 | import javax.crypto.spec.PBEKeySpec;
0005 | import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
0006 | import java.security.MessageDigest;
0007 | import java.security.SecureRandom;
0008 | import java.util.Base64;
0009 | 
0010 | public final class PasswordUtil {
0011 |     private static final String PREFIX = "pbkdf2";
0012 |     private static final int ITERATIONS = 120_000;
0013 |     private static final int KEY_LENGTH = 256;
0014 |     private static final int SALT_BYTES = 16;
0015 |     private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();
0016 | 
0017 |     private PasswordUtil() {
0018 |     }
0019 | 
0020 |     public static boolean looksHashed(String stored) {
0021 |         return stored != null && stored.startsWith(PREFIX + "$");
0022 |     }
0023 | 
0024 |     public static String hashPassword(String rawPassword) {
0025 |         if (rawPassword == null) {
0026 |             throw new IllegalArgumentException("密码不能为空");
0027 |         }
0028 |         byte[] salt = new byte[SALT_BYTES];
0029 |         RANDOM.nextBytes(salt);
0030 |         byte[] hash = pbkdf2(rawPassword.toCharArray(), salt, ITERATIONS, KEY_LENGTH);
0031 |         return PREFIX + "$" + ITERATIONS + "$"
0032 |                 + Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(salt) + "$"
0033 |                 + Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(hash);
0034 |     }
0035 | 
0036 |     public static boolean verifyPassword(String rawPassword, String stored) {
0037 |         if (rawPassword == null || stored == null || stored.isEmpty()) {
0038 |             return false;
0039 |         }
0040 |         if (!looksHashed(stored)) {
0041 |             return false;
0042 |         }
0043 |         try {
0044 |             String[] parts = stored.split("\\$");
0045 |             if (parts.length != 4) {
0046 |                 return false;
0047 |             }
0048 |             int iterations = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
0049 |             byte[] salt = Base64.getDecoder().decode(parts[2]);
0050 |             byte[] expected = Base64.getDecoder().decode(parts[3]);
0051 |             byte[] actual = pbkdf2(rawPassword.toCharArray(), salt, iterations, expected.length * 8);
0052 |             return MessageDigest.isEqual(expected, actual);
0053 |         } catch (Exception e) {
0054 |             return false;
0055 |         }
0056 |     }
0057 | 
0058 |     private static byte[] pbkdf2(char[] password, byte[] salt, int iterations, int keyLength) {
0059 |         try {
0060 |             PBEKeySpec spec = new PBEKeySpec(password, salt, iterations, keyLength);
0061 |             return SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256").generateSecret(spec).getEncoded();
0062 |         } catch (Exception e) {
0063 |             throw new IllegalStateException("密码哈希失败", e);
0064 |         }
0065 |     }
0066 | }

0074 |             return null;

0077 |             sessions.remove(sessionId);
0078 |             save();
0079 |             return null;
0080 |         }

0084 |             save();
0085 |         }

0095 |         save();
